name: IngramMello.exists_coef_bound
statement:
theorem exists_coef_bound (f : F[X]) :
    ∃ B : Γ₀, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ B
proof:
:=
  ⟨1 ⊔ (Finset.range f.natDegree).sup fun k => v (f.coeff k), le_sup_left, fun k hk =>
    le_sup_of_le_right (Finset.le_sup (f := fun k => v (f.coeff k)) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk))⟩

name: IngramMello.val_eval_sub_eval_le
statement:
theorem val_eval_sub_eval_le {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) {B : Γ₀} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ B) {x y : F} (hx : v x ≤ B) (hy : v y ≤ B) :
    v (f.eval x - f.eval y) ≤ v (x - y) * B ^ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : f.eval x - f.eval y = (x - y) * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (f.natDegree + 1),
      f.coeff i * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, x ^ j * y ^ (i - 1 - j) := by
    rw [eval_eq_sum_range, eval_eq_sum_range, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [← mul_sub, ← geom_sum₂_mul]; ring
  rw [hxy, Valuation.map_mul]
  refine mul_le_mul' le_rfl (v.map_sum_le fun i hi => ?_)
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
  rw [Valuation.map_mul]
  have hci : v (f.coeff i) ≤ B := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hi) with h | h
    · exact hcoef i h
    · rw [h, hf.coeff_natDegree, Valuation.map_one]; exact hB
  have hsum : v (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, x ^ j * y ^ (i - 1 - j)) ≤ B ^ (i - 1) := by
    refine v.map_sum_le fun j hj => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow, Valuation.map_pow]
    calc v x ^ j * v y ^ (i - 1 - j) ≤ B ^ j * B ^ (i - 1 - j) :=
          mul_le_mul' (pow_le_pow_left' hx j) (pow_le_pow_left' hy _)
      _ = B ^ (i - 1) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with hi0 | hi0
  · subst hi0
    simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, Valuation.map_zero, mul_zero]
    exact zero_le
  · calc v (f.coeff i) * v (∑ j ∈ Finset.range i, x ^ j * y ^ (i - 1 - j))
        ≤ B * B ^ (i - 1) := mul_le_mul' hci hsum
      _ = B ^ i := by rw [← pow_succ']; congr 1; omega
      _ ≤ B ^ f.natDegree := pow_le_pow_right' hB (by omega)

name: IngramMello.val_iterate_sub_iterate_le
statement:
theorem val_iterate_sub_iterate_le {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) {B : Γ₀} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ B) {x y : F}
    (hx : ∀ m, v ((fun z => f.eval z)^[m] x) ≤ B)
    (hy : ∀ m, v ((fun z => f.eval z)^[m] y) ≤ B) (g : ℕ) :
    v ((fun z => f.eval z)^[g] x - (fun z => f.eval z)^[g] y)
      ≤ v (x - y) * (B ^ f.natDegree) ^ g
proof:
:= by
  induction g with
  | zero => simp
  | succ g ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', pow_succ, ← mul_assoc]
    exact (val_eval_sub_eval_le v hf hB hcoef (hx g) (hy g)).trans (mul_le_mul' ih le_rfl)

name: IngramMello.exists_escape_data
statement:
theorem exists_escape_data {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree) {c : F}
    (h : Escapes v f c) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (γ : Γ₀), 1 < γ ∧ ∀ q, n ≤ q →
      v ((fun z => f.eval z)^[q] c - c) = γ ^ (f.natDegree ^ (q - n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hcoef, n, hn⟩ := h
  set F := fun z => f.eval z with hF
  have hesc := val_iterate_of_escape v hf hd hB hcoef hn
  have hγ : B < v (F^[n + 1] c) := by
    have := (hesc 1).1
    rwa [← Function.iterate_add_apply, add_comm] at this
  refine ⟨n + 1, v (F^[n + 1] c), lt_of_le_of_lt hB hγ, fun q hq => ?_⟩
  have hpow : ∀ m, v (F^[m + (n + 1)] c) = v (F^[n + 1] c) ^ (f.natDegree ^ m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => simp
    | succ m ih =>
      have hB' : B < v (F^[m + (n + 1)] c) := by
        have := (hesc (m + 1)).1
        rwa [← Function.iterate_add_apply, show m + 1 + n = m + (n + 1) by omega] at this
      rw [show m + 1 + (n + 1) = (m + (n + 1)) + 1 by omega, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        val_eval_eq_pow v hf hd hB hcoef hB', ih, ← pow_mul, pow_succ]
  have hq' : v (F^[q] c) = v (F^[n + 1] c) ^ (f.natDegree ^ (q - (n + 1))) := by
    have := hpow (q - (n + 1))
    rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hq] at this
  have hcq : v c < v (F^[q] c) := by
    rcases le_or_gt (v c) B with hcB | hcB
    · calc v c ≤ B := hcB
        _ < v (F^[n + 1] c) := hγ
        _ ≤ v (F^[q] c) := by
          rw [hq']
          exact le_self_pow (lt_of_le_of_lt hB hγ).le (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega))
    · have hsm : StrictMono fun m : ℕ => v (F^[m] c) :=
        strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun m => (val_iterate_of_escape v hf hd hB hcoef hcB m).2
      exact hsm (show 0 < q by omega)
  rw [Valuation.map_sub_eq_of_lt_left v hcq, hq']

name: IngramMello.exp_succ_le_of_exp_lt
statement:
theorem exp_succ_le_of_exp_lt {a : ℤ} {x : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (h : WithZero.exp a < x) : WithZero.exp (a + 1) ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithZero.le_log_iff_exp_le hx]
  rw [← WithZero.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hx] at h
  omega

name: IngramMello.false_of_escapes_of_prod_val_eq_one
statement:
theorem false_of_escapes_of_prod_val_eq_one {E : Type*} [Field E] {f : E[X]} (hf : f.Monic)
    (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))) (z : ι → E)
    (hper : ∀ p (g : ℕ), 0 < g → (fun x => f.eval x)^[g] (z p) ≠ z p)
    (hesc : ∃ p₀, Escapes (w p₀) f (z p₀))
    (hprod : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → ∏ p, w p ((fun x => f.eval x)^[q] (z p) - z p) = 1) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F := fun x => f.eval x with hF
  set d := f.natDegree with hd_def
  have hd0 : 0 < d := by omega
  set P : ℕ → ι → E := fun q p => F^[q] (z p) - z p with hP
  have hPne : ∀ q p, 0 < q → P q p ≠ 0 := fun q p hq => sub_ne_zero.mpr (hper p q hq)
  have hwne : ∀ q p, 0 < q → w p (P q p) ≠ 0 :=
    fun q p hq => (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).mpr (hPne q p hq)
  obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩ := hesc
  haveI : Nonempty ι := ⟨p₀⟩
  obtain ⟨n₀, γ, hγ, hγq⟩ := exists_escape_data (w p₀) hf hd hp₀
                                              
  have key : ∀ p, ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)), 1 ≤ B ∧
      (Escapes (w p) f (z p) → ∀ q, n ≤ q → 1 < w p (P q p)) ∧
      (¬ Escapes (w p) f (z p) → (∀ q, w p (P q p) ≤ B) ∧ ∀ m, w p (F^[m] (z p)) ≤ B) := by
    intro p
    by_cases hp : Escapes (w p) f (z p)
    · obtain ⟨n, γ', hγ', h⟩ := exists_escape_data (w p) hf hd hp
      refine ⟨n, 1, le_rfl, fun _ q hq => ?_, fun h' => absurd hp h'⟩
      simp only [hP]
      rw [h q hq]
      exact one_lt_pow' hγ' (pow_ne_zero _ (by omega))
    · obtain ⟨B, hB, hcoef⟩ := exists_coef_bound (w p) f
      have h1 : ∀ m, w p (F^[m] (z p)) ≤ B := fun m => by
        by_contra hcon
        push Not at hcon
        exact hp ⟨B, hB, hcoef, m, hcon⟩
      refine ⟨0, B, hB, fun h' => absurd h' hp, fun _ => ⟨fun q => ?_, h1⟩⟩
      exact (Valuation.map_sub _ _ _).trans (max_le (h1 q) (h1 0))
  choose n B hB1 hEsc hBdd using key
  set N : ℕ := (Finset.univ.sup n) ⊔ n₀ ⊔ 1 with hN
  have hNn : ∀ p, n p ≤ N := fun p =>
    (Finset.le_sup (f := n) (Finset.mem_univ p)).trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
  have hNn₀ : n₀ ≤ N := le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left
  have hN1 : 1 ≤ N := le_sup_right
  set k := Fintype.card ι with hk
  have hkpos : 0 < k := Fintype.card_pos
  set m : ℕ → ℕ := fun q => d ^ (q - n₀) / k with hm
  have hm_mono : Monotone m := fun a b hab =>
    Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hd0 (Nat.sub_le_sub_right hab _))
                                                                             
  have claim : ∀ q, N ≤ q → k ≤ d ^ (q - n₀) → ∃ p, ¬ Escapes (w p) f (z p) ∧
      w p (P q p) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(m q : ℤ)) := by
    intro q hq hkq
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have hq1 : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hN1 hq
    have hmq : 1 ≤ m q := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hkpos).mpr (by rw [one_mul]; exact hkq)
    have hlow : ∀ p ∈ Finset.univ.erase p₀,
        WithZero.exp (1 - (m q : ℤ)) ≤ w p (P q p) := by
      intro p _
      have hlt : WithZero.exp (-(m q : ℤ)) < w p (P q p) := by
        by_cases hp : Escapes (w p) f (z p)
        · calc WithZero.exp (-(m q : ℤ)) ≤ 1 := WithZero.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by omega)
            _ < w p (P q p) := hEsc p hp q ((hNn p).trans hq)
        · exact hcon p hp
      have := exp_succ_le_of_exp_lt (hwne q p hq1) hlt
      rwa [show -(m q : ℤ) + 1 = 1 - (m q : ℤ) by ring] at this
    have hp₀q : WithZero.exp ((d ^ (q - n₀) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ w p₀ (P q p₀) := by
      simp only [hP]
      rw [hγq q (hNn₀.trans hq)]
      have hγ0 : γ ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans hγ).ne'
      rw [← WithZero.le_log_iff_exp_le (pow_ne_zero _ hγ0), WithZero.log_pow]
      have hlogγ : 1 ≤ WithZero.log γ := by
        have : 0 < WithZero.log γ :=
          (WithZero.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hγ0).mpr (by rwa [WithZero.exp_zero])
        omega
      calc ((d ^ (q - n₀) : ℕ) : ℤ) = (d ^ (q - n₀)) • (1 : ℤ) := by simp
        _ ≤ (d ^ (q - n₀)) • WithZero.log γ := nsmul_le_nsmul_right hlogγ _
    have hprodq := hprod q hq1
    rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ p₀)] at hprodq
    have hlow' : WithZero.exp (1 - (m q : ℤ)) ^ (Finset.univ.erase p₀).card
        ≤ ∏ p ∈ Finset.univ.erase p₀, w p (P q p) := by
      rw [← Finset.prod_const]; exact Finset.prod_le_prod hlow
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ p₀), Finset.card_univ] at hlow'
    have h1 : WithZero.exp ((d ^ (q - n₀) : ℕ) : ℤ) * WithZero.exp (1 - (m q : ℤ)) ^ (k - 1)
        ≤ 1 := by
      rw [← hprodq]; exact mul_le_mul' hp₀q hlow'
    rw [← WithZero.exp_nsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add, WithZero.exp_le_one_iff, nsmul_eq_mul] at h1
    have hdiv : m q * k ≤ d ^ (q - n₀) := Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _
    obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ : ∃ k', k = k' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hk', Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
    have hdiv' : ((m q : ℤ)) * ((k' : ℤ) + 1) ≤ ((d ^ (q - n₀) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
      rw [hk'] at hdiv; exact_mod_cast hdiv
    have hmq' : (1 : ℤ) ≤ m q := by exact_mod_cast hmq
    nlinarith
                            
  have hbig : ∀ q, N + k ≤ q → k ≤ d ^ (q - n₀) := by
    intro q hq
    have h1 : q - n₀ < d ^ (q - n₀) := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    omega
  have hsel : ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ p, ¬ Escapes (w p) f (z p) ∧
      w p (P (N + k + q) p) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(m (N + k + q) : ℤ)) :=
    fun q => claim _ (by omega) (hbig _ (by omega))
  choose sel hselE hselle using hsel
  have hpig : ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℕ, a < b ∧ b ≤ k ∧ sel (q + a) = sel (q + b) := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt
      (fun a : Fin (k + 1) => sel (q + a)) (by simp [hk])
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, b, h, by omega, he⟩
    · exact ⟨b, a, h, by omega, he.symm⟩
  choose a b hab hbk hsab using hpig
  obtain ⟨⟨p, a₀, b₀⟩, hfib⟩ := Finite.exists_infinite_fiber
    (fun q => (sel (q + a q), (⟨a q, by have := hab q; have := hbk q; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)),
      (⟨b q, by have := hbk q; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1))))
  have hinf := Set.infinite_coe_iff.mp hfib
  set g : ℕ := (b₀ : ℕ) - a₀ with hg
  have hmem : ∀ q, q ∈ (fun q => (sel (q + a q),
      (⟨a q, by have := hab q; have := hbk q; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)),
      (⟨b q, by have := hbk q; omega⟩ : Fin (k + 1)))) ⁻¹' {(p, a₀, b₀)} →
      sel (q + a q) = p ∧ a q = a₀ ∧ b q = b₀ := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq, Fin.ext_iff] at hq
    exact hq
  have hgood : ∀ Q : ℕ, ∃ q, Q ≤ q ∧ sel q = p ∧ sel (q + g) = p := by
    intro Q
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hQq⟩ := hinf.exists_gt Q
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hmem q hq
    refine ⟨q + a q, by omega, h1, ?_⟩
    have hab' := hab q
    rw [show q + a q + g = q + b q by rw [hg, ← h2, ← h3]; omega, ← hsab q]
    exact h1
  have hg0 : 0 < g := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hinf.nonempty
    obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := hmem q hq
    have := hab q
    rw [hg, ← h2, ← h3]; omega
                                                            
  obtain ⟨q₁, -, hq₁, -⟩ := hgood 0
  have hpne : ¬ Escapes (w p) f (z p) := hq₁ ▸ hselE q₁
  obtain ⟨-, horbB⟩ := hBdd p hpne
  obtain ⟨Bc, hBc1, hcoefc⟩ := exists_coef_bound (w p) f
  set B' := B p ⊔ Bc with hB'
  have hB'1 : 1 ≤ B' := le_sup_of_le_right hBc1
  have hcoef' : ∀ j < f.natDegree, w p (f.coeff j) ≤ B' :=
    fun j hj => (hcoefc j hj).trans le_sup_right
  have horb' : ∀ mm, w p (F^[mm] (z p)) ≤ B' := fun mm => (horbB mm).trans le_sup_left
  set L : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ) := (B' ^ f.natDegree) ^ g with hL
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := one_le_pow_of_one_le' (one_le_pow_of_one_le' hB'1 _) _
  have hL0 : L ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL1).ne'
  have hest : ∀ q, sel q = p → sel (q + g) = p →
      w p (F^[g] (z p) - z p) ≤ WithZero.exp (-(m (N + k + q) : ℤ)) * L := by
    intro q h1 h2
    have e1 := hselle q
    rw [h1] at e1
    have e2 := hselle (q + g)
    rw [h2] at e2
    have hdecomp : F^[g] (z p) - z p
        = (F^[g] (z p) - F^[g] (F^[N + k + q] (z p))) + P (N + k + (q + g)) p := by
      simp only [hP]
      rw [← Function.iterate_add_apply, show g + (N + k + q) = N + k + (q + g) by omega]; ring
    rw [hdecomp]
    refine (Valuation.map_add _ _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · have hlip := val_iterate_sub_iterate_le (w p) hf hB'1 hcoef' (x := z p)
        (y := F^[N + k + q] (z p)) horb'
        (fun mm => by rw [← Function.iterate_add_apply]; exact horb' _) g
      refine hlip.trans ?_
      rw [Valuation.map_sub_swap]
      exact mul_le_mul' e1 le_rfl
    · refine e2.trans ?_
      calc WithZero.exp (-(m (N + k + (q + g)) : ℤ))
          ≤ WithZero.exp (-(m (N + k + q) : ℤ)) := by
            rw [WithZero.exp_le_exp]
            have := hm_mono (show N + k + q ≤ N + k + (q + g) by omega)
            omega
        _ = WithZero.exp (-(m (N + k + q) : ℤ)) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hL1
  have hy0 : w p (F^[g] (z p) - z p) ≠ 0 := hwne g p hg0
  set t : ℤ := WithZero.log L - WithZero.log (w p (F^[g] (z p) - z p)) + 1 with ht
  obtain ⟨q, hq, h1, h2⟩ := hgood (k * t.toNat)
  have hmq : t.toNat ≤ m (N + k + q) := by
    simp only [hm]
    rw [Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hkpos]
    have h3 := Nat.lt_pow_self (n := N + k + q - n₀) (show 1 < d by omega)
    have h4 : t.toNat * k ≤ N + k + q - n₀ := by
      rw [mul_comm]; omega
    omega
  have hfin := hest q h1 h2
  rw [← WithZero.exp_log hL0, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← WithZero.log_le_iff_le_exp hy0] at hfin
  have h5 := Int.self_le_toNat t
  omega

name: IngramMello.zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot
statement: theorem zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) : IsPrimitiveRoot (zetaC P) P
proof:
:=
  Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp P hP.ne'

name: IngramMello.zetaC_mem_cycField
statement: theorem zetaC_mem_cycField (P : ℕ) : zetaC P ∈ cycField P
proof:
:=
  IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ (zetaC P)

name: IngramMello.zetaC_isIntegral
statement: theorem zetaC_isIntegral {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) : IsIntegral ℚ (zetaC P)
proof:
:=
  ((zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP).isIntegral hP).tower_top

name: IngramMello.zetaC_isIntegral_int
statement: theorem zetaC_isIntegral_int {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) : IsIntegral ℤ (zetaC P)
proof:
:=
  (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP).isIntegral hP

name: IngramMello.cycField_finrank
statement:
theorem cycField_finrank {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (cycField P) = Nat.totient P
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycField
  rw [IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (zetaC_isIntegral hP),
    ← cyclotomic_eq_minpoly_rat (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP) hP, natDegree_cyclotomic]

name: IngramMello.mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt
statement: theorem mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt {P : ℕ} {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt P) : β ∈ cycField P
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycInt at hβ
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (hx := hβ) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rw [hx]
    exact zetaC_mem_cycField P
  · intro r
    exact (cycField P).intCast_mem r
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact (cycField P).add_mem hx hy
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact (cycField P).mul_mem hx hy

name: IngramMello.isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt P) :
    IsIntegral ℤ β
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycInt at hβ
  have : Algebra.adjoin ℤ {zetaC P} ≤ integralClosure ℤ ℂ := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rw [hx]
    exact zetaC_isIntegral_int hP
  exact this hβ

name: IngramMello.zetaC_zpow_mem_cycInt
statement: theorem zetaC_zpow_mem_cycInt {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (k : ℤ) : zetaC P ^ k ∈ cycInt P
proof:
:= by
  have hζ := zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP
  have hne : zetaC P ≠ 0 := hζ.ne_zero hP.ne'
  have : zetaC P ^ k = zetaC P ^ (k % (P : ℤ)).toNat := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Int.emod_add_mul_ediv k P]
    rw [zpow_add₀ hne, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hζ.pow_eq_one, one_zpow, mul_one,
      ← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hP.ne'))]
  rw [this]
  exact Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)) _

name: IngramMello.zetaC_pow_mem_cycInt
statement: theorem zetaC_pow_mem_cycInt {P : ℕ} (k : ℕ) : zetaC P ^ k ∈ cycInt P
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)) _

name: IngramMello.zetaC_dvd
statement: theorem zetaC_dvd {P₁ P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (h : P₁ ∣ P) : zetaC P₁ = zetaC P ^ (P / P₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
  have hP₁ : 0 < P₁ := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_right hP
  have hm : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hP
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hP₁]
  unfold zetaC
  rw [← Complex.exp_nat_mul]
  congr 1
  have hm' : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm.ne'
  have hP₁' : (P₁ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hP₁.ne'
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: IngramMello.cycInt_mono
statement: theorem cycInt_mono {P₁ P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (h : P₁ ∣ P) : cycInt P₁ ≤ cycInt P
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycInt
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
  intro x hx
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
  rw [hx, zetaC_dvd hP h]
  exact Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)) _

name: IngramMello.cycField_mono
statement: theorem cycField_mono {P₁ P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (h : P₁ ∣ P) : cycField P₁ ≤ cycField P
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycField
  rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff, zetaC_dvd hP h]
  exact pow_mem (zetaC_mem_cycField P) _

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.zero_mem
statement: theorem SumRoots.zero_mem (k : ℕ) : (0 : ℂ) ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, Nat.zero_le _, fun i => i.elim0, by simp⟩

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.mono
statement: theorem SumRoots.mono {k l : ℕ} (h : k ≤ l) : SumRoots k ⊆ SumRoots l
proof:
:= by
  rintro β ⟨n, ξ, hn, hξ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨n, ξ, hn.trans h, hξ, rfl⟩

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.root_mem
statement: theorem SumRoots.root_mem {ρ : ℂ} (hρ : IsRootOfUnityC ρ) : ρ ∈ SumRoots 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, fun _ => ρ, le_rfl, fun _ => hρ, by simp⟩

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.add
statement:
theorem SumRoots.add {k l : ℕ} {β γ : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ SumRoots k) (hγ : γ ∈ SumRoots l) :
    β + γ ∈ SumRoots (k + l)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ξ, hn, hξ, rfl⟩ := hβ
  obtain ⟨m, η, hm, hη, rfl⟩ := hγ
  refine ⟨n + m, Fin.append ξ η, Nat.add_le_add hn hm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Fin.append_left]; exact hξ j
    · rw [Fin.append_right]; exact hη j
  · rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp [Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.mul_root
statement:
theorem SumRoots.mul_root {k : ℕ} {ρ β : ℂ} (hρ : IsRootOfUnityC ρ) (hβ : β ∈ SumRoots k) :
    ρ * β ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ξ, hn, hξ, rfl⟩ := hβ
  exact ⟨n, fun i => ρ * ξ i, hn, fun i => hρ.mul (hξ i), by rw [Finset.mul_sum]⟩

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.neg
statement: theorem SumRoots.neg {k : ℕ} {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ SumRoots k) : -β ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsRootOfUnityC (-1 : ℂ) := ⟨2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  simpa using SumRoots.mul_root h hβ

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.sum
statement:
theorem SumRoots.sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ) (k : ι → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∈ SumRoots (k i)) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ∈ SumRoots (∑ i ∈ s, k i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using SumRoots.zero_mem 0
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact SumRoots.add (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s))
      (ih fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.natCast
statement: theorem SumRoots.natCast {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ k) : ((n : ℕ) : ℂ) ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, fun _ => 1, hn, fun _ => ⟨1, one_pos, one_pow 1⟩, by simp⟩

name: IngramMello.SumRoots.intCast
statement: theorem SumRoots.intCast {k : ℕ} (m : ℤ) (hm : m.natAbs ≤ k) : ((m : ℤ) : ℂ) ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq m with h | h
  · rw [h, Int.cast_natCast]; exact SumRoots.natCast m.natAbs hm
  · rw [h, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]
    exact SumRoots.neg (SumRoots.natCast m.natAbs hm)

name: IngramMello.norm_zetaC
statement: theorem norm_zetaC (P : ℕ) : ‖zetaC P‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos P with rfl | hP
  · simp [zetaC]
  · exact (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP).norm'_eq_one hP.ne'

name: IngramMello.conjQ_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem conjQ_apply (z : ℂ) : conjQ z = starRingEnd ℂ z
proof: := rfl

name: IngramMello.conj_mem_cycField
statement:
theorem conj_mem_cycField {P : ℕ} {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycField P) :
    starRingEnd ℂ β ∈ cycField P
proof:
:= by
  have h : cycField P ≤ (cycField P).comap conjQ := by
    unfold cycField
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff]
    change conjQ (zetaC P) ∈ cycField P
    rw [conjQ_apply, ← Complex.inv_eq_conj (norm_zetaC P)]
    exact inv_mem (zetaC_mem_cycField P)
  exact h hβ

name: IngramMello.coe_conjF
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_conjF {P : ℕ} (x : cycField P) : (conjF P x : ℂ) = starRingEnd ℂ x
proof: := rfl

name: IngramMello.algHom_conjF
statement:
theorem algHom_conjF {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) (x : cycField P) :
    σ (conjF P x) = starRingEnd ℂ (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : σ.comp (conjF P) = conjQ.comp σ := by
    apply (IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis (zetaC_isIntegral hP)).algHom_ext
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis_gen]
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, conjQ_apply]
    have hgen : (conjF P (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P))) =
        (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P))⁻¹ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [coe_conjF, IntermediateField.coe_inv, IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.coe_gen,
        Complex.inv_eq_conj (norm_zetaC P)]
    rw [hgen, map_inv₀]
    apply Complex.inv_eq_conj
    have h1 : (σ (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P))) ^ P = 1 := by
      rw [← map_pow]
      have : (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P)) ^ P = 1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [(zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP).pow_eq_one]
      rw [this, map_one]
    have h2 : ‖σ (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P))‖ ^ P = 1 := by
      rw [← norm_pow, h1, norm_one]
    exact (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hP.ne').1 h2
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) key

name: IngramMello.cassM_of_mem
statement:
theorem cassM_of_mem {P : ℕ} {β : ℂ} (h : β ∈ cycField P) :
    cassM P β = (∑ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ ⟨β, h⟩‖ ^ 2) / Nat.totient P
proof:
:= by
  simp [cassM, h]

name: IngramMello.cassM_nonneg
statement: theorem cassM_nonneg (P : ℕ) (β : ℂ) : 0 ≤ cassM P β
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : β ∈ cycField P
  · rw [cassM_of_mem h]
    exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => by positivity) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  · simp [cassM, h]

name: IngramMello.cassM_zero
statement: theorem cassM_zero (P : ℕ) : cassM P 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassM_of_mem (zero_mem _)]
  have : (⟨0, zero_mem _⟩ : cycField P) = 0 := rfl
  simp [this]

name: IngramMello.cassM_neg
statement: theorem cassM_neg (P : ℕ) (β : ℂ) : cassM P (-β) = cassM P β
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : β ∈ cycField P
  · rw [cassM_of_mem h, cassM_of_mem (neg_mem h)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    have : (⟨-β, neg_mem h⟩ : cycField P) = -⟨β, h⟩ := rfl
    rw [this, map_neg, norm_neg]
  · have h' : -β ∉ cycField P := fun h' => h (by simpa using neg_mem h')
    simp [cassM, h, h']

name: IngramMello.cassM_le_sq_of_houseLE
statement:
theorem cassM_le_sq_of_houseLE {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycField P) {B : ℝ}
    (h : HouseLE β B) : cassM P β ≤ B ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassM_of_mem hβ]
  have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient P := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hP
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hφ]
  have hemb : ∀ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ ⟨β, hβ⟩‖ ≤ B :=
    (houseLE_iff_embeddings (cycField P).val ⟨β, hβ⟩ B).1 (by simpa using h)
  calc (∑ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ ⟨β, hβ⟩‖ ^ 2)
      ≤ ∑ _σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, B ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hemb σ) 2
    _ = B ^ 2 * Nat.totient P := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, AlgHom.card, cycField_finrank hP,
          nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: IngramMello.one_le_cassM
statement:
theorem one_le_cassM {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycField P)
    (hint : IsIntegral ℤ β) (hne : β ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ cassM P β
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassM_of_mem hβ]
  set x : cycField P := ⟨β, hβ⟩ with hx
  have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient P := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hP
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) : ℝ) = Nat.totient P := by
    rw [AlgHom.card, cycField_finrank hP]
  have hxint : IsIntegral ℤ x :=
    (isIntegral_algHom_iff ((cycField P).val.restrictScalars ℤ) Subtype.val_injective).1 hint
  have hnint : IsIntegral ℤ (Algebra.norm ℚ x) := Algebra.isIntegral_norm ℚ hxint
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1 hnint
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hyne : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hxne (by simpa using hy.symm)
  have hprod : ∏ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ^ 2 = ((y : ℤ) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.prod_pow, ← norm_prod, ← Algebra.norm_eq_prod_embeddings ℚ ℂ x, ← hy]
    simp
  have hprod1 : 1 ≤ ∏ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hprod]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(y : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hyne
    nlinarith [sq_abs (y : ℝ)]
  have hw : ∑ _σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, 1 / (Nat.totient P : ℝ) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, hcard]
    field_simp
  have hamgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted Finset.univ
    (fun _ => 1 / (Nat.totient P : ℝ)) (fun σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ => ‖σ x‖ ^ 2)
    (fun _ _ => by positivity) hw (fun _ _ => by positivity)
  rw [Real.finsetProd_rpow _ _ (fun _ _ => by positivity)] at hamgm
  have hge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (∏ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ^ 2) ^ (1 / (Nat.totient P : ℝ)) :=
    Real.one_le_rpow hprod1 (by positivity)
  calc (1 : ℝ) ≤ _ := hge
    _ ≤ ∑ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, 1 / (Nat.totient P : ℝ) * ‖σ x‖ ^ 2 := hamgm
    _ = (∑ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ^ 2) / Nat.totient P := by
        rw [← Finset.mul_sum]; ring

name: IngramMello.trace_mul_conjF
statement:
theorem trace_mul_conjF {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (x : cycField P) :
    algebraMap ℚ ℂ (Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P) (x * conjF P x)) =
      ((∑ σ : cycField P →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_eq_sum_embeddings ℂ]
  push_cast
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [map_mul, algHom_conjF hP, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  push_cast
  ring

name: IngramMello.cassM_eq_trace
statement:
theorem cassM_eq_trace {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycField P) :
    cassM P β =
      ((Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P) (⟨β, hβ⟩ * conjF P ⟨β, hβ⟩) : ℚ) : ℝ) / Nat.totient P
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassM_of_mem hβ]
  congr 1
  have h := trace_mul_conjF hP ⟨β, hβ⟩
  rw [eq_ratCast, ← Complex.ofReal_ratCast] at h
  exact (Complex.ofReal_injective h).symm

name: IngramMello.cassM_intCast
statement: theorem cassM_intCast {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) (m : ℤ) : cassM P (m : ℂ) = (m : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (m : ℂ) ∈ cycField P := intCast_mem _ m
  rw [cassM_of_mem hm]
  have hφ : (Nat.totient P : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP).ne'
  have hx : (⟨(m : ℂ), hm⟩ : cycField P) = (m : cycField P) := Subtype.ext (by simp)
  rw [hx]
  simp only [map_intCast, Complex.norm_intCast, sq_abs, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    AlgHom.card, cycField_finrank hP, nsmul_eq_mul]
  field_simp

name: IngramMello.zetaC_one
statement: theorem zetaC_one : zetaC 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [zetaC, Complex.exp_two_pi_mul_I]

name: IngramMello.mem_cycInt_one_iff
statement: theorem mem_cycInt_one_iff {β : ℂ} : β ∈ cycInt 1 ↔ ∃ m : ℤ, β = m
proof:
:= by
  unfold cycInt
  rw [zetaC_one, Algebra.adjoin_singleton_one, Algebra.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩; exact ⟨m, by simp⟩

name: IngramMello.exists_mem_sumRoots_of_mem_cycInt_one
statement:
theorem exists_mem_sumRoots_of_mem_cycInt_one {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt 1) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) ≤ cassM 1 β ∧ β ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := mem_cycInt_one_iff.1 hβ
  refine ⟨m.natAbs, ?_, SumRoots.intCast m le_rfl⟩
  rw [cassM_intCast one_pos]
  have h1 : ((m.natAbs : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(m : ℝ)| := by rw [Nat.cast_natAbs, Int.cast_abs]
  rw [h1]
  have : (|(m : ℝ)|) ^ 2 = (m : ℝ) ^ 2 := sq_abs _
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with rfl | hm
  · simp
  · have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hm
    nlinarith

name: IngramMello.resultant_monic_of_le
statement:
theorem resultant_monic_of_le {A g : R[X]} (hA : A.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : g.natDegree ≤ n) :
    resultant A g A.natDegree n = resM A g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [resultant_add_right_deg _ _ _ _ k le_rfl, hA.coeff_natDegree, one_pow, one_mul]
  rfl

name: IngramMello.resM_mul
statement:
theorem resM_mul {A : R[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (g h : R[X]) :
    resM A (g * h) = resM A g * resM A h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← resultant_monic_of_le hA (natDegree_mul_le (p := g) (q := h)),
    resultant_mul_right _ _ _ _ le_rfl]
  rfl

name: IngramMello.resM_map
statement:
theorem resM_map {A : R[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (φ : R →+* S) [Nontrivial S] (g : R[X]) :
    φ (resM A g) = resM (A.map φ) (g.map φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [resM, ← resultant_map_map, ← hA.natDegree_map φ,
    resultant_monic_of_le (hA.map φ) (natDegree_map_le)]

name: IngramMello.resM_eq_prod_roots
statement:
theorem resM_eq_prod_roots {K : Type*} [Field K] {A : K[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (hs : A.Splits)
    (g : K[X]) : resM A g = (A.roots.map g.eval).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [resM, resultant_eq_prod_eval _ _ _ le_rfl hs, hA.leadingCoeff, one_pow, one_mul]

name: IngramMello.resM_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem resM_map_eq_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {A : R[X]} (hA : A.Monic)
    (φ : R →+* K) (g : R[X]) {c : K} (hc : (A.map φ).IsRoot c) (hg : (g.map φ).eval c = 0) :
    φ (resM A g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [resM_map hA, resM_eq_prod_roots (hA.map φ) (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
  refine Multiset.prod_eq_zero (Multiset.mem_map.2 ⟨c, ?_, hg⟩)
  exact (mem_roots (hA.map φ).ne_zero).2 hc

name: IngramMello.resM_ne_zero
statement:
theorem resM_ne_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {A : R[X]} (hA : A.Monic)
    (φ : R →+* K) (g : R[X])
    (hg : ∀ c : K, (A.map φ).IsRoot c → (g.map φ).eval c ≠ 0) : resM A g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 := resM_map hA φ g
  rw [h0, map_zero, resM_eq_prod_roots (hA.map φ) (IsAlgClosed.splits _)] at h1
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 (Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff.1 h1.symm)
  exact hg y ((mem_roots (hA.map φ).ne_zero).1 hy) hy0

name: IngramMello.comp_sub_comp
statement: theorem comp_sub_comp (G a b : R[X]) : G.comp a - G.comp b = (a - b) * divDiff G a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_eq_sum_left, comp_eq_sum_left, divDiff, Polynomial.sum, Polynomial.sum,
    Polynomial.sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [← mul_sub, ← (Commute.all a b).geom_sum₂_mul]
  ring

name: IngramMello.divDiff_eval₂
statement:
theorem divDiff_eval₂ {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (φ : R →+* K) (G a b : R[X]) (c : K)
    (ha : a.eval₂ φ c = c) (hb : b.eval₂ φ c = c) :
    (divDiff G a b).eval₂ φ c = (G.map φ).derivative.eval c
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivative_map, eval_map, derivative_apply, divDiff, Polynomial.sum, Polynomial.sum,
    eval₂_finsetSum, eval₂_finsetSum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [eval₂_mul, eval₂_C, eval₂_finsetSum, eval₂_pow, ha, hb, eval₂_X, geom_sum₂_self,
    eval₂_natCast, map_mul, map_natCast]
  ring

name: IngramMello.P_add
statement: theorem P_add (f : R[X]) (m n : ℕ) : P f (m + n) = (P f m).comp (P f n)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [P]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [P] at ih ⊢
    rw [Nat.succ_add, Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih,
      comp_assoc]

name: IngramMello.P_mul
statement: theorem P_mul (f : R[X]) (q n : ℕ) : P f (q * n) = (P f q).comp^[n] X
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [P]
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, add_comm, P_add, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: IngramMello.eval_P
statement:
theorem eval_P (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) (c : R) :
    (P f n).eval c = (fun z => f.eval z)^[n] c
proof:
:= by
  simp [P]

name: IngramMello.map_P
statement: theorem map_P (φ : R →+* S) (f : R[X]) (n : ℕ) : (P f n).map φ = P (f.map φ) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [P]
  | succ n ih => rw [P, Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← P, map_comp, ih, P, P,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']

name: IngramMello.derivative_P_eval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem derivative_P_eval_eq_zero (f : R[X]) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {c : R}
    (hc : f.derivative.eval c = 0) : (P f n).derivative.eval c = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
  rw [add_comm, P_add, show P f 1 = f by simp [P], derivative_comp,
    eval_mul, hc, zero_mul]

name: IngramMello.W_succ
statement:
theorem W_succ {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X]) (q n : ℕ) :
    W A f (q * (n + 2)) (q * (n + 1)) = W A f (q * (n + 1)) (q * n) * Q A f q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [W, W, Q, ← resM_mul hA, ← comp_sub_comp, P_mul, P_mul, P_mul,
    Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply' (f := (P f q).comp)]

name: IngramMello.W_mem_ker_pow
statement:
theorem W_mem_ker_pow {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X]) (ev : R₀ →+* K) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q) {c₀ : K} (hA₀ : (A.map ev).IsRoot c₀)
    (hcrit : (f.map ev).derivative.eval c₀ = 0)
    (hper : (fun z => (f.map ev).eval z)^[q] c₀ = c₀) (l : ℕ) :
    W A f (q * (l + 1)) (q * l) ∈ RingHom.ker ev ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : ∀ n, (P f (q * n)).eval₂ ev c₀ = c₀ := fun n => by
    rw [eval₂_eq_eval_map, map_P, eval_P, Function.iterate_mul, Function.iterate_fixed hper]
  induction l with
  | zero =>
    have h1 := hfix 1
    have h0 := hfix 0
    rw [mul_one] at h1
    rw [mul_zero] at h0
    simp only [zero_add, pow_one, mul_one, mul_zero, RingHom.mem_ker, W]
    refine resM_map_eq_zero hA ev _ hA₀ ?_
    rw [eval_map, eval₂_sub, h1, h0, sub_self]
  | succ l ih =>
    rw [show l + 1 + 1 = l + 2 by ring, W_succ hA, pow_succ]
    refine Ideal.mul_mem_mul ih ?_
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Q]
    refine resM_map_eq_zero hA ev _ hA₀ ?_
    rw [eval_map, divDiff_eval₂ ev _ _ _ _ (hfix _) (hfix _), map_P]
    exact derivative_P_eval_eq_zero _ hq hcrit

name: IngramMello.W_ne_zero
statement:
theorem W_ne_zero {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X]) (ι : R₀ →+* K) (l j : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ c : K, (A.map ι).IsRoot c →
      (fun z => (f.map ι).eval z)^[l] c ≠ (fun z => (f.map ι).eval z)^[j] c) :
    W A f l j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine resM_ne_zero hA ι _ fun c hc => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, eval_sub, map_P, map_P, eval_P, eval_P, sub_ne_zero]
  exact h c hc

name: IngramMello.ev_W
statement:
theorem ev_W {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X]) (ev : R₀ →+* K) (l j : ℕ) :
    ev (W A f l j) = ((A.map ev).roots.map fun c =>
      (fun z => (f.map ev).eval z)^[l] c - (fun z => (f.map ev).eval z)^[j] c).prod
proof:
:= by
  rw [W, resM_map hA, resM_eq_prod_roots (hA.map ev) (IsAlgClosed.splits _)]
  congr 1
  refine Multiset.map_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, eval_sub, map_P, map_P, eval_P, eval_P]

name: IngramMello.map_W_mem_maxIdeal_pow
statement:
theorem map_W_mem_maxIdeal_pow {r : ℕ} {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X])
    (ι : R₀ →+* MvLaurent r) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) {c₀ : ℂ}
    (hA₀ : (A.map (((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ)).comp ι)).IsRoot c₀)
    (hcrit : (f.map ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).derivative.eval c₀ = 0)
    (hper : (fun z => (f.map ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).eval z)^[q] c₀
      = c₀) (l : ℕ) :
    ι (W A f (q * (l + 1)) (q * l)) ∈ MvLaurent.maxIdeal x ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem ι (W_mem_ker_pow hA f _ hq hA₀ hcrit hper l)
  rw [Ideal.map_pow] at h
  refine Ideal.pow_right_mono ?_ _ h
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro y hy
  simpa [MvLaurent.maxIdeal, RingHom.mem_ker] using hy

name: IngramMello.isIntegrallyClosed_laurentPolynomial
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_laurentPolynomial (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R] : IsIntegrallyClosed (LaurentPolynomial R)
proof:
:=
  isIntegrallyClosed_of_isLocalization (R := Polynomial R) _ (Submonoid.powers Polynomial.X)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors Polynomial.X_ne_zero)

name: IngramMello.isIntegrallyClosed_mvLaurent
statement:
theorem isIntegrallyClosed_mvLaurent (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R] : ∀ r : ℕ, IsIntegrallyClosed (AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin r → ℤ))
proof:
| 0 => by
    refine IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (RingEquiv.ofBijective
      (algebraMap R (AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin 0 → ℤ))) ⟨?_, fun x => ⟨x.coeff 0, ?_⟩⟩)
    · intro a b h
      have := congrArg (fun y : AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin 0 → ℤ) => y.coeff 0) h
      simpa using this
    · refine AddMonoidAlgebra.ext (Finsupp.ext fun m => ?_)
      rw [Subsingleton.elim m 0]
      simp
  | r + 1 => by
    have := isIntegrallyClosed_mvLaurent R r
    have : IsIntegrallyClosed (AddMonoidAlgebra (AddMonoidAlgebra R (Fin r → ℤ)) ℤ) :=
      isIntegrallyClosed_laurentPolynomial _
    let e : (ℤ × (Fin r → ℤ)) ≃+ (Fin (r + 1) → ℤ) :=
      (Fin.consLinearEquiv ℤ (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => ℤ)).toAddEquiv
    exact IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv
      (curryRingEquiv.symm.trans (domCongr R R e).toRingEquiv)

name: IngramMello.finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq
statement:
theorem finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq {α : Type*} (F : α → α) {c : α} {l j : ℕ} (hlj : l ≠ j)
    (h : F^[l] c = F^[j] c) : (Set.range fun n => F^[n] c).Finite
proof:
:= by
  wlog hjl : j < l generalizing l j
  · exact this hlj.symm h.symm (lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hjl) hlj)
  classical
  refine ((Finset.range l).image fun n => F^[n] c).finite_toSet.subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases hn : n < l
    · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨n, Finset.mem_range.2 hn, rfl⟩)
    · have : F^[n] c = F^[n - l + j] c := by
        rw [Function.iterate_add_apply, ← h, ← Function.iterate_add_apply,
          Nat.sub_add_cancel (not_lt.1 hn)]
      change F^[n] c ∈ _
      rw [this]
      exact ih _ (by omega)

name: IngramMello.exists_iterate_eq_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_iterate_eq_of_finite {α : Type*} (F : α → α) (S : Finset α)
    (hS : ∀ c ∈ S, (Set.range fun n => F^[n] c).Finite) :
    ∃ n m : ℕ, n ≠ m ∧ ∀ c ∈ S, F^[n] c = F^[m] c
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : (Set.pi Set.univ fun c : S => Set.range fun n => F^[n] (c : α)).Finite :=
    Set.Finite.pi fun c => hS c c.2
  obtain ⟨n, -, m, -, hnm, h⟩ := Set.infinite_univ.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo
    (f := fun n : ℕ => fun c : S => F^[n] (c : α))
    (fun n _ => Set.mem_univ_pi.2 fun c => Set.mem_range_self n) hfin
  exact ⟨n, m, hnm, fun c hc => congrFun h ⟨c, hc⟩⟩

name: IngramMello.multiset_prod_dvd_pow
statement:
theorem multiset_prod_dvd_pow {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (s : Multiset M) (a : M)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∣ a) : s.prod ∣ a ^ Multiset.card s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons x s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.card_cons, pow_succ']
    exact mul_dvd_mul (h x (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _))
      (ih fun y hy => h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy))

name: IngramMello.isCoprime_multiset_prod_left
statement:
theorem isCoprime_multiset_prod_left {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (s : Multiset R) (h : R)
    (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, IsCoprime p h) : IsCoprime s.prod h
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact isCoprime_one_left
  | cons x s ih =>
    rw [Multiset.prod_cons]
    exact (hs x (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)).mul_left
      (ih fun y hy => hs y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy))

name: IngramMello.exists_coprime_split
statement:
theorem exists_coprime_split {K : Type*} [Field K] (g h : K[X]) (hg : g.Monic) :
    ∃ A B : K[X], A.Monic ∧ B.Monic ∧ g = A * B ∧ IsCoprime A h ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, B ∣ h ^ N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmon : ∀ p ∈ normalizedFactors g, p.Monic := fun p hp => by
    rw [← normalize_normalized_factor p hp]
    exact monic_normalize (ne_zero_of_mem_normalizedFactors hp)
  let s := normalizedFactors g
  refine ⟨(s.filter fun p => IsCoprime p h).prod, (s.filter fun p => ¬ IsCoprime p h).prod,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ id fun p hp =>
      hmon p (Multiset.mem_of_mem_filter hp)
  · simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ id fun p hp =>
      hmon p (Multiset.mem_of_mem_filter hp)
  · rw [Multiset.prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not]
    refine (eq_of_monic_of_associated ?_ hg (prod_normalizedFactors hg.ne_zero)).symm
    simpa using monic_multiset_prod_of_monic _ id hmon
  · exact isCoprime_multiset_prod_left _ _ fun p hp => (Multiset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
  · refine ⟨_, multiset_prod_dvd_pow _ _ fun p hp => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hp, hc⟩ := Multiset.mem_filter.1 hp
    exact not_not.1 fun hd => hc ((irreducible_of_normalized_factor p hp).coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 hd)

name: IngramMello.exists_infiniteOrbitFactor
statement:
theorem exists_infiniteOrbitFactor (f g : R₀[X]) (hg : g.Monic) :
    ∃ (A B : R₀[X]) (n m N : ℕ), A.Monic ∧ B.Monic ∧ g = A * B ∧ n ≠ m ∧
      B ∣ (P f n - P f m) ^ N ∧
      ∀ c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀),
        (A.map ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) _).comp (algebraMap R₀ _))).IsRoot c →
        ¬ (Set.range fun k => (fun z => (f.map ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) _).comp
          (algebraMap R₀ _))).eval z)^[k] c).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F0 := FractionRing R₀
  set L := AlgebraicClosure F0
  set ι : R₀ →+* L := (algebraMap F0 L).comp (algebraMap R₀ F0)
  set Fι := fun z => (f.map ι).eval z
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R₀ F0) := IsFractionRing.injective R₀ F0
  obtain ⟨n, m, hnm, hS⟩ := exists_iterate_eq_of_finite Fι
    ((g.map ι).roots.toFinset.filter fun c => (Set.range fun k => Fι^[k] c).Finite)
    fun c hc => (Finset.mem_filter.1 hc).2
  set h := P f n - P f m
  obtain ⟨A0, B0, hA0, hB0, hgAB, hcop, N, hBN⟩ :=
    exists_coprime_split (g.map (algebraMap R₀ F0)) (h.map (algebraMap R₀ F0)) (hg.map _)
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.eq_map_mul_C_of_dvd F0 hg (Dvd.intro B0 hgAB.symm)
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.eq_map_mul_C_of_dvd F0 hg (Dvd.intro_left A0 hgAB.symm)
  rw [hA0.leadingCoeff, C_1, mul_one] at hA
  rw [hB0.leadingCoeff, C_1, mul_one] at hB
  have hAm : A.Monic := by
    rw [Monic, ← hinj.eq_iff, ← leadingCoeff_map_of_injective hinj, hA, hA0.leadingCoeff,
      map_one]
  have hBm : B.Monic := by
    rw [Monic, ← hinj.eq_iff, ← leadingCoeff_map_of_injective hinj, hB, hB0.leadingCoeff,
      map_one]
  have hgAB' : g = A * B := map_injective _ hinj (by rw [Polynomial.map_mul, hA, hB, hgAB])
  refine ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, hBm, hgAB', hnm, ?_, fun c hc hfin => ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_dvd_map _ hinj hBm, Polynomial.map_pow, hB]
    exact hBN
  · 
    have hAι : A.map ι = A0.map (algebraMap F0 L) := by rw [← hA, map_map]
    have hhι : h.map ι = (h.map (algebraMap R₀ F0)).map (algebraMap F0 L) := by rw [map_map]
    obtain ⟨u, v, huv⟩ := hcop.map (mapRingHom (algebraMap F0 L))
    have h1 := congrArg (eval c) huv
    simp only [coe_mapRingHom, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_one, ← hAι, hc.eq_zero, mul_zero,
      zero_add, ← hhι] at h1
    
    have hcg : c ∈ (g.map ι).roots := by
      rw [mem_roots (hg.map ι).ne_zero, IsRoot, hgAB', Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul,
        hc.eq_zero, zero_mul]
    have := hS c (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hcg, hfin⟩)
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, eval_sub, map_P, map_P, eval_P, eval_P, this, sub_self,
      mul_zero] at h1
    exact zero_ne_one h1

name: IngramMello.isRoot_of_iterate_ne
proof:
:= by
  rw [hgAB, Polynomial.map_mul, IsRoot, eval_mul] at hc
  refine (mul_eq_zero.1 hc).resolve_right fun hBc => hnm ?_
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hB
  have := congrArg (fun p => (p.map ψ).eval c) hk
  simp only [Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_pow, eval_mul, hBc, zero_mul,
    Polynomial.map_sub, eval_sub, map_P, eval_P] at this
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff'.1 this).1

name: IngramMello.dvd_pow_of_roots
statement:
theorem dvd_pow_of_roots {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {p q : K[X]} (hp : p.Monic)
    (h : ∀ c, p.IsRoot c → q.IsRoot c) : p ∣ q ^ p.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  rw [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).natDegree_eq_card_roots, ← Multiset.card_map (fun a => X - C a)]
  nth_rw 1 [(IsAlgClosed.splits p).eq_prod_roots_of_monic hp]
  refine multiset_prod_dvd_pow _ _ fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hx
  exact dvd_iff_isRoot.2 (h a (isRoot_of_mem_roots ha))

name: IngramMello.isRoot_A_of_superAttracting
statement:
theorem isRoot_A_of_superAttracting {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀] {f g A B : R₀[X]}
    {n m N : ℕ} (hnm : n ≠ m) (hgAB : g = A * B) (hB : B ∣ (P f n - P f m) ^ N)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hfg : derivative f = C (d : R₀) * g)
    (ψ : R₀ →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ) (Pp : (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)[X]) (hPm : Pp.Monic)
    (hroots : ∀ c : GenericField, aeval c Pp = 0 →
      aeval c (derivative (f.map ψ)) = 0 ∧ ¬ HasFiniteOrbit (f.map ψ) c)
    (t₀ : ℂˣ) {c₀ : ℂ}
    (hc₀ : (Pp.map (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀)).IsRoot c₀) :
    (A.map ((LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀).comp ψ)).IsRoot c₀
proof:
:= by
  have hj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) GenericField) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
      (FractionRing (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)) GenericField]
    exact (algebraMap (FractionRing (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)) GenericField).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)
  set j := algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) GenericField
  have : CharZero GenericField :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom (j.comp LaurentPolynomial.C).injective
  have hF : (fun w : GenericField => aeval w (f.map ψ)) =
      fun z => (f.map (j.comp ψ)).eval z := by
    funext w; rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, map_map]
  have key : ∀ c, (Pp.map j).IsRoot c → ((A.map ψ).map j).IsRoot c := by
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨hcrit, horb⟩ := hroots c (by rwa [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map])
    rw [map_map]
    refine isRoot_of_iterate_ne hgAB hB (j.comp ψ) ?_ fun heq => horb ?_
    · rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, derivative_map, map_map, hfg,
        Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, map_C, eval_C, map_natCast] at hcrit
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hcrit).resolve_left (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hd)
    · unfold HasFiniteOrbit
      rw [hF]
      exact finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq _ hnm heq
  have h1 := dvd_pow_of_roots (hPm.map j) key
  rw [← Polynomial.map_pow, map_dvd_map j hj hPm] at h1
  have h2 := Polynomial.map_dvd (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀) h1
  rw [Polynomial.map_pow, map_map] at h2
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h2
  have := congrArg (eval c₀) hk
  rw [eval_mul, hc₀.eq_zero, zero_mul, eval_pow] at this
  exact pow_eq_zero_iff'.1 this |>.1

name: IngramMello.map_monicCentred
statement:
theorem map_monicCentred {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (d : ℕ)
    (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) : (monicCentred d a).map φ = monicCentred d (fun i => φ (a i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [monicCentred, Polynomial.map_sum]

name: IngramMello.exists_derivative_monicCentred
statement:
theorem exists_derivative_monicCentred {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℚ R] [Nontrivial R]
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    ∃ g : R[X], g.Monic ∧ g.natDegree = d - 1 ∧ derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : R) * g
proof:
:= by
  set S := ∑ i : Fin (d - 1), C (a i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)
  set e : R := algebraMap ℚ R (d : ℚ)⁻¹
  have hde : (d : R) * e = 1 := by
    rw [← map_natCast (algebraMap ℚ R), ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast
      (show d ≠ 0 by omega)), map_one]
  have hS : S.natDegree ≤ d - 2 := by
    refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ => ?_
    exact (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (by omega)
  have hdeg : (C e * derivative S).degree < ((d - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ) := by
    have h1 : (C e * derivative S).natDegree < d - 1 := by
      have := (natDegree_C_mul_le e (derivative S)).trans (natDegree_derivative_le S)
      omega
    exact (degree_le_natDegree).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast h1)
  refine ⟨X ^ (d - 1) + C e * derivative S, monic_X_pow_add hdeg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [natDegree_add_eq_left_of_degree_lt (by rwa [degree_X_pow]), natDegree_X_pow]
  · rw [monicCentred, derivative_add, derivative_X_pow, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul, hde,
      C_1, one_mul]

name: IngramMello.aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀] [IsDomain R₀] (p : R₀[X])
    (c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀)) :
    aeval c p = (p.map ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
      (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀)))).eval c
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))]

name: IngramMello.hasFiniteOrbit_iff_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem hasFiniteOrbit_iff_algebraicClosure {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀] [IsDomain R₀] (f : R₀[X])
    (c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀)) :
    HasFiniteOrbit f c ↔ (Set.range fun k => (fun z => (f.map
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
        (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀)))).eval z)^[k] c).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun w : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀) => aeval w f) = fun z => (f.map
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
        (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀)))).eval z :=
    funext fun w => aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure f w
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit
  rw [h]

name: IngramMello.exists_infiniteOrbitFactor_monicCentred
statement:
theorem exists_infiniteOrbitFactor_monicCentred {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀] [IsDomain R₀]
    [IsIntegrallyClosed R₀] [Algebra ℚ R₀] {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R₀) :
    ∃ (A B : R₀[X]) (n m N : ℕ), A.Monic ∧ B.Monic ∧
      derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : R₀) * (A * B) ∧ n ≠ m ∧
      B ∣ (P (monicCentred d a) n - P (monicCentred d a) m) ^ N ∧
      ∀ c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀), aeval c A = 0 ↔
        (aeval c (derivative (monicCentred d a)) = 0 ∧
          ¬ HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, -, hfg⟩ := exists_derivative_monicCentred hd a
  set f := monicCentred d a
  obtain ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, hBm, hgAB, hnm, hBN, hinf⟩ := exists_infiniteOrbitFactor f g hgm
  refine ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, hBm, by rw [hfg, hgAB], hnm, hBN, fun c => ?_⟩
  have : CharZero (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀)) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom
      ((algebraMap R₀ (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp (algebraMap ℚ R₀)).injective
  have hd0 : (d : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀)) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (by omega)
  rw [aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure, aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure,
    hasFiniteOrbit_iff_algebraicClosure]
  set ι' : R₀ →+* AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀) :=
    (algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
      (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀))
  have hdg : ((derivative f).map ι').eval c = (d : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀)) *
      (g.map ι').eval c := by
    rw [hfg, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, map_C, eval_C, map_natCast]
  constructor
  · intro hA
    refine ⟨?_, hinf c hA⟩
    rw [hdg, hgAB, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, hA, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · rintro ⟨hc, horb⟩
    rw [hdg] at hc
    have hcg : (g.map ι').IsRoot c := (mul_eq_zero.1 hc).resolve_left hd0
    exact isRoot_of_iterate_ne hgAB hBN ι' hcg fun heq =>
      horb (finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq _ hnm heq)

name: IngramMello.exists_superAttracting_root
statement:
theorem exists_superAttracting_root (hSA : SuperAttracting) {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀]
    {r : ℕ} (ι : R₀ →+* MvLaurent r) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R₀)
    (hnc : ∃ i, MvLaurent.NonConst (ι (a i))) {g A B : R₀[X]} {n m N : ℕ} (hnm : n ≠ m)
    (hgAB : g = A * B) (hBN : B ∣ (P (monicCentred d a) n - P (monicCentred d a) m) ^ N)
    (hfg : derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : R₀) * g) :
    ∃ (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (c₀ : ℂ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q ∧
      (A.map ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).IsRoot c₀ ∧
      ((monicCentred d a).map
        ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).derivative.eval c₀ = 0 ∧
      (fun z => ((monicCentred d a).map
        ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).eval z)^[q] c₀ = c₀
proof:
:= by
  set f := monicCentred d a
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := MvLaurent.exists_curve_not_const (fun i => ι (a i))
  set ψ : R₀ →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ := (MvLaurent.curve β : MvLaurent r →+* _).comp ι
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hnc
  obtain ⟨Pp, hPm, hroots, t₀, c₀, q, hq, hc₀, hper⟩ :=
    hSA d hd (fun i => ψ (a i)) ⟨i, hβ i hi⟩
  have hfψ : f.map ψ = monicCentred d (fun i => ψ (a i)) := map_monicCentred ψ d a
  rw [← hfψ] at hroots hper
  have hroot := isRoot_A_of_superAttracting hnm hgAB hBN (by omega : d ≠ 0) hfg ψ Pp hPm
    hroots t₀ hc₀
  set x : Fin r → ℂˣ := fun j => t₀ ^ β j
  have hev : (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀).comp ψ =
      (MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι :=
    RingHom.ext fun y => MvLaurent.eval₂_curve β t₀ (ι y)
  rw [hev] at hroot
  rw [map_map, hev] at hper
  refine ⟨x, c₀, q, hq, hroot, ?_, hper⟩
  have hdvd : A ∣ derivative f := ⟨C (d : R₀) * B, by rw [hfg, hgAB]; ring⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hdvd
  rw [derivative_map, hk, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, hroot.eq_zero, zero_mul]

name: IngramMello.exists_highOrderResultant
statement:
theorem exists_highOrderResultant (hSA : SuperAttracting) {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀]
    [IsDomain R₀] [IsIntegrallyClosed R₀] [Algebra ℚ R₀] {r : ℕ} (ι : R₀ →+* MvLaurent r)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R₀) (hnc : ∃ i, MvLaurent.NonConst (ι (a i))) :
    ∃ A : R₀[X], A.Monic ∧ A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a) ∧
      (∀ l j, l ≠ j → W A (monicCentred d a) l j ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q ∧ ∀ l,
        ι (W A (monicCentred d a) (q * (l + 1)) (q * l)) ∈ MvLaurent.maxIdeal x ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, -, hfg, hnm, hBN, hiff⟩ :=
    exists_infiniteOrbitFactor_monicCentred hd a
  set f := monicCentred d a
  refine ⟨A, hAm, ⟨C (d : R₀) * B, by rw [hfg]; ring⟩, fun l j hlj => ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine W_ne_zero hAm f ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
      (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀))) l j fun c hc heq => ?_
    have h := (hiff c).1 (by rw [aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure]; exact hc)
    exact h.2 ((hasFiniteOrbit_iff_algebraicClosure f c).2 (finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq _ hlj heq))
  · obtain ⟨x, c₀, q, hq, hroot, hcrit, hper⟩ :=
      exists_superAttracting_root hSA ι hd a hnc hnm rfl hBN hfg
    exact ⟨x, q, hq, fun l => map_W_mem_maxIdeal_pow hAm f ι x hq hroot hcrit hper l⟩

name: IngramMello.iterate_eval_map
statement:
theorem iterate_eval_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (q : R[X])
    (w : R) (n : ℕ) :
    φ ((fun z => q.eval z)^[n] w) = (fun z => (q.map φ).eval z)^[n] (φ w)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ← ih, eval_map, eval₂_hom]

name: IngramMello.hasFiniteOrbit_map
statement:
theorem hasFiniteOrbit_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) (q : R[X])
    (w : R) (h : HasFiniteOrbit q w) : HasFiniteOrbit (q.map φ) (φ w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit at h ⊢
  refine (h.image φ).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(fun z => aeval z q)^[n] w, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  exact iterate_eval_map φ q w n

name: IngramMello.hasFiniteOrbit_of_map
statement:
theorem hasFiniteOrbit_of_map {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (q : R[X]) (w : R) (h : HasFiniteOrbit (q.map φ) (φ w)) :
    HasFiniteOrbit q w
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit at h ⊢
  refine Set.Finite.of_finite_image (f := φ) ?_ hφ.injOn
  refine h.subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  exact (iterate_eval_map φ q w n).symm

name: IngramMello.ingramBound_of_local
statement: theorem ingramBound_of_local : IngramBound
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hloc⟩ := exists_local_bound.{0, 0} d hd
  obtain ⟨MG, hMG⟩ := exists_arch_bound d hd
  refine ⟨N, hN, N * MG, ?_⟩
  intro a halg hpcf
  set f := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
  have hd0 : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
                                                   
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀m, hg₀deg, hfg₀⟩ := exists_derivative_monicCentred hd a
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_critProd hg₀m hg₀deg
  have hc : derivative f = C (d : ℂ) * critProd c := hfg₀
  have hcroot : ∀ i, (derivative f).IsRoot (c i) := fun i => by
    rw [hc, IsRoot, eval_mul, (critProd_isRoot_iff c (c i)).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩, mul_zero]
  have hroot_c : ∀ z, (derivative f).IsRoot z → ∃ i, c i = z := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hc, IsRoot, eval_mul, eval_C] at hz
    exact (critProd_isRoot_iff c z).mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hd0)
  have hf'ne : derivative f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hc]; exact mul_ne_zero (C_ne_zero.mpr hd0) (critProd_monic c).ne_zero
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℂ, f.eval p = p := by
    have hdeg : 0 < (f - X).degree := by
      rw [degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt]
      · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hfm.ne_zero, hfdeg]; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
      · rw [degree_X, degree_eq_natDegree hfm.ne_zero, hfdeg]
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 < d by omega)
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Complex.exists_root hdeg
    exact ⟨p, by rw [IsRoot, eval_sub, eval_X, sub_eq_zero] at hp; exact hp⟩
                                                                          
  set K₀ : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range a) with hK₀
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ K₀ := by
    apply IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact (halg i).isIntegral
  have haK₀ : ∀ i, a i ∈ K₀ := fun i => IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  set a₀ : Fin (d - 1) → K₀ := fun i => ⟨a i, haK₀ i⟩ with ha₀
  have hf₀ : (monicCentred d a₀).map (algebraMap K₀ ℂ) = f := by rw [map_monicCentred]; rfl
  have hint : ∀ z : ℂ, (derivative f).IsRoot z → IsIntegral ℚ z := by
    intro z hz
    have hq : derivative (monicCentred d a₀) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hf'ne
      have := congrArg (Polynomial.map (algebraMap K₀ ℂ)) h0
      rwa [← derivative_map, hf₀, Polynomial.map_zero] at this
    have hzalg : IsAlgebraic K₀ z :=
      ⟨derivative (monicCentred d a₀), hq, by
        rw [aeval_def, ← eval_map, ← derivative_map, hf₀]; exact hz⟩
    exact isIntegral_trans (R := ℚ) (A := K₀) z hzalg.isIntegral
  have hpint : IsIntegral ℚ p := by
    have hq : monicCentred d a₀ - X ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := congrArg (Polynomial.map (algebraMap K₀ ℂ)) h0
      rw [Polynomial.map_sub, hf₀, map_X, Polynomial.map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at this
      have h1 := congrArg natDegree this
      rw [hfdeg, natDegree_X] at h1
      omega
    have hpalg : IsAlgebraic K₀ p :=
      ⟨monicCentred d a₀ - X, hq, by
        rw [aeval_def, ← eval_map, Polynomial.map_sub, hf₀, map_X, eval_sub, eval_X, hp, sub_self]⟩
    exact isIntegral_trans (R := ℚ) (A := K₀) p hpalg.isIntegral
                             
  set S : Set ℂ := Set.range a ∪ {z | (derivative f).IsRoot z} ∪ {p} with hS
  have hSfin : S.Finite :=
    ((Set.finite_range a).union (finite_setOf_isRoot hf'ne)).union (Set.finite_singleton p)
  set L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ S with hL
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ L := by
    have := hSfin.to_subtype
    apply IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with (⟨i, rfl⟩ | hx) | rfl
    · exact (halg i).isIntegral
    · exact hint x hx
    · exact hpint
  have : NumberField L := ⟨⟩
  have hmemL : ∀ x ∈ S, x ∈ L := fun x hx => IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ S hx
  have haL : ∀ i, a i ∈ L := fun i => hmemL _ (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))
  have hcL : ∀ i, c i ∈ L := fun i => hmemL _ (Or.inl (Or.inr (hcroot i)))
  have hpL : p ∈ L := hmemL p (Or.inr rfl)
  set aL : Fin (d - 1) → L := fun i => ⟨a i, haL i⟩ with haL'
  set cL : Fin (d - 1) → L := fun i => ⟨c i, hcL i⟩ with hcL'
  set pL : L := ⟨p, hpL⟩ with hpL'
  set fL := monicCentred d aL with hfL'
  have hfL : fL.map (algebraMap L ℂ) = f := by rw [hfL', map_monicCentred]; rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap L ℂ) := (algebraMap L ℂ).injective
  have hcLder : derivative fL = C (d : L) * critProd cL := by
    apply Polynomial.map_injective _ hinj
    rw [← derivative_map, hfL, hc, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_critProd, map_natCast]
    rfl
  have hpLfix : fL.eval pL = pL := by
    apply hinj
    rw [← eval₂_hom, ← eval_map, hfL]
    exact hp
  have horbL : ∀ i, HasFiniteOrbit fL (cL i) := fun i =>
    hasFiniteOrbit_of_map (algebraMap L ℂ) hinj fL (cL i) (by rw [hfL]; exact hpcf (c i) (hcroot i))
                                                                     
  have hval := fun (v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L)) =>
    hloc L (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) (v.valuation L) aL cL pL hcLder hpLfix horbL
  have hintL : ∀ x : L, (∀ v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L), v.valuation L x ≤ 1) →
      IsIntegral ℤ (algebraMap L ℂ x) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.mem_integers_of_valuation_le_one (R := 𝓞 L) (K := L) x hx
    rw [← hy]
    exact (RingOfIntegers.isIntegral_coe y).map (algebraMap L ℂ).toIntAlgHom
                                                                 
  have hhouse : ∀ x : L, (∀ σ : L →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ≤ N * MG) →
      HouseLE (algebraMap L ℂ x) (N * MG) :=
    fun x hx => (houseLE_iff_embeddings L.val x _).mpr hx
  have hmapσ : ∀ σ : L →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, fL.map (σ : L →+* ℂ) = monicCentred d (fun i => σ (aL i)) :=
    fun σ => map_monicCentred _ d aL
  have hσder : ∀ σ : L →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, derivative (monicCentred d (fun i => σ (aL i)))
      = C (d : ℂ) * critProd (fun i => σ (cL i)) := by
    intro σ
    rw [← hmapσ, derivative_map, hcLder, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_critProd, map_natCast]
    rfl
  have hσroot : ∀ (σ : L →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) i,
      (derivative (monicCentred d (fun i => σ (aL i)))).IsRoot (σ (cL i)) := fun σ i => by
    rw [hσder, IsRoot, eval_mul, (critProd_isRoot_iff _ (σ (cL i))).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩, mul_zero]
  have hσpcf : ∀ σ : L →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, IsPCF (monicCentred d (fun i => σ (aL i))) := by
    intro σ z hz
    rw [hσder, IsRoot, eval_mul, eval_C] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (critProd_isRoot_iff _ z).mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hd0)
    rw [← hmapσ]
    exact hasFiniteOrbit_map (σ : L →+* ℂ) fL (cL i) (horbL i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hx : (N : ℂ) * a i = algebraMap L ℂ ((N : L) * aL i) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_natCast]; rfl
    rw [hx]
    refine ⟨hintL _ fun v => (hval v).1 i, hhouse _ fun σ => ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, map_natCast, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hMG _ (hσpcf σ)).1 i) (Nat.cast_nonneg N)
  · intro z hz n m
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hroot_c z hz
    have hx : (N : ℂ) * ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n] (c i) - (fun w => f.eval w)^[m] (c i))
        = algebraMap L ℂ ((N : L) *
          ((fun w => fL.eval w)^[n] (cL i) - (fun w => fL.eval w)^[m] (cL i))) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_natCast, map_sub, iterate_eval_map, iterate_eval_map, hfL]
      rfl
    rw [hx]
    refine ⟨hintL _ fun v => (hval v).2 (cL i) (horbL i) n m, hhouse _ fun σ => ?_⟩
    have h1 := iterate_eval_map (σ : L →+* ℂ) fL (cL i) n
    have h2 := iterate_eval_map (σ : L →+* ℂ) fL (cL i) m
    simp only [AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] at h1 h2
    rw [map_mul, map_natCast, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, map_sub, h1, h2, hmapσ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hMG _ (hσpcf σ)).2 (σ (cL i)) (hσroot σ i) n m)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg N)

name: IngramMello.minpoly_eq_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
theorem minpoly_eq_of_adjoin_eq_top {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [FiniteDimensional K L] {x : L} (htop : K⟮x⟯ = ⊤) {q : K[X]} (hq : q.Monic)
    (hroot : aeval x q = 0) (hdeg : q.natDegree = finrank K L) :
    minpoly K x = q ∧ Algebra.trace K L x = -q.nextCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have hx : IsIntegral K x := IsIntegral.of_finite K x
  have hdvd : minpoly K x ∣ q := minpoly.dvd K x hroot
  have hnat : (minpoly K x).natDegree = finrank K L := by
    rw [← adjoin.finrank hx, htop, finrank_top']
  have hmin : minpoly K x = q :=
    (eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le (minpoly.monic hx) hq hdvd (by rw [hnat, hdeg])).symm
  refine ⟨hmin, ?_⟩
  rw [trace_eq_finrank_mul_minpoly_nextCoeff, htop, IntermediateField.finrank_top, hmin]
  simp

name: IngramMello.towerAlgebra_algebraMap_apply
statement:
theorem towerAlgebra_algebraMap_apply (hP : 0 < P) (hdvd : P₁ ∣ P) (y : cycField P₁) :
    ((@algebraMap _ _ _ _ (towerAlgebra hP hdvd) y : cycField P) : ℂ) = y
proof:
:=
  coe_inclusion _ y

name: IngramMello.towerAlgebra_isScalarTower'
statement:
theorem towerAlgebra_isScalarTower' (hP : 0 < P) (hdvd : P₁ ∣ P) :
    @IsScalarTower (cycField P₁) (cycField P) ℂ (towerAlgebra hP hdvd).toSMul _ _
proof:
:= by
  let _ := towerAlgebra hP hdvd
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun y => by
    rw [IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply, IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply,
      towerAlgebra_algebraMap_apply]

name: IngramMello.towerAlgebra_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem towerAlgebra_isScalarTower (hP : 0 < P) (hdvd : P₁ ∣ P) :
    @IsScalarTower ℚ (cycField P₁) (cycField P) _ (towerAlgebra hP hdvd).toSMul _
proof:
:= by
  let _ := towerAlgebra hP hdvd
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun q =>
    ((IntermediateField.inclusion (cycField_mono hP hdvd)).commutes q).symm

name: IngramMello.coe_algebraMap_cycField
statement:
theorem coe_algebraMap_cycField (y : cycField P₁) :
    ((algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) y : cycField P) : ℂ) = y
proof:
:= by
  have := IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (cycField P₁) (cycField P) ℂ y
  simpa using this.symm

name: IngramMello.totient_mul_finrank_cycField
statement:
theorem totient_mul_finrank_cycField (hP : 0 < P) (hdvd : P₁ ∣ P) :
    Nat.totient P₁ * finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField P) = Nat.totient P
proof:
:= by
  have hP₁ : 0 < P₁ := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd hP
  rw [← cycField_finrank hP₁, ← cycField_finrank hP]
  exact Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (cycField P₁) (cycField P)

name: IngramMello.adjoin_eq_top_of_zetaC_eq
statement:
theorem adjoin_eq_top_of_zetaC_eq (hP : 0 < P) (x : cycField P) (η : cycField P₁) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : zetaC P = (x : ℂ) ^ a * (η : ℂ) ^ b) : (cycField P₁)⟮x⟯ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let g : cycField P := AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC P)
  have hg : g ∈ (cycField P₁)⟮x⟯ := by
    have hgx : g = x ^ a * (algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) η) ^ b := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have e1 : ∀ z : cycField P, ∀ n : ℤ, ((z ^ n : cycField P) : ℂ) = (z : ℂ) ^ n := by
        intro z n
        exact map_zpow₀ (cycField P).val z n
      simp only [g, AdjoinSimple.coe_gen, h]
      rw [IntermediateField.coe_mul, e1, e1, coe_algebraMap_cycField]
    rw [hgx]
    exact mul_mem (zpow_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self _ x) a)
      (zpow_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ η) b)
  have htop : Algebra.adjoin ℚ ({g} : Set (cycField P)) = ⊤ := by
    have := PowerBasis.adjoin_gen_eq_top (adjoin.powerBasis (zetaC_isIntegral hP))
    rwa [adjoin.powerBasis_gen] at this
  have hle : Algebra.adjoin ℚ ({g} : Set (cycField P)) ≤
      ((cycField P₁)⟮x⟯.restrictScalars ℚ).toSubalgebra := by
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact hg
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro y _
  have : y ∈ ((cycField P₁)⟮x⟯.restrictScalars ℚ).toSubalgebra := hle (htop ▸ Algebra.mem_top)
  exact this

name: IngramMello.trace_one_cycField
statement:
theorem trace_one_cycField :
    Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField P) 1 =
      (finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField P) : cycField P₁)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P)).map_one, Algebra.trace_algebraMap]
  simp

name: IngramMello.zpow_bezout
statement:
theorem zpow_bezout {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ζ ≠ 0) {k p : ℕ} (hcop : k.Coprime p) :
    ζ = (ζ ^ k) ^ Nat.gcdA k p * (ζ ^ p) ^ Nat.gcdB k p
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : (k : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA k p + (p : ℤ) * Nat.gcdB k p = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hcop.gcd_eq_one, Nat.cast_one]
  calc ζ = ζ ^ ((k : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA k p + (p : ℤ) * Nat.gcdB k p) := by rw [hexp, zpow_one]
    _ = _ := by rw [zpow_add₀ hζ, zpow_mul, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]

name: IngramMello.exists_nat_exponent
statement:
theorem exists_nat_exponent {k : ℤ} {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) (hk : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ k) :
    ∃ (k' : ℕ) (m : ℤ), 0 < k' ∧ k' < p ∧ k = (p : ℤ) * m + k'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(k % (p : ℤ)).toNat, k / p, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 : k % (p : ℤ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h)
    have h1 : 0 ≤ k % (p : ℤ) := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne')
    omega
  · have := Int.emod_lt_of_pos k (by exact_mod_cast hp : (0 : ℤ) < p)
    omega
  · have h1 : 0 ≤ k % (p : ℤ) := Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hp.ne')
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg h1, add_comm]
    exact (Int.emod_add_mul_ediv k p).symm

name: IngramMello.trace_zpow_coprime
statement:
theorem trace_zpow_coprime (hcop : p.Coprime P₁) (ξ : cycField (p * P₁)) (hξ : (ξ : ℂ) = zetaC p)
    (k : ℤ) (hk : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ k) :
    Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (ξ ^ k) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hP : 0 < p * P₁ := Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ p := by
    rw [← IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_submonoidClass_iff, hξ]
    exact zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hp.pos
  have hξne : ξ ≠ 0 := hprim.ne_zero hp.ne_zero
  obtain ⟨k', m, hk'pos, hk'lt, rfl⟩ := exists_nat_exponent hp.pos hk
  have hred : ξ ^ ((p : ℤ) * m + k') = ξ ^ k' := by
    rw [zpow_add₀ hξne, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hprim.pow_eq_one, one_zpow, one_mul,
      zpow_natCast]
  rw [hred]
  set x := ξ ^ k' with hx
  have hcop' : k'.Coprime p := (Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime hk'pos.ne' hk'lt hp).symm
  have hxprim : IsPrimitiveRoot x p := hprim.pow_of_coprime k' hcop'
  
  have htop : (cycField P₁)⟮x⟯ = ⊤ := by
    have hζp : zetaC p = (x : ℂ) ^ Nat.gcdA k' p := by
      have := zpow_bezout ((zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hp.pos).ne_zero hp.ne_zero) hcop'
      rw [(zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hp.pos).pow_eq_one, one_zpow, mul_one] at this
      rw [this, hx, IntermediateField.coe_pow, hξ]
    refine adjoin_eq_top_of_zetaC_eq hP x ⟨zetaC P₁, zetaC_mem_cycField P₁⟩
      (Nat.gcdA k' p * Nat.gcdB p P₁) (Nat.gcdA p P₁) ?_
    rw [zetaC_mul_eq_of_coprime hp.pos hP₁ hcop, hζp, zpow_mul, mul_comm]
  
  have : NeZero (p : cycField (p * P₁)) := ⟨by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero⟩
  have := Fact.mk hp
  have hroot : aeval x (cyclotomic p (cycField P₁)) = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_def, ← eval_map, map_cyclotomic]
    exact (isRoot_cyclotomic_iff.mpr hxprim)
  have hrank : finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) = p - 1 := by
    have h := totient_mul_finrank_cycField hP (dvd_mul_left P₁ p)
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hp, mul_comm] at h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP₁) h
  have hdeg : (cyclotomic p (cycField P₁)).natDegree =
      finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) := by
    rw [natDegree_cyclotomic, Nat.totient_prime hp, hrank]
  obtain ⟨-, htr⟩ := minpoly_eq_of_adjoin_eq_top htop (cyclotomic.monic p _) hroot hdeg
  rw [htr]
  congr 1
  have hpos : 0 < (cyclotomic p (cycField P₁)).natDegree := by
    rw [natDegree_cyclotomic, Nat.totient_prime hp]
    have := hp.two_le
    omega
  rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos hpos, natDegree_cyclotomic, Nat.totient_prime hp,
    cyclotomic_prime, finsetSum_coeff]
  simp only [coeff_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
  have := hp.two_le
  simp [Finset.mem_range, show p - 1 - 1 < p by omega]

name: IngramMello.trace_zpow_dvd
statement:
theorem trace_zpow_dvd (hpdvd : p ∣ P₁) (ξ : cycField (p * P₁)) (hξ : (ξ : ℂ) = zetaC (p * P₁))
    (k : ℤ) (hk : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ k) :
    Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (ξ ^ k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP : 0 < p * P₁ := Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁
  have hprim : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ (p * P₁) := by
    rw [← IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_submonoidClass_iff, hξ]
    exact zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP
  have hξne : ξ ≠ 0 := hprim.ne_zero hP.ne'
  set η : cycField P₁ := ⟨zetaC P₁, zetaC_mem_cycField P₁⟩ with hη
  have hξp : ξ ^ p = algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) η := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [IntermediateField.coe_pow, hξ, coe_algebraMap_cycField, zetaC_mul_pow hp.pos hP₁]
  obtain ⟨k', m, hk'pos, hk'lt, rfl⟩ := exists_nat_exponent hp.pos hk
  have hred : ξ ^ ((p : ℤ) * m + k') =
      algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (η ^ m) * ξ ^ k' := by
    rw [zpow_add₀ hξne, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hξp, map_zpow₀, zpow_natCast]
  rw [hred, ← Algebra.smul_def, LinearMap.map_smul]
  set x := ξ ^ k' with hx
  have hcop' : k'.Coprime p := (Nat.coprime_of_lt_prime hk'pos.ne' hk'lt hp).symm
  
  have htop : (cycField P₁)⟮x⟯ = ⊤ := by
    refine adjoin_eq_top_of_zetaC_eq hP x η (Nat.gcdA k' p) (Nat.gcdB k' p) ?_
    have := zpow_bezout ((zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hP).ne_zero hP.ne') hcop'
    rw [zetaC_mul_pow hp.pos hP₁] at this
    rw [this, hx, IntermediateField.coe_pow, hξ]
  
  have hroot : aeval x (X ^ p - C (η ^ k')) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C]
    rw [hx, ← pow_mul, mul_comm k' p, pow_mul, hξp, sub_self]
  have hrank : finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) = p := by
    have h := totient_mul_finrank_cycField hP (dvd_mul_left P₁ p)
    rw [Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hp hpdvd, mul_comm p P₁.totient] at h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP₁) h
  have hdeg : (X ^ p - C (η ^ k') : (cycField P₁)[X]).natDegree =
      finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) := by
    rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C, hrank]
  obtain ⟨-, htr⟩ := minpoly_eq_of_adjoin_eq_top htop (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hp.ne_zero) hroot hdeg
  rw [htr]
  have hpos : 0 < (X ^ p - C (η ^ k') : (cycField P₁)[X]).natDegree := by
    rw [natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]; exact hp.pos
  rw [nextCoeff_of_natDegree_pos hpos, natDegree_X_pow_sub_C, coeff_sub, coeff_X_pow, coeff_C]
  have := hp.two_le
  simp [show p - 1 ≠ p by omega, show p - 1 ≠ 0 by omega]

name: IngramMello.conjF_algebraMap
statement:
theorem conjF_algebraMap (y : cycField P₁) :
    conjF P (algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) y) =
      algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (conjF P₁ y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_conjF, coe_algebraMap_cycField, coe_algebraMap_cycField, coe_conjF]

name: IngramMello.conjF_of_norm_eq_one
statement: theorem conjF_of_norm_eq_one {ξ : cycField P} (hξ : ‖(ξ : ℂ)‖ = 1) : conjF P ξ = ξ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coe_conjF, IntermediateField.coe_inv, Complex.inv_eq_conj hξ]

name: IngramMello.trace_mul_conjF_expand
statement:
theorem trace_mul_conjF_expand {n : ℕ} {ξ : cycField P} (hξ : ‖(ξ : ℂ)‖ = 1)
    (a : Fin n → cycField P₁) :
    Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField P)
      ((∑ j, algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (a j) * ξ ^ (j : ℕ)) *
        conjF P (∑ j, algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (a j) * ξ ^ (j : ℕ))) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, a i * conjF P₁ (a j) *
        Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (ξ ^ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hξne : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hξ
    simp at hξ
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, conjF_algebraMap, conjF_of_norm_eq_one hξ]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  have : algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (a i) * ξ ^ (i : ℕ) *
      (algebraMap (cycField P₁) (cycField P) (conjF P₁ (a j)) * ξ⁻¹ ^ (j : ℕ)) =
      (a i * conjF P₁ (a j)) • ξ ^ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, zpow_sub₀ hξne, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, inv_pow]
    ring
  rw [this, LinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: IngramMello.sum_sub_mul_sub_eq
statement:
theorem sum_sub_mul_sub_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (u v : Fin n → R) :
    2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * v j * ((if i = j then (n : R) else 0) - 1) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (u i - u j) * (v i - v j)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∑ i, ∑ j, u i * v j * ((if i = j then (n : R) else 0) - 1) =
      (n : R) * ∑ i, u i * v i - (∑ i, u i) * (∑ j, v j) := by
    have e : ∀ i j, u i * v j * ((if i = j then (n : R) else 0) - 1) =
        (if i = j then (n : R) * (u i * v i) else 0) - u i * v j := by
      intro i j
      by_cases h : i = j
      · subst h; simp; ring
      · simp [h]
    simp only [e, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hR : ∑ i, ∑ j, (u i - u j) * (v i - v j) =
      2 * ((n : R) * ∑ i, u i * v i) - 2 * ((∑ i, u i) * (∑ j, v j)) := by
    have e : ∀ i j, (u i - u j) * (v i - v j) =
        u i * v i + u j * v j - u i * v j - u j * v i := fun i j => by ring
    simp only [e, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    have e1 : ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, u i * v j = (∑ i, u i) * (∑ j, v j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    have e2 : ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, u j * v i = (∑ i, u i) * (∑ j, v j) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    have e3 : ∑ i : Fin n, (n : R) * (u i * v i) = (n : R) * ∑ i, u i * v i := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [e1, e2, e3]
    ring
  rw [hL, hR]; ring

name: IngramMello.int_dvd_sub_fin_iff
statement:
theorem int_dvd_sub_fin_iff (i j : Fin p) :
    (p : ℤ) ∣ ((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ) ↔ i = j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hi := i.2
    have hj := j.2
    have := Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd h (by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega)
    exact Fin.ext (by omega)
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: IngramMello.cassels_identity_dvd
statement:
theorem cassels_identity_dvd (hp : p.Prime) (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) (hpdvd : p ∣ P₁)
    (a : Fin p → ℂ) (ha : ∀ j, a j ∈ cycField P₁) :
    cassM (p * P₁) (∑ j, a j * zetaC (p * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ)) = ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a j)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : 0 < p * P₁ := Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁
  have hdvd : P₁ ∣ p * P₁ := dvd_mul_left P₁ p
  let _ := towerAlgebra hP hdvd
  have := towerAlgebra_isScalarTower hP hdvd
  have := towerAlgebra_isScalarTower' hP hdvd
  set ξ : cycField (p * P₁) := ⟨zetaC (p * P₁), zetaC_mem_cycField _⟩ with hξdef
  have hξ : (ξ : ℂ) = zetaC (p * P₁) := rfl
  have hξnorm : ‖(ξ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by rw [hξ]; exact norm_zetaC _
  let av : Fin p → cycField P₁ := fun j => ⟨a j, ha j⟩
  set βt : cycField (p * P₁) := ∑ j, algebraMap _ _ (av j) * ξ ^ (j : ℕ) with hβt
  have hβmem : (∑ j, a j * zetaC (p * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ)) ∈ cycField (p * P₁) := by
    have : (βt : ℂ) = ∑ j, a j * zetaC (p * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ) := by
      rw [hβt, IntermediateField.coe_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [IntermediateField.coe_mul, IntermediateField.coe_pow, coe_algebraMap_cycField, hξ]
    rw [← this]; exact βt.2
