  have hβeq : (⟨(∑ j, a j * zetaC (p * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ) : ℂ), hβmem⟩ : cycField (p * P₁)) = βt := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (∑ j, a j * zetaC (p * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ)) = (βt : ℂ)
    rw [hβt, IntermediateField.coe_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [IntermediateField.coe_mul, IntermediateField.coe_pow, coe_algebraMap_cycField, hξ]
  
  have htr : ∀ i j : Fin p,
      Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (ξ ^ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
        if i = j then (p : cycField P₁) else 0 := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, sub_self, zpow_zero, trace_one_cycField]
      have hrank : finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) = p := by
        have h := totient_mul_finrank_cycField hP hdvd
        rw [Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hp hpdvd, mul_comm p P₁.totient] at h
        exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP₁) h
      rw [hrank]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij]
      exact trace_zpow_dvd hp hP₁ hpdvd ξ hξ _ (fun h => hij ((int_dvd_sub_fin_iff i j).1 h))
  have hrel : Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (βt * conjF (p * P₁) βt) =
      (p : cycField P₁) * ∑ i, av i * conjF P₁ (av i) := by
    rw [hβt, trace_mul_conjF_expand hξnorm]
    simp only [htr, mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _
  
  have htt := Algebra.trace_trace (R := ℚ) (S := cycField P₁) (βt * conjF (p * P₁) βt)
  rw [cassM_eq_trace hP hβmem, hβeq, ← htt, hrel,
    ← nsmul_eq_mul, map_nsmul, map_sum, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hφ : (Nat.totient (p * P₁) : ℝ) = p * Nat.totient P₁ := by
    rw [Nat.totient_mul_of_prime_of_dvd hp hpdvd]; push_cast; ring
  have hp0 : (p : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  rw [hφ]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hp0, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [cassM_eq_trace hP₁ (ha i)]

name: IngramMello.cassels_identity_coprime
statement:
theorem cassels_identity_coprime (hp : p.Prime) (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) (hndvd : ¬ p ∣ P₁)
    (a : Fin p → ℂ) (ha : ∀ j, a j ∈ cycField P₁) :
    2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (p * P₁) (∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ)) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j)
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : p.Coprime P₁ := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 hndvd
  have hP : 0 < p * P₁ := Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁
  have hdvd : P₁ ∣ p * P₁ := dvd_mul_left P₁ p
  let _ := towerAlgebra hP hdvd
  have := towerAlgebra_isScalarTower hP hdvd
  have := towerAlgebra_isScalarTower' hP hdvd
  have hζp : zetaC p ∈ cycField (p * P₁) := by
    rw [zetaC_dvd hP (dvd_mul_right p P₁)]
    exact pow_mem (zetaC_mem_cycField _) _
  set ξ : cycField (p * P₁) := ⟨zetaC p, hζp⟩ with hξdef
  have hξ : (ξ : ℂ) = zetaC p := rfl
  have hξnorm : ‖(ξ : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by rw [hξ]; exact norm_zetaC _
  let av : Fin p → cycField P₁ := fun j => ⟨a j, ha j⟩
  set βt : cycField (p * P₁) := ∑ j, algebraMap _ _ (av j) * ξ ^ (j : ℕ) with hβt
  have hβmem : (∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ)) ∈ cycField (p * P₁) := by
    have : (βt : ℂ) = ∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ) := by
      rw [hβt, IntermediateField.coe_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [IntermediateField.coe_mul, IntermediateField.coe_pow, coe_algebraMap_cycField, hξ]
    rw [← this]; exact βt.2
  have hβeq : (⟨(∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ) : ℂ), hβmem⟩ : cycField (p * P₁)) = βt := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ)) = (βt : ℂ)
    rw [hβt, IntermediateField.coe_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [IntermediateField.coe_mul, IntermediateField.coe_pow, coe_algebraMap_cycField, hξ]
  
  have htr : ∀ i j : Fin p,
      Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (ξ ^ (((i : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
        (if i = j then (p : cycField P₁) else 0) - 1 := by
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl, sub_self, zpow_zero, trace_one_cycField]
      have hrank : finrank (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) = p - 1 := by
        have h := totient_mul_finrank_cycField hP hdvd
        rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hp, mul_comm (p - 1) P₁.totient] at h
        exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP₁) h
      rw [hrank, Nat.cast_sub hp.one_le, Nat.cast_one]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hij, zero_sub]
      exact trace_zpow_coprime hp hP₁ hcop ξ hξ _
        (fun h => hij ((int_dvd_sub_fin_iff i j).1 h))
  have hrel : 2 * Algebra.trace (cycField P₁) (cycField (p * P₁)) (βt * conjF (p * P₁) βt) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, (av i - av j) * conjF P₁ (av i - av j) := by
    rw [hβt, trace_mul_conjF_expand hξnorm]
    simp only [htr, map_sub]
    exact sum_sub_mul_sub_eq av (fun j => conjF P₁ (av j))
  
  have hφ : (Nat.totient (p * P₁) : ℝ) = ((p : ℝ) - 1) * Nat.totient P₁ := by
    rw [Nat.totient_mul hcop, Nat.totient_prime hp]; push_cast [hp.one_le]; ring
  have hφ₁ : (Nat.totient P₁ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.totient_pos.2 hP₁).ne'
  have hp1 : (p : ℝ) - 1 ≠ 0 := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.two_le
    linarith
  have key : ((Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P₁)
      (∑ i, ∑ j, (av i - av j) * conjF P₁ (av i - av j)) : ℚ) : ℝ) =
      2 * ((Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField (p * P₁)) (βt * conjF (p * P₁) βt) : ℚ) : ℝ) := by
    have h2 : ∀ z, Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P₁) (2 * z) = 2 * Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P₁) z :=
      fun z => by rw [two_mul, map_add, two_mul]
    have htt := Algebra.trace_trace (R := ℚ) (S := cycField P₁) (βt * conjF (p * P₁) βt)
    rw [← hrel, h2, ← htt]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [cassM_eq_trace hP hβmem, hβeq, hφ]
  have hrhs : ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) =
      ((Algebra.trace ℚ (cycField P₁)
        (∑ i, ∑ j, (av i - av j) * conjF P₁ (av i - av j)) : ℚ) : ℝ) / Nat.totient P₁ := by
    rw [map_sum]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [map_sum]
    push_cast
    rw [Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [cassM_eq_trace hP₁ (sub_mem (ha i) (ha j))]
    rfl
  rw [hrhs, key]
  field_simp

name: IngramMello.houseLE_iff_embeddings
statement:
theorem houseLE_iff_embeddings {E : Type*} [Field E] [Algebra ℚ E]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ E] (φ : E →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ) (x : E) (M : ℝ) :
    HouseLE (φ x) M ↔ ∀ σ : E →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, ‖σ x‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  have hp : minpoly ℚ (φ x) = minpoly ℚ x := minpoly.algHom_eq φ φ.injective x
  constructor
  · intro h σ
    apply h
    rw [hp, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, minpoly.aeval, map_zero]
  · intro h z hz
    rw [hp] at hz
    obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := IntermediateField.exists_algHom_of_splits_of_aeval
      (fun y : E => ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral y, IsAlgClosed.splits _⟩) hz
    exact h σ

name: IngramMello.HouseLE.mul
proof:
:= by
  let E := algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ
  let x' : E := ⟨x, hxi⟩
  let y' : E := ⟨y, hyi⟩
  apply (houseLE_iff_embeddings E.val (x' * y') (M * N)).mpr
  intro σ
  rw [map_mul, norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul ((houseLE_iff_embeddings E.val x' M).mp hx σ)
    ((houseLE_iff_embeddings E.val y' N).mp hy σ) (norm_nonneg _)
    ((norm_nonneg x).trans (hx x (minpoly.aeval ℚ x)))

name: IngramMello.IsBoundedAlgInt.mul
proof:
:=
  ⟨hx.1.mul hy.1, hx.2.mul hy.2 hx.1.tower_top hy.1.tower_top⟩

name: IngramMello.isBoundedAlgInt_natCast
statement: theorem isBoundedAlgInt_natCast (n : ℕ) : IsBoundedAlgInt (n : ℝ) (n : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isIntegral_natCast n, ?_⟩
  apply (houseLE_iff_embeddings (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ).val
    (n : algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ) (n : ℝ)).mpr
  intro σ
  simp

name: IngramMello.IsBoundedAlgInt.mono
statement:
theorem IsBoundedAlgInt.mono {x : ℂ} {M N : ℝ}
    (hx : IsBoundedAlgInt M x) (h : M ≤ N) : IsBoundedAlgInt N x
proof:
:=
  ⟨hx.1, fun z hz => (hx.2 z hz).trans h⟩

name: IngramMello.IsBoundedAlgInt.pow
statement:
theorem IsBoundedAlgInt.pow {x : ℂ} {M : ℝ}
    (hx : IsBoundedAlgInt M x) (n : ℕ) : IsBoundedAlgInt (M ^ n) (x ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using isBoundedAlgInt_natCast 1
  | succ n ih => simpa [pow_succ] using ih.mul hx

name: IngramMello.isBoundedAlgInt_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem isBoundedAlgInt_multiset_prod (s : Multiset ℂ) {M : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsBoundedAlgInt M x) : IsBoundedAlgInt (M ^ s.card) s.prod
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using isBoundedAlgInt_natCast 1
  | cons x s ih =>
    simpa [pow_succ, mul_comm] using
      (h x (Multiset.mem_cons_self x s)).mul (ih (fun y hy => h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy)))

name: IngramMello.bounded_scaled_prod
statement:
theorem bounded_scaled_prod (s : Multiset ℂ) {D n : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hcard : s.card ≤ n) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, IsBoundedAlgInt M ((D : ℂ) * x)) :
    IsBoundedAlgInt ((D : ℝ) ^ (n - s.card) * M ^ s.card)
      ((D : ℂ) ^ n * s.prod)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := isBoundedAlgInt_multiset_prod (s.map fun x => (D : ℂ) * x)
    (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
      exact h y hy)
  have heq : (s.map fun x => (D : ℂ) * x).prod = (D : ℂ) ^ s.card * s.prod := by
    clear hcard h hp
    induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | cons x s ih => simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.card_cons,
        ih, pow_succ]; ring
  rw [heq, Multiset.card_map] at hp
  have ht := ((isBoundedAlgInt_natCast D).pow (n - s.card)).mul hp
  simpa only [← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hcard] using ht

name: IngramMello.scaled_prod_bound_uniform
statement:
theorem scaled_prod_bound_uniform {D n k : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (hk : k ≤ n) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    (D : ℝ) ^ (n - k) * M ^ k ≤ (max (D : ℝ) (max 1 M)) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  let B := max (D : ℝ) (max 1 M)
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := (Nat.cast_nonneg D).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  calc
    (D : ℝ) ^ (n - k) * M ^ k ≤ B ^ (n - k) * B ^ k := by
      apply mul_le_mul
      · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg D) (le_max_left _ _) _
      · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hM ((le_max_right 1 M).trans (le_max_right _ _)) _
      · positivity
      · positivity
    _ = B ^ n := by rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]

name: IngramMello.natDegree_le_of_dvd_derivative_monicCentred
statement:
theorem natDegree_le_of_dvd_derivative_monicCentred {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (a : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) {A : ℂ[X]} (hdiv : A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a)) :
    A.natDegree ≤ d - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, hgdeg, hfg⟩ := exists_derivative_monicCentred hd a
  have hd0 : (d : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
  rw [hfg] at hdiv
  have hdeg : (C (d : ℂ) * g).natDegree = d - 1 := by
    rw [natDegree_C_mul hd0, hgdeg]
  exact hdeg ▸ natDegree_le_of_dvd hdiv (mul_ne_zero (C_ne_zero.mpr hd0) hgm.ne_zero)

name: IngramMello.isBoundedAlgInt_W
statement:
theorem isBoundedAlgInt_W {d D : ℕ} {M : ℝ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (a : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) {A : ℂ[X]} (hA : A.Monic)
    (hdiv : A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a))
    (hbound : ∀ c : ℂ, (derivative (monicCentred d a)).IsRoot c → ∀ l j : ℕ,
      IsBoundedAlgInt M ((D : ℂ) *
        ((fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[l] c -
          (fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[j] c))) (l j : ℕ) :
    IsBoundedAlgInt ((D : ℝ) ^ (d - 1 - A.natDegree) * M ^ A.natDegree)
      ((D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * W A (monicCentred d a) l j)
proof:
:= by
  let diff := fun c => (fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[l] c -
    (fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[j] c
  have hcard : (A.roots.map diff).card = A.natDegree := by
    rw [Multiset.card_map, ← (IsAlgClosed.splits A).natDegree_eq_card_roots]
  have hprod : (A.roots.map diff).prod = W A (monicCentred d a) l j := by
    simpa using (ev_W hA (monicCentred d a) (RingHom.id ℂ) l j).symm
  have h := bounded_scaled_prod (A.roots.map diff)
    (hcard ▸ natDegree_le_of_dvd_derivative_monicCentred hd a hdiv)
    (D := D) (M := M) (fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
      exact hbound c (Polynomial.IsRoot.dvd ((mem_roots hA.ne_zero).mp hc) hdiv) l j)
  rwa [hcard, hprod] at h

name: IngramMello.exists_uniform_W_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_W_bound (hIB : IngramBound) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ a : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ, (∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (a i)) →
        IsPCF (monicCentred d a) → ∀ A : ℂ[X], A.Monic →
        A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a) → ∀ l j : ℕ,
          IsBoundedAlgInt B ((D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * W A (monicCentred d a) l j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, M, h⟩ := hIB d hd
  refine ⟨D, hD, (max (D : ℝ) (max 1 (max 0 M))) ^ (d - 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro a ha hpcf A hA hdiv l j
  have hb := (h a ha hpcf).2
  have hb' : ∀ c : ℂ, (derivative (monicCentred d a)).IsRoot c → ∀ l j : ℕ,
      IsBoundedAlgInt (max 0 M) ((D : ℂ) *
        ((fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[l] c -
          (fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[j] c)) :=
    fun c hc l j => (hb c hc l j).mono (le_max_right _ _)
  exact (isBoundedAlgInt_W hd a hA hdiv hb' l j).mono
    (scaled_prod_bound_uniform (natDegree_le_of_dvd_derivative_monicCentred hd a hdiv)
      (le_max_left 0 M))

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval_mem_intermediateField
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.eval_mem_intermediateField {r : ℕ} (F : MvLaurent r)
    (L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (x : Fin r → ℂ)
    (hF : ∀ e, F.coeff e ∈ L) (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ L) : MvLaurent.eval F x ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply L.sum_mem
  intro e _
  exact L.mul_mem (hF e) (L.prod_mem fun i _ => L.toSubfield.zpow_mem (hx i) _)

name: IngramMello.mem_Kcyc_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_Kcyc_of_mem (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ K) :
    x ∈ Kcyc K
proof: := (le_sup_left : K ≤ Kcyc K) hx

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.mem_Kcyc
statement:
theorem IsRootOfUnityC.mem_Kcyc {x : ℂ} (hx : IsRootOfUnityC x)
    (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) : x ∈ Kcyc K
proof:
:=
  (le_sup_right : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {ζ : ℂ | IsRootOfUnityC ζ} ≤ Kcyc K)
    (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ hx)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_map_mem_Kcyc
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.evalHom_map_mem_Kcyc {r : ℕ} (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
    (F : AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ)) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ)
    (hx : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (x i : ℂ)) :
    MvLaurent.evalHom x (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (Fin r → ℤ) K.val.toRingHom F)
      ∈ Kcyc K
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvLaurent.evalHom_apply]
  apply MvLaurent.eval_mem_intermediateField
  · intro e
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapRingHom]
    exact mem_Kcyc_of_mem K (F.coeff e).property
  · exact fun i => (hx i).mem_Kcyc K

name: IngramMello.Kcyc_le_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem Kcyc_le_algebraicClosure (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) [FiniteDimensional ℚ K] :
    Kcyc K ≤ algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ
proof:
:= by
  apply sup_le
  · intro x hx
    exact (IsIntegral.of_finite (R := ℚ) (⟨x, hx⟩ : K)).map K.val
  · apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨n, hn, heq⟩ := hx
    exact IsIntegral.of_pow hn (heq ▸ isIntegral_one)

name: IngramMello.isAlgebraic_of_mem_Kcyc
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_mem_Kcyc (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) [FiniteDimensional ℚ K]
    {x : ℂ} (hx : x ∈ Kcyc K) : IsAlgebraic ℚ x
proof:
:=
  (mem_algebraicClosure_iff).mp (Kcyc_le_algebraicClosure K hx)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalOver_mem_Kcyc
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.evalOver_mem_Kcyc {r : ℕ} (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
    (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (hx : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (x i : ℂ))
    (F : AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ)) : MvLaurent.evalOver K x F ∈ Kcyc K
proof:
:=
  MvLaurent.evalHom_map_mem_Kcyc K F x hx

name: IngramMello.exists_uniform_W_bound_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_W_bound_torsion (hIB : IngramBound) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ), FiniteDimensional ℚ K → ∀ r : ℕ,
      ∀ (a : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ))
        (A : (AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ))[X]),
      A.Monic → A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a) →
      ∀ x : Fin r → ℂˣ, (∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (x i : ℂ)) →
      IsPCF (monicCentred d (fun i => MvLaurent.evalOver K x (a i))) → ∀ l j : ℕ,
        let α := (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * MvLaurent.evalOver K x (W A (monicCentred d a) l j)
        IsBoundedAlgInt B α ∧ α ∈ Kcyc K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, B, hB, hb⟩ := exists_uniform_W_bound hIB hd
  refine ⟨D, hD, B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro K hK r a A hA hdiv x hx hpcf l j
  let := hK
  let ev := MvLaurent.evalOver K x
  have ha : ∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (ev (a i)) :=
    fun i => isAlgebraic_of_mem_Kcyc K (MvLaurent.evalOver_mem_Kcyc K x hx (a i))
  have hdiv' : A.map ev ∣ derivative (monicCentred d (fun i => ev (a i))) := by
    rw [← map_monicCentred, derivative_map]
    exact Polynomial.map_dvd ev hdiv
  have hW : ev (W A (monicCentred d a) l j) =
      W (A.map ev) (monicCentred d (fun i => ev (a i))) l j := by
    rw [W, resM_map hA, Polynomial.map_sub, map_P, map_P, map_monicCentred]
    rfl
  constructor
  · change IsBoundedAlgInt B ((D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * ev (W A (monicCentred d a) l j))
    rw [hW]
    exact hb _ ha hpcf _ (hA.map ev) hdiv' l j
  · change (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * ev (W A (monicCentred d a) l j) ∈ Kcyc K
    exact (Kcyc K).mul_mem ((Kcyc K).toSubfield.pow_mem ((Kcyc K).natCast_mem D) (d - 1))
      (MvLaurent.evalOver_mem_Kcyc K x hx _)

name: IngramMello.exists_W_representations
statement:
theorem exists_W_representations (hIB : IngramBound) (hDZ : DvornicichZannier)
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (hK : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) :
    ∃ D : ℕ, 0 < D ∧ ∃ E : Finset ℂ, (∀ e ∈ E, e ∈ K) ∧ ∃ N : ℕ,
      ∀ r : ℕ, ∀ (a : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ))
        (A : (AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ))[X]),
      A.Monic → A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a) →
      ∀ x : Fin r → ℂˣ, (∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (x i : ℂ)) →
      IsPCF (monicCentred d (fun i => MvLaurent.evalOver K x (a i))) → ∀ l j : ℕ,
        ∃ (n : ℕ) (c ξ : Fin n → ℂ), n ≤ N ∧ (∀ i, c i ∈ E) ∧
          (∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ξ i)) ∧
          (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * MvLaurent.evalOver K x (W A (monicCentred d a) l j) =
            ∑ i, c i * ξ i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, B, -, hb⟩ := exists_uniform_W_bound_torsion hIB hd
  obtain ⟨E, hE, N, hN⟩ := hDZ K hK B
  refine ⟨D, hD, E, hE, N, ?_⟩
  intro r a A hA hdiv x hx hpcf l j
  obtain ⟨hbnd, hmem⟩ := hb K hK r a A hA hdiv x hx hpcf l j
  exact hN _ hmem hbnd.1 hbnd.2

name: IngramMello.evalOver_single_basis
statement:
theorem evalOver_single_basis {r : ℕ} (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ)
    (k : Fin r) (c : K) :
    MvLaurent.evalOver K x (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Pi.single k 1) c) = (c : ℂ) * x k
proof:
:= by
  simp [MvLaurent.evalOver, MvLaurent.evalHom_single, Pi.single_apply]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.curve_single
statement:
theorem curve_single (β : Fin r → ℤ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    curve β (single a c) = LaurentPolynomial.C c * LaurentPolynomial.T (β ⬝ᵥ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [curve, Algebra.smul_def]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.curve_single'
statement:
theorem curve_single' (β : Fin r → ℤ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (c : ℂ) :
    curve β (single a c) = (single (β ⬝ᵥ a) c : LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [curve_single, LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C_mul_T]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval₂_curve
statement:
theorem eval₂_curve (β : Fin r → ℤ) (t₀ : ℂˣ) (F : MvLaurent r) :
    LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀ (curve β F) =
      evalHom (fun j => t₀ ^ β j) F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F G hF hG => simp [hF, hG]
  | single a c =>
    rw [curve_single, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_C_mul_T, evalHom_single, RingHom.id_apply]
    congr 1
    have : t₀ ^ (β ⬝ᵥ a) = ∏ j, (t₀ ^ β j) ^ a j := by
      simp only [dotProduct, zpow_finset_sum, ← zpow_mul]
    rw [this]
    simp [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coeff_curve
statement:
theorem coeff_curve (β : Fin r → ℤ) (F : MvLaurent r) (n : ℤ) :
    (curve β F).coeff n = F.coeff.sum fun a c => if β ⬝ᵥ a = n then c else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F G hF hG =>
    rw [map_add, coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hF, hG, coeff_add,
      Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ => by simp) (fun _ _ _ => by split_ifs <;> simp)]
  | single a c =>
    rw [curve_single', coeff_single, coeff_single, Finsupp.sum_single_index (by simp),
      Finsupp.single_apply]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coeff_curve_of_injOn
statement:
theorem coeff_curve_of_injOn (β : Fin r → ℤ) (F : MvLaurent r) (a₀ : Fin r → ℤ)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ F.coeff.support, β ⬝ᵥ a = β ⬝ᵥ a₀ → a = a₀) :
    (curve β F).coeff (β ⬝ᵥ a₀) = F.coeff a₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_curve, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_eq_single a₀
    (fun b hb hne => ite_eq_right fun e => hne (h b hb e))
    (fun hnot => by simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hnot])]
  simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_dotProduct_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_dotProduct_ne_zero (s : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (hs : ∀ v ∈ s, v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ β : Fin r → ℤ, ∀ v ∈ s, β ⬝ᵥ v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let pv : (Fin r → ℤ) → Polynomial ℤ := fun v => ∑ i : Fin r, Polynomial.monomial (i : ℕ) (v i)
  have hcoeff : ∀ v (i : Fin r), (pv v).coeff i = v i := fun v i => by
    simp only [pv, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj => ite_eq_right fun e => hj (Fin.val_injective e))
      (by simp)]
    simp
  have hne : ∀ v ∈ s, pv v ≠ 0 := fun v hv h0 => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 (hs v hv)
    exact hi (by rw [← hcoeff v i, h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (s.biUnion fun v => (pv v).roots.toFinset)
  refine ⟨fun i => N ^ (i : ℕ), fun v hv h0 => hN (Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩)⟩
  rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots (hne v hv), Polynomial.IsRoot,
    ← h0, dotProduct]
  simp only [pv, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_monomial]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_curve_not_const
statement:
theorem exists_curve_not_const {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (F : ι → MvLaurent r) :
    ∃ β : Fin r → ℤ, ∀ i, NonConst (F i) →
      curve β (F i) ∉ Set.range (LaurentPolynomial.C : ℂ →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  let S : ι → Finset (Fin r → ℤ) := fun i => insert 0 (F i).coeff.support
  let s := Finset.univ.biUnion fun i =>
    (((S i) ×ˢ (S i)).filter fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2).image fun p => p.1 - p.2
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_dotProduct_ne_zero s fun v hv => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, hv⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hv
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hv
    exact sub_ne_zero.2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
  have key : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ S i, ∀ b ∈ S i, a ≠ b → β ⬝ᵥ a ≠ β ⬝ᵥ b := fun i a ha b hb hab e =>
    hβ (a - b) (Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.mem_image.2
      ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨ha, hb⟩, hab⟩, rfl⟩⟩)
      (by rw [dotProduct_sub, e, sub_self])
  refine ⟨β, fun i ⟨a, ha0, ha⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ => ?_⟩
  have haS : a ∈ S i := Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 ha)
  have h1 := coeff_curve_of_injOn β (F i) a fun b hb e =>
    not_not.1 fun hne => key i b (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hb) a haS hne e
  have h2 : β ⬝ᵥ a ≠ 0 := by
    have := key i a haS 0 (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) ha0
    rwa [dotProduct_zero] at this
  rw [← hc, ← LaurentPolynomial.single_eq_C, coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply,
    ite_eq_right (Ne.symm h2)] at h1
  exact ha h1.symm

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_laurent_eval₂_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_laurent_eval₂_ne_zero {f : LaurentPolynomial ℂ} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : ℂˣ, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, f', hf'⟩ := LaurentPolynomial.exists_T_pow f
  have hf'0 : f' ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp only [map_zero] at hf'
    exact hf (by simpa [LaurentPolynomial.isUnit_T n |>.mul_left_eq_zero] using hf'.symm)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (insert (0 : ℂ) f'.roots.toFinset)
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h => ht (h ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have htr : f'.eval t ≠ 0 := fun h => ht (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
    (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 ((Polynomial.mem_roots hf'0).2 h)))
  refine ⟨Units.mk0 t ht0, fun h => htr ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) (Units.mk0 t ht0)) hf'
  rw [LaurentPolynomial.eval₂_toLaurent, map_mul, h, zero_mul] at this
  rw [Units.val_mk0] at this
  exact this

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eq_zero_of_forall_evalHom
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_evalHom {F : MvLaurent r} (h : ∀ x : Fin r → ℂˣ, evalHom x F = 0) :
    F = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hF
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ : ∃ a₀, F.coeff a₀ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h'
    push Not at h'
    exact hF (AddMonoidAlgebra.ext (Finsupp.ext h'))
  let s := (F.coeff.support ×ˢ F.coeff.support).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) |>.image
    fun p => p.1 - p.2
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_dotProduct_ne_zero s fun v hv => by
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hv
    exact sub_ne_zero.2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
  have hc := coeff_curve_of_injOn β F a₀ fun b hb e => not_not.1 fun hne =>
    hβ (b - a₀) (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(b, a₀), Finset.mem_filter.2
      ⟨Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨hb, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 ha₀⟩, hne⟩, rfl⟩)
      (by rw [dotProduct_sub, e, sub_self])
  have hne : curve β F ≠ 0 := fun h0 => ha₀ (by rw [← hc, h0]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_laurent_eval₂_ne_zero hne
  exact ht (by rw [eval₂_curve]; exact h _)

name: IngramMello.exists_eq_critProd
statement:
theorem exists_eq_critProd {g : ℂ[X]} (hg : g.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : g.natDegree = n) :
    ∃ u : Fin n → ℂ, g = critProd u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : Multiset.card g.roots = n := by rw [IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hn]
  set L := g.roots.toList with hL
  have hlen : L.length = n := by rw [hL, Multiset.length_toList, hcard]
  refine ⟨fun i => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i), ?_⟩
  have hofn : List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)) = L := by
    apply List.ext_get (by simp [hlen])
    intro m h₁ h₂
    simp
  have hprod : (g.roots.map fun a => X - C a).prod = g := by
    have := C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C (p := g) IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree
    rwa [hg.leadingCoeff, C_1, one_mul] at this
  unfold critProd
  rw [← List.prod_ofFn]
  have hmap : List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => X - C (L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)))
      = L.map (fun a => X - C a) := by
    calc List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => X - C (L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)))
        = (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)).map (fun a => X - C a) :=
          by rw [List.map_ofFn]; rfl
      _ = L.map (fun a => X - C a) := by rw [hofn]
  rw [hmap, ← Multiset.prod_coe, ← Multiset.map_coe, hL, Multiset.coe_toList, hprod]

name: IngramMello.exists_ingram_local_arch
statement:
theorem exists_ingram_local_arch (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ κ : ℝ, 0 < κ ∧ ∀ (c : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) (i : Fin (d - 1)),
      ∃ j, κ * ‖c i‖ ^ d ≤ ‖(Phi d c).eval (c j)‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, Fc, he, hFc⟩ := exists_certificate d hd
  set A : ℝ := ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ m ∈ (Fc i j).support, ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i j).coeff m)‖ with hA
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by positivity
  refine ⟨1 / (1 + A), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro c i
  have hFbound : ∀ i j (x : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ), (∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ 1) →
      ‖MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i j)‖
        ≤ ∑ m ∈ (Fc i j).support, ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i j).coeff m)‖ := by
    intro i j x hx
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq]
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun m _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul]
    calc _ ≤ ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i j).coeff m)‖ * 1 := by
          gcongr
          rw [norm_prod]
          exact Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun k _ => norm_nonneg _)
            (fun k _ => by rw [norm_pow]; exact pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hx k))
      _ = _ := mul_one _
  by_cases hci : c i = 0
  · exact ⟨i, by rw [hci, norm_zero, zero_pow (by omega), mul_zero]; exact norm_nonneg _⟩
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))).Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
  obtain ⟨i₀, -, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => ‖c k‖) hne
  have hci₀ : c i₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hci
    have := hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm this (norm_nonneg _))
  have hci₀' : 0 < ‖c i₀‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hci₀
  set x : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ := fun k => c k * (c i₀)⁻¹ with hx
  have hcx : ∀ k, c k = c i₀ * x k := fun k => by rw [hx]; simp only; field_simp
  have hx1 : ∀ k, ‖x k‖ ≤ 1 := fun k => by
    rw [hx]; simp only
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, mul_inv_le_iff₀ hci₀', one_mul]
    exact hi₀ k (Finset.mem_univ k)
  have hxi₀ : x i₀ = 1 := by rw [hx]; simp only; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hci₀
  have hcert : (1 : ℂ) = ∑ j, MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j) * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := by
    have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (hFc i₀)
    rw [map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, hxi₀, one_pow, map_sum] at this
    simpa [aeval_G] using this
  have hhom : ∀ j, (Phi d c).eval (c j) = c i₀ ^ d * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := by
    intro j
    have hc : c = fun k => c i₀ * x k := funext hcx
    calc (Phi d c).eval (c j) = (Phi d fun k => c i₀ * x k).eval (c i₀ * x j) := by
          rw [← hcx j, ← hc]
      _ = c i₀ ^ d * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := Phi_eval_smul d (by omega) x (c i₀) (x j)
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hlt : ∀ j, ‖(Phi d x).eval (x j)‖ < 1 / (1 + A) := by
    intro j
    have h1 := hcon j
    rw [hhom j, norm_mul, norm_pow] at h1
    have h2 : 1 / (1 + A) * ‖c i‖ ^ d ≤ 1 / (1 + A) * ‖c i₀‖ ^ d := by
      gcongr
      exact hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h3 := lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
    have hpos : 0 < ‖c i₀‖ ^ d := pow_pos hci₀' d
    rw [mul_comm (1 / (1 + A))] at h3
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left h3 hpos.le
  have hsum : ‖∑ j, MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j) * (Phi d x).eval (x j)‖ < 1 := by
    calc ‖∑ j, MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j) * (Phi d x).eval (x j)‖
        ≤ ∑ j, ‖MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j)‖ * ‖(Phi d x).eval (x j)‖ := by
          refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
          simp only [norm_mul, le_refl]
      _ ≤ ∑ j, (∑ m ∈ (Fc i₀ j).support, ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i₀ j).coeff m)‖)
            * (1 / (1 + A)) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => mul_le_mul (hFbound i₀ j x hx1) (hlt j).le
            (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (∑ j, ∑ m ∈ (Fc i₀ j).support, ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i₀ j).coeff m)‖)
            * (1 / (1 + A)) := by rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ ≤ A * (1 / (1 + A)) := by
          gcongr
          exact Finset.single_le_sum
            (f := fun i => ∑ j, ∑ m ∈ (Fc i j).support, ‖algebraMap ℚ ℂ ((Fc i j).coeff m)‖)
            (fun i _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_univ i₀)
      _ < 1 := by rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_one (by positivity)]; linarith
  rw [← hcert, norm_one] at hsum
  exact lt_irrefl _ hsum

name: IngramMello.norm_eval_ge
proof:
:= by
  set n := f.natDegree with hn
  have hn2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hd
  have hz4 : 4 ≤ ‖z‖ := by nlinarith
  have hz1 : 1 ≤ ‖z‖ := by linarith
  have hS : ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f.coeff k * z ^ k‖ ≤ n * B * ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖f.coeff k * z ^ k‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, B * ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun k hk => by
          rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
          have hk' := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
          exact mul_le_mul (hcoef k hk') (pow_le_pow_right₀ hz1 (by omega)) (by positivity)
            (by linarith)
      _ = n * B * ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hzn : ‖z‖ ^ n = ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) * ‖z‖ := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
  have hfz : f.eval z = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f.coeff k * z ^ k) + z ^ n := by
    rw [eval_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ, hf.coeff_natDegree, one_mul]
  have h1 : ‖z‖ ^ n - ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f.coeff k * z ^ k‖ ≤ ‖f.eval z‖ := by
    rw [hfz, ← norm_pow]
    have := norm_sub_le ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f.coeff k * z ^ k) + z ^ n)
      (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f.coeff k * z ^ k)
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    linarith
  have h2 : ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) * (‖z‖ / 2) ≤ ‖f.eval z‖ := by
    have hnB : (n : ℝ) * B ≤ ‖z‖ / 2 := by linarith
    calc ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) * (‖z‖ / 2) ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) * (‖z‖ - n * B) := by
          gcongr; linarith
      _ = ‖z‖ ^ n - n * B * ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := by rw [hzn]; ring
      _ ≤ ‖f.eval z‖ := by linarith [h1, hS]
  have h3 : 2 * ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) * (‖z‖ / 2) := by
    have : ‖z‖ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := by
      calc ‖z‖ = ‖z‖ ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
        _ ≤ ‖z‖ ^ (n - 1) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hz1 (by omega)
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: IngramMello.norm_iterate_of_escape
proof:
:= by
  have hn2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ f.natDegree := by exact_mod_cast hd
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    show ‖z‖ < ‖f.eval z‖
    have := norm_eval_ge hf hd hB hcoef hz
    nlinarith
  | succ m ih =>
    have hz' : 2 * f.natDegree * B ≤ ‖(fun w => f.eval w)^[m + 1] z‖ := ih.1.trans ih.2.le
    refine ⟨hz', ?_⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ (m + 1)]
    have := norm_eval_ge hf hd hB hcoef hz'
    nlinarith

name: IngramMello.not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escape_arch
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun n : ℕ => (fun w => aeval w f)^[n] z := by
    have hsm : StrictMono fun n : ℕ => ‖(fun w => f.eval w)^[n] z‖ :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => (norm_iterate_of_escape hf hd hB hcoef hz n).2
    intro n m hnm
    apply hsm.injective
    simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval] at hnm
    simp only [hnm]
  exact Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj

name: IngramMello.norm_iterate_lt_of_hasFiniteOrbit
statement:
theorem norm_iterate_lt_of_hasFiniteOrbit {f : ℂ[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, ‖f.coeff k‖ ≤ B) {c : ℂ}
    (hc : HasFiniteOrbit f c) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(fun w => f.eval w)^[n] c‖ < 2 * f.natDegree * B
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escape_arch hf hd hB hcoef h
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit at hc ⊢
  refine hc.subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨m + n, ?_⟩
  simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval, Function.iterate_add_apply]

name: IngramMello.norm_coeff_critProd_le
statement:
theorem norm_coeff_critProd_le {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → ℂ), (∀ i, ‖u i‖ ≤ R) →
      ∀ k, ‖(critProd u).coeff k‖ ≤ (2 * R) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro u _ k
    unfold critProd
    simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, pow_zero, coeff_one]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro u hu k
    have hsplit : critProd u = (X - C (u 0)) * critProd (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ) := by
      unfold critProd
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    have hih := ih (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ) (fun i => hu i.succ)
    have hpos : 0 ≤ (2 * R) ^ n := by positivity
    rw [hsplit, sub_mul, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, pow_succ]
    refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans ?_
    have hX : ‖(X * critProd (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ)).coeff k‖ ≤ (2 * R) ^ n := by
      rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [coeff_X_mul_zero, norm_zero]; exact hpos
      · rw [coeff_X_mul]; exact hih k
    have hC : ‖u 0 * (critProd (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ)).coeff k‖ ≤ R * (2 * R) ^ n := by
      rw [norm_mul]; exact mul_le_mul (hu 0) (hih k) (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    nlinarith

name: IngramMello.exists_arch_bound
statement:
theorem exists_arch_bound (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ a : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ, IsPCF (monicCentred d a) →
      (∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ M) ∧
      ∀ c : ℂ, (derivative (monicCentred d a)).IsRoot c → ∀ n m : ℕ,
        ‖(fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[n] c -
          (fun z => (monicCentred d a).eval z)^[m] c‖ ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, hloc⟩ := exists_ingram_local_arch d hd
  have hd2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast hd
  set R₁ : ℝ := max 1 (d * 2 ^ d / κ) with hR₁
  have hR₁1 : 1 ≤ R₁ := le_max_left _ _
  set C₁ : ℝ := 2 * R₁ with hC₁
  have hC₁1 : 1 ≤ C₁ := by linarith
  set C₂ : ℝ := d * (2 * C₁) ^ (d - 1) with hC₂
  have hC₂0 : 0 ≤ C₂ := by positivity
  set Ma : ℝ := R₁ + R₁ ^ d + d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d + C₂ with hMa
  set B : ℝ := max 1 Ma with hB
  have hB1 : 1 ≤ B := le_max_left _ _
  have hMaB : Ma ≤ B := le_max_right _ _
  refine ⟨4 * d * B, ?_⟩
  intro a hpcf
  set f := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀m, hg₀deg, hfg₀⟩ := exists_derivative_monicCentred hd a
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_critProd hg₀m hg₀deg
  have hc : derivative f = C (d : ℂ) * critProd c := hfg₀
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℂ, f.eval p = p := by
    have hdeg : 0 < (f - X).degree := by
      rw [degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt]
      · rw [degree_eq_natDegree hfm.ne_zero, hfdeg]; exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
      · rw [degree_X, degree_eq_natDegree hfm.ne_zero, hfdeg]
        exact_mod_cast (show 1 < d by omega)
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Complex.exists_root hdeg
    exact ⟨p, by rw [IsRoot, eval_sub, eval_X, sub_eq_zero] at hp; exact hp⟩
  have horb : ∀ i, HasFiniteOrbit f (c i) := fun i =>
    hpcf (c i) (by
      rw [hc, IsRoot, eval_mul, (critProd_isRoot_iff c (c i)).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩, mul_zero])
  obtain ⟨hgPhi, hgm, hgdeg⟩ := conjFixed_monicCentred hd a c p hc hp
  obtain ⟨hg0, hgcoef⟩ := conjFixed_coeff hd a c p hc hp
  set g := conjFixed f p with hg
  set c' : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ := fun i => c i - p with hc'
  have horb' : ∀ j, HasFiniteOrbit g (c' j) := fun j =>
    hasFiniteOrbit_conjFixed f p (c j) (horb j)
                              
  have hstep1 : ∀ i, ‖c' i‖ ≤ R₁ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcon
    have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))).Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
    obtain ⟨i₀, -, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => ‖c' k‖) hne
    set R := ‖c' i₀‖ with hR
    have hRR₁ : R₁ < R := lt_of_lt_of_le hi (hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i))
    have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := hR₁1.trans hRR₁.le
    have hRκ : d * 2 ^ d < κ * R := by
      have : d * 2 ^ d / κ < R := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hRR₁
      rw [div_lt_iff₀ hκ] at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hloc c' i₀
    have hgj : d * κ * R ^ d ≤ ‖g.eval (c' j)‖ := by
      rw [hgPhi, eval_mul, eval_C, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj (by positivity)
    set Bg : ℝ := d * (2 * R) ^ (d - 1) with hBg
    have hBg1 : 1 ≤ Bg := by
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * R) ^ (d - 1) := one_le_pow₀ (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    have hcoefg : ∀ k < g.natDegree, ‖g.coeff k‖ ≤ Bg := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hgdeg] at hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [hg0, norm_zero]; exact zero_le_one.trans hBg1
      · have h1 := hgcoef k
        have hprod : ‖(critProd c').coeff k‖ ≤ (2 * R) ^ (d - 1) :=
          norm_coeff_critProd_le hR1 c' (fun i => hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)) k
        have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(k : ℂ) + 1‖ := by
          rw [show ((k : ℂ) + 1) = ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring, Complex.norm_natCast]
          exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos k
        have h2 : ‖g.coeff (k + 1)‖ * ‖(k : ℂ) + 1‖ ≤ Bg := by
          rw [← norm_mul, h1, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, hBg]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity)
        calc ‖g.coeff (k + 1)‖ = ‖g.coeff (k + 1)‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
          _ ≤ ‖g.coeff (k + 1)‖ * ‖(k : ℂ) + 1‖ := by gcongr
          _ ≤ Bg := h2
    have hthr : 2 * (g.natDegree : ℝ) * Bg ≤ ‖g.eval (c' j)‖ := by
      refine le_trans ?_ hgj
      rw [hgdeg, hBg]
      have hRd : R ^ d = R * R ^ (d - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      have h2d : (2 : ℝ) ^ d = 2 * 2 ^ (d - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      rw [hRd, mul_pow]
      have hRpos : 0 ≤ R ^ (d - 1) := by positivity
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hRκ.le hRpos
      rw [h2d] at this
      nlinarith
    have := norm_iterate_lt_of_hasFiniteOrbit hgm (by rw [hgdeg]; exact hd) hBg1 hcoefg
      (horb' j) 1
    simp only [Function.iterate_one] at this
    exact absurd hthr (not_le.mpr this)
                                         
  have hsum := sum_crit_eq_zero hd a c hc
  have hp' : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * p = -∑ i, c' i := by
    simp only [hc', Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hpR : ‖p‖ ≤ R₁ := by
    have hd1 : (0 : ℝ) < ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d - 1 by omega)
    have h1 : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖p‖ ≤ ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R₁ := by
      calc ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ‖p‖ = ‖((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) * p‖ := by
            rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast]
        _ = ‖∑ i, c' i‖ := by rw [hp', norm_neg]
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (d - 1), ‖c' i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
        _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin (d - 1), R₁ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hstep1 i
        _ = ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * R₁ := by
            rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h1 hd1
  have hcC₁ : ∀ i, ‖c i‖ ≤ C₁ := by
    intro i
    have : c i = c' i + p := by simp [hc']
    rw [this]
    calc ‖c' i + p‖ ≤ ‖c' i‖ + ‖p‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ R₁ + R₁ := add_le_add (hstep1 i) hpR
      _ = C₁ := by rw [hC₁]; ring
                                 
  have hak : ∀ k : Fin (d - 1), 1 ≤ (k : ℕ) → ‖a k‖ ≤ C₂ := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, (k : ℕ) = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hder := coeff_derivative f j
    rw [hc, coeff_C_mul, ← hj, monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a k.isLt, Fin.eta] at hder
    have hprod : ‖(critProd c).coeff j‖ ≤ (2 * C₁) ^ (d - 1) :=
      norm_coeff_critProd_le hC₁1 c hcC₁ j
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ‖(j : ℂ) + 1‖ := by
      rw [show ((j : ℂ) + 1) = ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring, Complex.norm_natCast]
      exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos j
    have h2 : ‖a k‖ * ‖(j : ℂ) + 1‖ ≤ C₂ := by
      rw [← norm_mul, ← hder, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, hC₂]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by positivity)
    calc ‖a k‖ = ‖a k‖ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ ≤ ‖a k‖ * ‖(j : ℂ) + 1‖ := by gcongr
      _ ≤ C₂ := h2
  have haM : ∀ k, ‖a k‖ ≤ Ma := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) = 0
    · have ha0 : a k = p - p ^ d - ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, a i * p ^ (i : ℕ) := by
        have h := hp
        rw [hf, monicCentred_eval, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ k), hk, pow_zero,
          mul_one] at h
        linear_combination h
      rw [ha0]
      have hsum : ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, a i * p ^ (i : ℕ)‖ ≤ d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d := by
        calc _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, ‖a i * p ^ (i : ℕ)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
          _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, C₂ * R₁ ^ d := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => by
              have hi1 : 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := by
                rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hi with ⟨hne, -⟩
                by_contra h
                exact hne (Fin.ext (by rw [hk]; omega))
              rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
              exact mul_le_mul (hak i hi1)
                ((pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hpR _).trans
                  (pow_le_pow_right₀ hR₁1 (by have := i.isLt; omega)))
                (by positivity) hC₂0
          _ = (Finset.univ.erase k).card * (C₂ * R₁ ^ d) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ d * (C₂ * R₁ ^ d) := by
              gcongr
              calc (Finset.univ.erase k).card
                  ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))).card :=
                    Finset.card_le_card (Finset.erase_subset _ _)
                _ ≤ d := by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]; exact Nat.sub_le d 1
          _ = d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d := by ring
      calc ‖p - p ^ d - ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, a i * p ^ (i : ℕ)‖
          ≤ ‖p - p ^ d‖ + ‖∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, a i * p ^ (i : ℕ)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ (‖p‖ + ‖p ^ d‖) + d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d := add_le_add (norm_sub_le _ _) hsum
        _ ≤ (R₁ + R₁ ^ d) + d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d := by
            gcongr
            rw [norm_pow]; exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hpR _
        _ ≤ Ma := by rw [hMa]; linarith
    · have := hak k (by omega)
      rw [hMa]
      have : 0 ≤ R₁ + R₁ ^ d + d * C₂ * R₁ ^ d := by positivity
      linarith
  refine ⟨fun k => (haM k).trans (hMaB.trans ?_), ?_⟩
  · nlinarith
  · intro c₀ hc₀ n m
    have hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, ‖f.coeff k‖ ≤ B := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hfdeg] at hk
      by_cases hk' : k < d - 1
      · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a hk']; exact (haM _).trans hMaB
      · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero a (by omega) hk, norm_zero]; linarith
    have horb₀ : HasFiniteOrbit f c₀ := hpcf c₀ hc₀
    have h1 := norm_iterate_lt_of_hasFiniteOrbit hfm (by rw [hfdeg]; exact hd) hB1 hcoef horb₀ n
    have h2 := norm_iterate_lt_of_hasFiniteOrbit hfm (by rw [hfdeg]; exact hd) hB1 hcoef horb₀ m
    rw [hfdeg] at h1 h2
    calc _ ≤ ‖(fun z => f.eval z)^[n] c₀‖ + ‖(fun z => f.eval z)^[m] c₀‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ 4 * d * B := by linarith

name: IngramMello.exists_sum_pow_of_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem exists_sum_pow_of_mem_adjoin (S : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {ξ β : ℂ} (hξ : ξ ^ n ∈ S) (hβ : β ∈ Algebra.adjoin S {ξ}) :
    ∃ a : Fin n → ℂ, (∀ j, a j ∈ S) ∧ β = ∑ j, a j * ξ ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval] at hβ
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hβ
  change aeval ξ f = β at hf
  let q : S[X] := X ^ n - C ⟨ξ ^ n, hξ⟩
  have hq : q.Monic := monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hn.ne'
  have hdeg : q.natDegree = n := natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  have hq1 : q ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg natDegree h
    rw [hdeg, natDegree_one] at this
    omega
  have hrdeg : (f %ₘ q).natDegree < n := by
    simpa [hdeg] using natDegree_modByMonic_lt f hq hq1
  have hroot : aeval ξ q = 0 := by simp [q]
  refine ⟨fun j => ((f %ₘ q).coeff j : ℂ), fun j => ((f %ₘ q).coeff j).2, ?_⟩
  rw [← hf, ← aeval_modByMonic_eq_self_of_root hroot, aeval_eq_sum_range' hrdeg]
  change (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((f %ₘ q).coeff j : ℂ) * ξ ^ j) = _
  exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => ((f %ₘ q).coeff j : ℂ) * ξ ^ j) n).symm

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.zpow_mem_subalgebra
statement:
theorem IsRootOfUnityC.zpow_mem_subalgebra {S : Subalgebra ℤ ℂ} {ξ : ℂ}
    (hξ : IsRootOfUnityC ξ) (hmem : ξ ∈ S) (k : ℤ) : ξ ^ k ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hpow⟩ := hξ
  have hne : ξ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h, hn.ne'] at hpow
  have hreduce : ξ ^ k = ξ ^ (k % (n : ℤ)).toNat := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Int.emod_add_mul_ediv k n]
    rw [zpow_add₀ hne, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hpow, one_zpow, mul_one,
      ← zpow_natCast, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ (by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'))]
  rw [hreduce]
  exact S.pow_mem hmem _

name: IngramMello.zetaC_mul_pow
statement:
theorem zetaC_mul_pow {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    zetaC (n * m) ^ n = zetaC m
proof:
:= by
  have h := zetaC_dvd (Nat.mul_pos hn hm) (dvd_mul_left m n)
  simpa [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hm, Nat.mul_div_cancel _ hm] using h.symm

name: IngramMello.exists_cycInt_sum_pow
statement:
theorem exists_cycInt_sum_pow {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt (n * m)) :
    ∃ a : Fin n → ℂ, (∀ j, a j ∈ cycInt m) ∧
      β = ∑ j, a j * zetaC (n * m) ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : cycInt (n * m) ≤
      (Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC (n * m)}).restrictScalars ℤ := by
    rw [cycInt, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rw [hx]
    change zetaC (n * m) ∈ Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC (n * m)}
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)
  apply exists_sum_pow_of_mem_adjoin (cycInt m) hn _ (hle hβ)
  rw [zetaC_mul_pow hn hm]
  exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)

name: IngramMello.zetaC_mul_eq_of_coprime
statement:
theorem zetaC_mul_eq_of_coprime {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcop : n.Coprime m) :
    zetaC (n * m) = zetaC m ^ Nat.gcdA n m * zetaC n ^ Nat.gcdB n m
proof:
:= by
  have hne := (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot (Nat.mul_pos hn hm)).ne_zero (Nat.mul_pos hn hm).ne'
  have hexp : (n : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA n m + (m : ℤ) * Nat.gcdB n m = 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hcop.gcd_eq_one, Nat.cast_one]
  calc zetaC (n * m)
      = zetaC (n * m) ^ ((n : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA n m + (m : ℤ) * Nat.gcdB n m) := by
          rw [hexp, zpow_one]
    _ = (zetaC (n * m) ^ n) ^ Nat.gcdA n m *
        (zetaC (n * m) ^ m) ^ Nat.gcdB n m := by
          rw [zpow_add₀ hne, zpow_mul, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    _ = _ := by rw [zetaC_mul_pow hn hm, Nat.mul_comm n m, zetaC_mul_pow hm hn]

name: IngramMello.exists_cycInt_sum_pow_of_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_cycInt_sum_pow_of_coprime {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcop : n.Coprime m) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt (n * m)) :
    ∃ a : Fin n → ℂ, (∀ j, a j ∈ cycInt m) ∧
      β = ∑ j, a j * zetaC n ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let S := (Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC n}).restrictScalars ℤ
  have hbase : cycInt m ≤ S := by
    intro x hx
    change x ∈ Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC n}
    exact (Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC n}).algebraMap_mem ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hroot : zetaC n ∈ S := by
    change zetaC n ∈ Algebra.adjoin (cycInt m) {zetaC n}
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have hle : cycInt (n * m) ≤ S := by
    rw [cycInt, Algebra.adjoin_le_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    rw [zetaC_mul_eq_of_coprime hn hm hcop]
    exact S.mul_mem (hbase (zetaC_zpow_mem_cycInt hm _))
      (IsRootOfUnityC.zpow_mem_subalgebra
        ⟨n, hn, (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hn).pow_eq_one⟩ hroot _)
  apply exists_sum_pow_of_mem_adjoin (cycInt m) hn _ (hle hβ)
  rw [(zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hn).pow_eq_one]
  exact (cycInt m).one_mem

name: IngramMello.sum_zetaC_pow
statement:
theorem sum_zetaC_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, zetaC n ^ (j : ℕ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  exact (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot (by omega)).geom_sum_eq_zero hn

name: IngramMello.sum_sub_mul_zetaC_pow
statement:
theorem sum_sub_mul_zetaC_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (a : Fin n → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    ∑ j, (a j - c) * zetaC n ^ (j : ℕ) = ∑ j, a j * zetaC n ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_zetaC_pow hn,
    mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: IngramMello.exists_cycInt_sum_pow_sub
statement:
theorem exists_cycInt_sum_pow_sub {n m : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hcop : n.Coprime m) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt (n * m)) :
    ∃ a : Fin n → ℂ, (∀ j, a j ∈ cycInt m) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin n, (∀ j, a j - a i ∈ cycInt m) ∧
        β = ∑ j, (a j - a i) * zetaC n ^ (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hsum⟩ := exists_cycInt_sum_pow_of_coprime (by omega) hm hcop hβ
  exact ⟨a, ha, fun i => ⟨fun j => (cycInt m).sub_mem (ha j) (ha i),
    hsum.trans (sum_sub_mul_zetaC_pow hn a (a i)).symm⟩⟩

name: IngramMello.cycField_isCyclotomicExtension
statement:
theorem cycField_isCyclotomicExtension {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsCyclotomicExtension {n} ℚ (cycField n)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  exact (IntermediateField.isCyclotomicExtension_singleton_iff_eq_adjoin
    n ℚ ℂ (cycField n) (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hn)).2 rfl

name: IngramMello.mem_cycInt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cycInt_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {β : ℂ} :
    β ∈ cycInt n ↔ β ∈ cycField n ∧ IsIntegral ℤ β
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hβ
    exact ⟨mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt hβ, isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt hn hβ⟩
  · rintro ⟨hβ, hint⟩
    have : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
    have := cycField_isCyclotomicExtension hn
    let ξ : cycField n := IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (zetaC n)
    have hξ : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ n :=
      IsPrimitiveRoot.coe_submonoidClass_iff.mp (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hn)
    have hβint : IsIntegral ℤ (⟨β, hβ⟩ : cycField n) :=
      (isIntegral_algHom_iff ((cycField n).val.restrictScalars ℤ)
        Subtype.val_injective).1 hint
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
      (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isIntegralClosure_adjoin_singleton hξ).isIntegral_iff.1 hβint
    have hy' : ((y : cycField n) : ℂ) = β := congrArg Subtype.val hy
    have hmem : β ∈ (Algebra.adjoin ℤ {ξ}).map ((cycField n).val.restrictScalars ℤ) :=
      ⟨y, y.2, hy'⟩
    simpa [ξ, cycInt] using hmem

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_weight_ne
statement:
theorem exists_weight_ne (a : Fin r → ℤ) (S : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (ha : a ∉ S) :
    ∃ w : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ ℂ, ∀ b ∈ S, w b ≠ w a
proof:
:= by
  let v : S → (Fin r → ℂ) := fun b j => ((b.1 j - a j : ℤ) : ℂ)
  have hv : ∀ b, v b ≠ 0 := by
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩ h
    apply ha
    have : b = a := funext fun j => by
      have := congrFun h j
      simp only [v, Pi.zero_apply, Int.cast_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
    exact this ▸ hb
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_ne_zero (K := ℂ) v hv
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun b => f fun j => (b j : ℂ), map_zero' := ?_, map_add' := ?_ }, ?_⟩
  · convert f.map_zero using 2; funext j; simp
  · intro b c
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    funext j
    simp
  · intro b hb h
    apply hf ⟨b, hb⟩
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk] at h
    have : v ⟨b, hb⟩ = (fun j => (b j : ℂ)) - fun j => (a j : ℂ) := by
      funext j
      simp [v]
    rw [this, map_sub, h, sub_self]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.hajos
statement:
theorem hajos (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (T : ℕ) (F : MvLaurent r) (hF : F ≠ 0)
    (hT : F.coeff.support.card ≤ T) : F ∉ maxIdeal x ^ T
proof:
:= by
  induction T generalizing F with
  | zero =>
    exact absurd (by simpa using hT) hF
  | succ T ih =>
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : F.coeff.support.Nonempty := by
      rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, Finsupp.support_eq_empty, coeff_eq_zero]
      exact hF
    set S := F.coeff.support.erase a
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_weight_ne a S (Finset.notMem_erase a _)
    set G := eulerD w F - w a • F with hG
    have hGcoeff : ∀ b, G.coeff b = (w b - w a) * F.coeff b := fun b => by
      simp [hG, sub_mul]
    have hGmem : G ∈ maxIdeal x ^ T :=
      sub_mem (eulerD_mem_pow w _ T F hmem)
        (Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right T.le_succ hmem))
    have hGsupp : G.coeff.support ⊆ S := fun b hb => by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hGcoeff] at hb
      refine Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨fun hba => ?_, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (right_ne_zero_of_mul hb)⟩
      subst hba
      simp at hb
    by_cases hG0 : G = 0
    · 
      have hS : S = ∅ := Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun b hb => by
        have h := hGcoeff b
        rw [hG0, coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact hw b hb h
        · exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hb) h
      have hsupp : F.coeff.support = {a} := by
        rw [← Finset.insert_erase ha]
        simp [S] at hS
        simp [hS]
      obtain ⟨hFa, hFeq⟩ := Finsupp.support_eq_singleton.1 hsupp
      have hF1 : F ∈ maxIdeal x := Ideal.pow_le_self T.succ_ne_zero hmem
      have : F = single a (F.coeff a) := by
        rw [← coeff_inj, coeff_single]
        exact hFeq
      rw [this] at hF1
      exact single_notMem_maxIdeal x a hFa hF1
    · refine ih G hG0 ?_ hGmem
      calc G.coeff.support.card ≤ S.card := Finset.card_le_card hGsupp
        _ = F.coeff.support.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem ha
        _ ≤ T := by omega

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.card_support_sum_single_le
statement:
theorem card_support_sum_single_le {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fin r → ℤ) (β : Fin n → ℂ) :
    (∑ i, single (a i) (β i)).coeff.support.card ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_sum]
  calc (∑ i, (single (a i) (β i)).coeff).support.card
      ≤ (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i => (single (a i) (β i)).coeff.support).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (Finsupp.support_finsetSum)
    _ ≤ ∑ i, (single (a i) (β i)).coeff.support.card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, 1 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => by
        rw [coeff_single]
        exact (Finset.card_le_card Finsupp.support_single_subset).trans (by simp)
    _ = n := by simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.hajos_sum
statement:
theorem hajos_sum (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) {T n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ T) (a : Fin n → Fin r → ℤ)
    (β : Fin n → ℂ) (hF : ∑ i, single (a i) (β i) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ i, single (a i) (β i) ∉ maxIdeal x ^ T
proof:
:=
  hajos x T _ hF ((card_support_sum_single_le a β).trans hn)

name: IngramMello.charPow_add
statement:
theorem charPow_add (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (v w : Fin r → ℤ) :
    charPow x (v + w) = charPow x v * charPow x w
proof:
:= by
  simp [charPow, zpow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: IngramMello.charPow_neg
statement: theorem charPow_neg (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (v : Fin r → ℤ) : charPow x (-v) = (charPow x v)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [charPow, zpow_neg, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]

name: IngramMello.charPow_sub
statement:
theorem charPow_sub (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (v w : Fin r → ℤ) :
    charPow x (v - w) = charPow x v / charPow x w
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, charPow_add, charPow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: IngramMello.charPow_zsmul
statement:
theorem charPow_zsmul (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (N : ℤ) (v : Fin r → ℤ) :
    charPow x (N • v) = charPow x v ^ N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [charPow, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← Finset.prod_zpow]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm]

name: IngramMello.coe_charPow
statement:
theorem coe_charPow (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (v : Fin r → ℤ) :
    (charPow x v : ℂ) = ∏ j, (x j : ℂ) ^ v j
proof:
:= by
  simp [charPow, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.finset_prod
statement:
theorem IsRootOfUnityC.finset_prod {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, IsRootOfUnityC (f i)) : IsRootOfUnityC (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨1, one_pos, by simp⟩
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_insert hi]
    exact (h i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)).mul
      (ih fun j hj => h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))

name: IngramMello.isRootOfUnityC_charPow
statement:
theorem isRootOfUnityC_charPow (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (hx : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ))
    (v : Fin r → ℤ) : IsRootOfUnityC (charPow x v : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_charPow]
  exact IsRootOfUnityC.finset_prod _ _ fun j _ => (hx j).zpow _

name: IngramMello.exists_pair_of_vanishing_sum
statement:
theorem exists_pair_of_vanishing_sum (S : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (q : (Fin r → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hq : ∀ e ∈ S, q e ≠ 0) (hS : S.Nonempty) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ)
    (hx : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ))
    (hsum : ∑ e ∈ S, (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0) :
    ∃ e ∈ S, ∃ f ∈ S, e ≠ f ∧
      charPow x e ^ S.card.factorial = charPow x f ^ S.card.factorial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set 𝓢 := S.powerset.filter
    (fun S' => S'.Nonempty ∧ ∑ e ∈ S', (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0) with h𝓢
  have hS𝓢 : S ∈ 𝓢 := by
    rw [h𝓢, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    exact ⟨subset_rfl, hS, hsum⟩
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hminS₀⟩ := Finset.exists_min_image 𝓢 Finset.card ⟨S, hS𝓢⟩
  rw [h𝓢, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hS₀
  obtain ⟨hS₀S, hS₀ne, hS₀sum⟩ := hS₀
  have hmin : ∀ I ⊆ S₀, I.Nonempty → ∑ e ∈ I, (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0 → I = S₀ := by
    intro I hI hIne hIsum
    have hI𝓢 : I ∈ 𝓢 := by
      rw [h𝓢, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
      exact ⟨hI.trans hS₀S, hIne, hIsum⟩
    exact Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hI (hminS₀ I hI𝓢)
  
  obtain ⟨e₀, he₀⟩ := hS₀ne
  have hcharne : ∀ e, (charPow x e : ℂ) ≠ 0 := fun e => (charPow x e).ne_zero
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀, hf₀e⟩ : ∃ f ∈ S₀, f ≠ e₀ := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have hsing : S₀ = {e₀} := Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨he₀, h⟩
    rw [hsing, Finset.sum_singleton] at hS₀sum
    exact mul_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hq e₀ (hS₀S he₀)) (hcharne e₀) hS₀sum
  
  set k := S₀.card with hk
  let σ : S₀ ≃ Fin k := S₀.equivFin
  let ζ : Fin k → ℂ := fun i => (charPow x (σ.symm i : Fin r → ℤ) : ℂ)
  let c : Fin k → ℚ := fun i => q (σ.symm i)
  have hζ : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ζ i) := fun i => isRootOfUnityC_charPow x hx _
  have hsum' : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0 := by
    rw [← hS₀sum, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort S₀]
    exact Equiv.sum_comp σ.symm (fun e : S₀ => (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ))
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin k => (σ.symm i : Fin r → ℤ)) :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp σ.symm.injective
  have hmin' : ∀ I : Finset (Fin k), I.Nonempty → ∑ i ∈ I, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0 → I = univ := by
    intro I hI hIsum
    set I' := I.image (fun i : Fin k => (σ.symm i : Fin r → ℤ)) with hI'
    have hI'sub : I' ⊆ S₀ := by
      intro e he
      rw [hI', Finset.mem_image] at he
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := he
      exact (σ.symm i).2
    have hI'sum : ∑ e ∈ I', (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0 := by
      rw [hI', Finset.sum_image (fun i _ j _ h => hinj h)]
      exact hIsum
    have heq := hmin I' hI'sub (hI.image _) hI'sum
    have hcard : I.card = k := by
      rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injective I hinj, ← hI', heq]
    exact Finset.eq_univ_of_card I (by simpa using hcard)
  have hm := mann c ζ hζ hsum' hmin' (σ ⟨e₀, he₀⟩) (σ ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩)
  simp only [ζ, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at hm
  refine ⟨e₀, hS₀S he₀, f₀, hS₀S hf₀, hf₀e.symm, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : k.factorial ∣ S.card.factorial :=
    Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial (Finset.card_le_card hS₀S)
  apply Units.ext
  rw [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ht, pow_mul, pow_mul, hm]

name: IngramMello.exists_character_of_infinite
statement:
theorem exists_character_of_infinite (S : Finset (Fin r → ℤ)) (q : (Fin r → ℤ) → ℚ)
    (hq : ∀ e ∈ S, q e ≠ 0) (hS : S.Nonempty) (T : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ)) (hT : T.Infinite)
    (htor : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ))
    (hvan : ∀ x ∈ T, ∑ e ∈ S, (q e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0) :
    ∃ v : Fin r → ℤ, v ≠ 0 ∧ {x ∈ T | charPow x v = 1}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set N : ℤ := ((S.card.factorial : ℕ) : ℤ) with hN
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  apply hT
  set F := (S ×ˢ S).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) with hF
  have hsub : T ⊆ ⋃ p ∈ (F : Set ((Fin r → ℤ) × (Fin r → ℤ))),
      {x ∈ T | charPow x (N • (p.1 - p.2)) = 1} := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨e, he, f, hf, hef, h⟩ :=
      exists_pair_of_vanishing_sum S q hq hS x (htor x hx) (hvan x hx)
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂]
    refine ⟨(e, f), ?_, hx, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_coe, hF, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
      exact ⟨⟨he, hf⟩, hef⟩
    · rw [charPow_zsmul, charPow_sub, div_zpow, hN, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, h, div_self']
  refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet F) fun p hp => hcon _ ?_) hsub
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, hF, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
  exact smul_ne_zero (by rw [hN]; exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_ne_zero _)) (sub_ne_zero.2 hp.2)

name: IngramMello.fiberMat_mulVec_succAbove
statement:
theorem fiberMat_mulVec_succAbove {r' : ℕ} (v : Fin (r' + 1) → ℤ) (i₀ : Fin (r' + 1))
    (u : Fin r' → ℤ) (k : Fin r') : (fiberMat v i₀).mulVec u (i₀.succAbove k) = v i₀ * u k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, fiberMat, Fin.succAbove_ne, ite_false,
    Fin.succAbove_right_inj]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

name: IngramMello.fiberMat_mulVec_injective
statement:
theorem fiberMat_mulVec_injective {r' : ℕ} (v : Fin (r' + 1) → ℤ) (i₀ : Fin (r' + 1))
    (hm : v i₀ ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (fiberMat v i₀).mulVec
proof:
:= by
  intro u u' h
  funext k
  have := congrFun h (i₀.succAbove k)
  rw [fiberMat_mulVec_succAbove, fiberMat_mulVec_succAbove] at this
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hm this

name: IngramMello.exists_fiber_param
statement:
theorem exists_fiber_param {r' : ℕ} (v : Fin (r' + 1) → ℤ) (i₀ : Fin (r' + 1)) (hm : 0 < v i₀)
    (x : Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ) (hx : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ)) (hv : charPow x v = 1) :
    ∃ ζ ∈ (Polynomial.nthRoots (v i₀).toNat (1 : ℂ)).toFinset, ∃ w : Fin r' → ℂ,
      (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k)) ∧
        cosetPt (fiberEta i₀ ζ) (fiberMat v i₀) w = fun j => (x j : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := (v i₀).toNat with hmdef
  have hm' : (m : ℤ) = v i₀ := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hm.le
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  have hw : ∀ k, ∃ w : ℂ, w ^ m = (x (i₀.succAbove k) : ℂ) := fun k =>
    IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq _ hm0
  choose w hw using hw
  have hw0 : ∀ k, w k ≠ 0 := fun k h => by
    have := hw k
    rw [h, zero_pow hm0.ne'] at this
    exact (x _).ne_zero this.symm
  have hwtor : ∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k) := fun k => by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hx (i₀.succAbove k)
    exact ⟨m * n, Nat.mul_pos hm0 hn, by rw [pow_mul, hw k, h]⟩
  set ζ := (x i₀ : ℂ) * ∏ k, w k ^ v (i₀.succAbove k) with hζdef
  have hζ : ζ ^ m = 1 := by
    have h1 : (charPow x v : ℂ) = 1 := by rw [hv, Units.val_one]
    rw [coe_charPow, Fin.prod_univ_succAbove _ i₀] at h1
    have hk : ∀ k, (w k ^ v (i₀.succAbove k)) ^ m =
        (x (i₀.succAbove k) : ℂ) ^ v (i₀.succAbove k) := fun k => by
      rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, hw k]
    rw [hζdef, mul_pow, ← Finset.prod_pow]
    simp_rw [hk]
    rw [← hm', zpow_natCast] at h1
    exact h1
  refine ⟨ζ, ?_, w, hw0, hwtor, ?_⟩
  · rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_nthRoots hm0]
    exact hζ
  funext j
  rcases Fin.eq_self_or_eq_succAbove i₀ j with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · simp only [cosetPt, fiberEta, fiberMat, ite_true, zpow_neg, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
    rw [hζdef, mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun k _ => zpow_ne_zero _ (hw0 k)), mul_one]
  · simp only [cosetPt, fiberEta, fiberMat, Fin.succAbove_ne, ite_false,
      Fin.succAbove_right_inj, one_mul]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single k]
    · simp only [ite_true]
      rw [← hm', zpow_natCast, hw k]
    · intro b _ hb
      simp [Ne.symm hb]
    · simp

name: IngramMello.exists_fiber_cover
statement:
theorem exists_fiber_cover {r' : ℕ} (v : Fin (r' + 1) → ℤ) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (F : Finset (Fin (r' + 1) → ℂ)) (B : Matrix (Fin (r' + 1)) (Fin r') ℤ),
      (∀ η ∈ F, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j)) ∧ Function.Injective B.mulVec ∧
      ∀ x : Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ, (∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ)) → charPow x v = 1 →
        ∃ η ∈ F, ∃ w : Fin r' → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k)) ∧
          cosetPt η B w = fun j => (x j : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀'⟩ := Function.ne_iff.1 hv
  have hi₀ : v i₀ ≠ 0 := hi₀'
  
  suffices key : ∀ v : Fin (r' + 1) → ℤ, 0 < v i₀ →
      ∃ (F : Finset (Fin (r' + 1) → ℂ)) (B : Matrix (Fin (r' + 1)) (Fin r') ℤ),
        (∀ η ∈ F, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j)) ∧ Function.Injective B.mulVec ∧
        ∀ x : Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ, (∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ)) → charPow x v = 1 →
          ∃ η ∈ F, ∃ w : Fin r' → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k)) ∧
            cosetPt η B w = fun j => (x j : ℂ) by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hi₀ with hneg | hpos
    · obtain ⟨F, B, hF, hB, h⟩ := key (-v) (by show (0 : ℤ) < -v i₀; omega)
      refine ⟨F, B, hF, hB, fun x hx hxv => h x hx ?_⟩
      rw [charPow_neg, hxv, inv_one]
    · exact key v hpos
  intro v hm
  refine ⟨(Polynomial.nthRoots (v i₀).toNat (1 : ℂ)).toFinset.image (fiberEta i₀), fiberMat v i₀,
    ?_, fiberMat_mulVec_injective v i₀ hm.ne', fun x hx hxv => ?_⟩
  · intro η hη j
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at hη
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, rfl⟩ := hη
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_nthRoots (by omega)] at hζ
    simp only [fiberEta]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨(v i₀).toNat, by omega, hζ⟩
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, one_pow 1⟩
  · obtain ⟨ζ, hζ, w, hw0, hwtor, hcos⟩ := exists_fiber_param v i₀ hm x hx hxv
    exact ⟨fiberEta i₀ ζ, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hζ, w, hw0, hwtor, hcos⟩

name: IngramMello.mainStatement_of_not_isExceptional
statement:
theorem mainStatement_of_not_isExceptional (hIB : IngramBound) (hDZ : DvornicichZannier)
    (hExc : ∀ d, 2 ≤ d → ∀ K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ, FiniteDimensional ℚ K → ∀ r a T,
      ¬ IsExceptional d K r a T) : MainStatement
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro K hK d hd
  by_contra hS
  set S := {a : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ | (∀ i, a i ∈ Kcyc K) ∧ IsPCF (monicCentred d a)}
  obtain ⟨D, hD, M, hM⟩ := hIB d hd
  obtain ⟨m, e, he, hlin⟩ := exists_linearForm hDZ K hK M
  have hDne : (D : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD.ne'
  
  have hrep : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ i, ∃ y : Fin m → ℂ, (∀ j, y j = 0 ∨ IsRootOfUnityC (y j)) ∧
      (D : ℂ) * a i = ∑ j, e j * y j := by
    intro a ha i
    have halg : ∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (a i) := fun i => isAlgebraic_of_mem_Kcyc K (ha.1 i)
    have hb := (hM a halg ha.2).1 i
    exact hlin _ ((Kcyc K).mul_mem ((Kcyc K).natCast_mem D) (ha.1 i)) hb.1 hb.2
  choose! Y hY0 hYsum using hrep
  let ι := Fin (d - 1) × Fin m
  let Yf : (Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) → ι → ℂ := fun a p => Y a p.1 p.2
  
  have hSinf : Infinite S := Set.infinite_coe_iff.mpr hS
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Finite.exists_infinite_fiber
    (fun a : S => (fun p : ι => Yf a p = 0))
  set S' : Set (Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) := {a | a ∈ S ∧ ∀ p, (Yf a p = 0 ↔ P p)} with hS'
  have hS'inf : S'.Infinite := by
    refine Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun x : ((fun a : S =>
      (fun p : ι => Yf a p = 0)) ⁻¹' {P}) => (x.1.1 : Fin (d - 1) → ℂ)) ?_ ?_
    · intro x y hxy
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hxy)
    · intro x
      refine ⟨x.1.2, fun p => ?_⟩
      have h2 : (fun p : ι => Yf x.1 p = 0) = P := x.2
      exact iff_of_eq (congrFun h2 p)
  let J := {p : ι // ¬ P p}
  let r := Fintype.card J
  let σ := Fintype.equivFin J
  let coef : ι → K := fun p => ⟨e p.2 / D, K.div_mem (he _) (K.natCast_mem D)⟩
  let fam : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ) := fun i =>
    ∑ p : J, if p.1.1 = i then AddMonoidAlgebra.single (Pi.single (σ p) 1) (coef p.1) else 0
  let pt : (Fin (d - 1) → ℂ) → Fin r → ℂˣ := fun a k =>
    if h : Yf a (σ.symm k).1 ≠ 0 then Units.mk0 _ h else 1
  have hpt : ∀ a ∈ S', ∀ k, (pt a k : ℂ) = Yf a (σ.symm k).1 := by
    intro a ha k
    have : Yf a (σ.symm k).1 ≠ 0 := fun h0 => (σ.symm k).2 ((ha.2 _).1 h0)
    simp [pt, this]
  have heval : ∀ a ∈ S', (fun i => MvLaurent.evalOver K (pt a) (fam i)) = a := by
    intro a ha
    funext i
    simp only [fam, map_sum, apply_ite (MvLaurent.evalOver K (pt a)), map_zero,
      evalOver_single_basis, hpt a ha, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    let g : ι → ℂ := fun p => if p.1 = i then ((coef p : K) : ℂ) * Yf a p else 0
    change ∑ p : J, g p.1 = a i
    have hsplit := Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype P g
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun p _ => by simp [g, (ha.2 p.1).2 p.2]), zero_add] at hsplit
    change ∑ p : {p : ι // ¬ P p}, g p.1 = a i
    rw [hsplit, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb => by simp [g, hb])
      (by simp)]
    simp only [g, ite_true, coef, Yf]
    have h1 := hYsum a ha.1 i
    simp_rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← Finset.sum_div, ← h1]
    field_simp
  have hinj : Set.InjOn pt S' := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [← heval a ha, ← heval b hb, hab]
  refine hExc d hd K hK r fam (pt '' S') ⟨hS'inf.image hinj, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ k
    rw [hpt a ha]
    exact (hY0 a ha.1 _ _).resolve_left fun h0 => (σ.symm k).2 ((ha.2 _).1 h0)
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rw [heval a ha]
    exact ha.1.2
  · rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ hab
    have : a = b := by
      have := hab
      simp only at this
      rw [heval a ha, heval b hb] at this
      exact this
    rw [this]

name: IngramMello.exists_eq_critProd_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem exists_eq_critProd_of_isAlgClosed {K : Type*} [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] {g : K[X]}
    (hg : g.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : g.natDegree = n) : ∃ u : Fin n → K, g = critProd u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : Multiset.card g.roots = n := by rw [IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree, hn]
  set L := g.roots.toList with hL
  have hlen : L.length = n := by rw [hL, Multiset.length_toList, hcard]
  refine ⟨fun i => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i), ?_⟩
  have hofn : List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)) = L := by
    apply List.ext_get (by simp [hlen])
    intro m h₁ h₂
    simp
  have hprod : (g.roots.map fun a => X - C a).prod = g := by
    have := C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C (p := g) IsAlgClosed.card_roots_eq_natDegree
    rwa [hg.leadingCoeff, C_1, one_mul] at this
  unfold critProd
  rw [← List.prod_ofFn]
  have hmap : List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => X - C (L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)))
      = L.map (fun a => X - C a) := by
    calc List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => X - C (L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)))
        = (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => L.get (Fin.cast hlen.symm i)).map (fun a => X - C a) :=
          by rw [List.map_ofFn]; rfl
      _ = L.map (fun a => X - C a) := by rw [hofn]
  rw [hmap, ← Multiset.prod_coe, ← Multiset.map_coe, hL, Multiset.coe_toList, hprod]

name: IngramMello.exists_eq_critProd_of_roots_mem
statement:
theorem exists_eq_critProd_of_roots_mem {E L : Type*} [Field E] [Field L] [IsAlgClosed L]
    [Algebra E L] {g : E[X]} (hg : g.Monic) {n : ℕ} (hn : g.natDegree = n)
    (hroots : ∀ z : L, (g.map (algebraMap E L)).IsRoot z → z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap E L)) :
    ∃ c : Fin n → E, g = critProd c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_eq_critProd_of_isAlgClosed (hg.map (algebraMap E L))
    (by rw [hg.natDegree_map, hn])
  have hmem : ∀ i, u i ∈ Set.range (algebraMap E L) := fun i =>
    hroots (u i) (by rw [hu]; exact (critProd_isRoot_iff u (u i)).mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  choose c hc using hmem
  refine ⟨c, Polynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap E L).injective ?_⟩
  rw [hu, map_critProd]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact (hc i).symm

name: IngramMello.roots_critProd
statement:
theorem roots_critProd {F : Type*} [Field F] {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → F) :
    (critProd u).roots = Finset.univ.val.map u
proof:
:= by
  unfold critProd
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod,
    show (fun i => X - C (u i)) = (fun a => X - C a) ∘ u from rfl, ← Multiset.map_map,
    roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C]

name: IngramMello.algebraMap_W_eq_prod
statement:
theorem algebraMap_W_eq_prod {R₀ E L : Type*} [CommRing R₀] [Field E] [Field L] [IsAlgClosed L]
    [Algebra E L] [Algebra R₀ E] [Algebra R₀ L] [IsScalarTower R₀ E L]
    {A : R₀[X]} (hA : A.Monic) (f : R₀[X]) {k : ℕ} (cA : Fin k → E)
    (hcA : A.map (algebraMap R₀ E) = critProd cA) (q : ℕ) :
    algebraMap R₀ E (W A f q 0) =
      ∏ j, ((fun z => (f.map (algebraMap R₀ E)).eval z)^[q] (cA j) - cA j)
proof:
:= by
  apply (algebraMap E L).injective
  have hAL : A.map (algebraMap R₀ L) = critProd ((algebraMap E L) ∘ cA) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R₀ E L, ← Polynomial.map_map, hcA, map_critProd]
  have hfL : f.map (algebraMap R₀ L) = (f.map (algebraMap R₀ E)).map (algebraMap E L) := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, ev_W hA f (algebraMap R₀ L) q 0, hAL, roots_critProd,
    Multiset.map_map, ← Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, map_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, map_sub]
  rw [iterate_eval_map, hfL]

name: IngramMello.exists_escapes_of_nonconst
statement:
theorem exists_escapes_of_nonconst {w₀ w₁ : Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))}
    (hw : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
    (hnc : ∃ i, a i ∉ Set.range (LaurentPolynomial.C : ℂ →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ))
    (c : Fin (d - 1) → E)
    (hc : derivative (monicCentred d fun i => algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (a i))
      = C (d : E) * critProd c)
    (p : E) (hp : (monicCentred d fun i => algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (a i)).eval p = p) :
    ∃ i, Escapes w₀ (monicCentred d fun i => algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (a i)) (c i) ∨
      Escapes w₁ (monicCentred d fun i => algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (a i)) (c i)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hbound⟩ := exists_local_coeff_bound_of_not_escapes d hd
  have h0 := hbound E _ w₀ _ c p hc hp fun i => (hcon i).1
  have h1 := hbound E _ w₁ _ c p hc hp fun i => (hcon i).2
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hnc
  apply hi
  obtain ⟨hN0, hN1⟩ := hw.val_natCast hN.ne'
  refine hw.mem_range_C_of_le_one ?_ ?_
  · have := h0 i; rwa [Valuation.map_mul, hN0, one_mul] at this
  · have := h1 i; rwa [Valuation.map_mul, hN1, one_mul] at this

name: IngramMello.superAttracting_of_algebraic
statement: theorem superAttracting_of_algebraic : SuperAttracting
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d hd a hnc
  set f : (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)[X] := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
  haveI : IsIntegrallyClosed (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) := isIntegrallyClosed_laurentPolynomial ℂ
  obtain ⟨g, hgm, hgdeg, hfg⟩ := exists_derivative_monicCentred hd a
  obtain ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, hBm, hgAB, hnm, hBdvd, hAroots⟩ := exists_infiniteOrbitFactor f g hgm
  set ι : LaurentPolynomial ℂ →+* GenericField :=
    (algebraMap Kt GenericField).comp (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt) with hι
  have hι_eq : ι = algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) GenericField :=
    (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt GenericField).symm
  have hιinj : Function.Injective ι :=
    (algebraMap Kt GenericField).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective _ Kt)
  haveI : CharZero GenericField := charZero_of_injective_ringHom (ι.comp LaurentPolynomial.C).injective
  have hFL : (fun w : GenericField => aeval w f) = fun z => (f.map ι).eval z := by
    funext w; rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, hι_eq]
  refine ⟨A, hAm, fun c hc => ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hfg, hgAB, map_mul, map_mul, hc, zero_mul, mul_zero]
  · have hcA : (A.map ι).IsRoot c := by rwa [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← hι_eq] at hc
    unfold HasFiniteOrbit
    rw [hFL]
    exact hAroots c hcA
                      
  haveI : CharZero (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) :=
    charZero_of_injective_ringHom (LaurentPolynomial.C (R := ℂ)).injective
  set h : Kt[X] := (derivative f * (f - X)).map (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt) with hh
  have hf'ne : derivative f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hfg]
    exact mul_ne_zero (C_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))) hgm.ne_zero
  have hfXne : f - X ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have h1 := congrArg natDegree (sub_eq_zero.mp h0)
    rw [hfdeg, natDegree_X] at h1
    omega
  have hhne : h ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hh, Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (IsFractionRing.injective _ Kt)]
    exact mul_ne_zero hf'ne hfXne
  set E : IntermediateField Kt GenericField :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin Kt (h.rootSet GenericField) with hE
  haveI : FiniteDimensional Kt E := by
    haveI := (h.rootSet_finite GenericField).to_subtype
    apply IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    intro x hx
    rw [mem_rootSet] at hx
    exact IsAlgebraic.isIntegral ⟨h, hx.1, hx.2⟩
  haveI : IsScalarTower (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E GenericField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt GenericField,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt E,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Kt E GenericField]
  haveI : CharZero E := charZero_of_injective_ringHom
    ((algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E).comp LaurentPolynomial.C).injective
  have hιE : ∀ x, algebraMap E GenericField (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) = ι x := by
    intro x
    rw [hι_eq, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
  have hmapE : ∀ P : (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)[X],
      (P.map (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E)).map (algebraMap E GenericField) = P.map ι := by
    intro P
    rw [Polynomial.map_map, hι_eq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E GenericField]
  have hmemE : ∀ z : GenericField, ((derivative f * (f - X)).map ι).IsRoot z →
      z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap E GenericField) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzE : z ∈ E := by
      refine IntermediateField.subset_adjoin Kt _ ?_
      rw [mem_rootSet]
      refine ⟨hhne, ?_⟩
      rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq_eval_map, hh, Polynomial.map_map, ← hι]
      exact hz
