    exact ⟨⟨z, hzE⟩, rfl⟩
                                                 
  set fE := f.map (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E) with hfE
  have hfE' : fE = monicCentred d fun i => algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (a i) := by
    rw [hfE, hf, map_monicCentred]
  have hfEm : fE.Monic := hfm.map _
  have hfEdeg : fE.natDegree = d := by rw [hfE, hfm.natDegree_map, hfdeg]
  set gE := g.map (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E) with hgE
  have hgEm : gE.Monic := hgm.map _
  obtain ⟨c, hcg⟩ : ∃ c : Fin (d - 1) → E, gE = critProd c := by
    refine exists_eq_critProd_of_roots_mem (L := GenericField) hgEm
      (by rw [hgE, hgm.natDegree_map, hgdeg])
      fun z hz => ?_
    refine hmemE z ?_
    rw [hgE, hmapE] at hz
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul, IsRoot, eval_mul, hfg, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, hz.eq_zero,
      mul_zero, zero_mul]
  have hcE : derivative fE = C (d : E) * critProd c := by
    rw [hfE, derivative_map, hfg, Polynomial.map_mul, map_C, map_natCast, ← hgE, hcg]
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : E, fE.eval p = p := by
    have hdeg : ((f - X).map ι).degree ≠ 0 := by
      rw [degree_eq_natDegree (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff hιinj |>.mpr hfXne),
        natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hιinj]
      have : (f - X).natDegree = d := by
        rw [natDegree_sub_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt (by rw [natDegree_X, hfdeg]; omega), hfdeg]
      rw [this]
      exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 by omega)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root _ hdeg
    obtain ⟨pE, hpE⟩ := hmemE z (by
      rw [Polynomial.map_mul, IsRoot, eval_mul, hz.eq_zero, mul_zero])
    refine ⟨pE, (algebraMap E GenericField).injective ?_⟩
    have h1 := iterate_eval_map (algebraMap E GenericField) fE pE 1
    simp only [Function.iterate_one] at h1
    rw [h1, hpE, hfE, hmapE]
    have := hz.eq_zero
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, map_X, eval_sub, eval_X, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
                                                       
  obtain ⟨w₀, w₁, hw⟩ := exists_twoPlaces E
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_escapes_of_nonconst hw hd a hnc c (hfE' ▸ hcE) p (hfE' ▸ hp)
  rw [← hfE'] at hi₀
                                
  set AE := A.map (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E) with hAE
  have hAEm : AE.Monic := hAm.map _
  obtain ⟨cA, hcA⟩ : ∃ cA : Fin A.natDegree → E, AE = critProd cA := by
    refine exists_eq_critProd_of_roots_mem (L := GenericField) hAEm
      (by rw [hAE, hAm.natDegree_map]) fun z hz => ?_
    refine hmemE z ?_
    rw [hAE, hmapE] at hz
    rw [Polynomial.map_mul, IsRoot, eval_mul, hfg, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, hgAB,
      Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, hz.eq_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  set FE := fun z : E => fE.eval z with hFE
  set FL := fun z : GenericField => (f.map ι).eval z with hFL'
  have hiter : ∀ (x : E) (k : ℕ), algebraMap E GenericField (FE^[k] x) = FL^[k] (algebraMap E GenericField x) := by
    intro x k
    rw [hFE, hFL', iterate_eval_map, hfE, hmapE]
  have hAroot_cA : ∀ j, (A.map ι).IsRoot (algebraMap E GenericField (cA j)) := by
    intro j
    rw [← hmapE, ← hAE, hcA, map_critProd]
    exact (critProd_isRoot_iff _ _).mpr ⟨j, rfl⟩
  have hper : ∀ j (g' : ℕ), 0 < g' → FE^[g'] (cA j) ≠ cA j := by
    intro j g' hg' heq
    apply hAroots _ (hAroot_cA j)
    have := congrArg (algebraMap E GenericField) heq
    rw [hiter] at this
    exact finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq FL (show g' ≠ 0 by omega) this
  
  have hesc_i₀ : Escapes w₀ fE (c i₀) ∨ Escapes w₁ fE (c i₀) := hi₀
  have hci₀_inf : ¬ HasFiniteOrbit fE (c i₀) := by
    rcases hesc_i₀ with h | h
    · exact not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escapes w₀ hfEm (by rw [hfEdeg]; exact hd) h
    · exact not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escapes w₁ hfEm (by rw [hfEdeg]; exact hd) h
  have hci₀_A : AE.IsRoot (c i₀) := by
    refine isRoot_of_iterate_ne hgAB hBdvd (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E) ?_ ?_
    · rw [← hgE, hcg]; exact (critProd_isRoot_iff _ _).mpr ⟨i₀, rfl⟩
    · intro heq
      apply hci₀_inf
      unfold HasFiniteOrbit
      have : (fun w : E => aeval w fE) = FE := by funext w; rw [hFE, coe_aeval_eq_eval]
      rw [this]
      exact finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq FE hnm heq
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := (critProd_isRoot_iff cA (c i₀)).mp (hcA ▸ hci₀_A)
                                                                      
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hno : ∀ q, 0 < q → ∀ t₀ : ℂˣ,
      LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀ (W A f q 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq t₀ h0
    have hev := ev_W hAm f (LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀) q 0
    rw [h0, eq_comm, Multiset.prod_eq_zero_iff, Multiset.mem_map] at hev
    obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hc₀0⟩ := hev
    simp only [Function.iterate_zero, id_eq, sub_eq_zero] at hc₀0
    exact hcon t₀ c₀ q hq ((mem_roots (hAm.map _).ne_zero).mp hc₀) hc₀0
  have hWeq : ∀ q, algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (W A f q 0) = ∏ j, (FE^[q] (cA j) - cA j) :=
    fun q => algebraMap_W_eq_prod (L := GenericField) hAm f cA hcA q
  have hWne : ∀ q, 0 < q → W A f q 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq h0
    have := hWeq q
    rw [h0, map_zero, eq_comm, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at this
    obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := this
    exact hper j q hq (sub_eq_zero.mp hj)
  let wv : Fin 2 → Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := ![w₀, w₁]
  refine false_of_escapes_of_prod_val_eq_one hfEm (by rw [hfEdeg]; exact hd)
    (ι := Fin A.natDegree × Fin 2)
    (fun jb => wv jb.2) (fun jb => cA jb.1) (fun jb g' hg' => hper jb.1 g' hg') ?_ ?_
  · rcases hesc_i₀ with h | h
    · exact ⟨(j₀, 0), by simpa [wv, hj₀] using h⟩
    · exact ⟨(j₀, 1), by simpa [wv, hj₀] using h⟩
  · intro q hq
    rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_two]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    simp only [wv, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    rw [← map_prod, ← map_prod, ← hWeq]
    exact hw.val_mul_val_eq_one_of_forall_eval_ne_zero (hWne q hq) (hno q hq)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.monomialMap_one_comp
statement:
theorem monomialMap_one_comp {t : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (C : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin r) ℤ) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) :
    monomialMap 1 C (monomialMap 1 B w) = monomialMap 1 (C * B) w
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have h := prod_monomialMap_zpow 1 B w (C i)
  simp only [Pi.one_apply, one_zpow, Finset.prod_const_one, one_mul] at h
  simp only [monomialMap, Pi.one_apply, one_mul] at h ⊢
  rw [h]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  congr 1
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.mul_apply, mul_comm]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.det_transpose_mul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_transpose_mul_ne_zero (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) : (B.transpose * B).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hGv⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.2 h
  apply hv
  apply hB
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_zero]
  have : (B.mulVec v) ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec v) = 0 :=
    calc (B.mulVec v) ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec v) = (Matrix.vecMul v B.transpose) ⬝ᵥ (B.mulVec v) := by
          rw [Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
      _ = v ⬝ᵥ (B.transpose.mulVec (B.mulVec v)) := (Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec ..).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hGv, dotProduct_zero]
  exact dotProduct_self_eq_zero.1 this

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_left_inverse_smul
statement:
theorem exists_left_inverse_smul (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) :
    ∃ (C : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin r) ℤ) (N : ℤ), N ≠ 0 ∧ C * B = N • (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℤ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(B.transpose * B).adjugate * B.transpose, (B.transpose * B).det,
    det_transpose_mul_ne_zero B hB, by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.adjugate_mul]⟩

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.monomialMap_one_smul_one
statement:
theorem monomialMap_one_smul_one (N : ℤ) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) (k : Fin s) :
    monomialMap 1 (N • (1 : Matrix (Fin s) (Fin s) ℤ)) w k = w k ^ N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialMap, Pi.one_apply, one_mul, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single k (fun j _ hj => by simp [Ne.symm hj]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.isOfFinOrder_of_zpow
statement:
theorem isOfFinOrder_of_zpow {G : Type*} [Group G] {g : G} {N : ℤ} (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (h : IsOfFinOrder (g ^ N)) : IsOfFinOrder g
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : IsOfFinOrder (g ^ ((N.natAbs * N.natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
    rw [Int.natAbs_mul_self, zpow_mul]
    exact h.zpow
  rw [zpow_natCast, isOfFinOrder_pow] at h2
  exact h2.resolve_right (by simpa using hN)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.isOfFinOrder_of_monomialMap
statement:
theorem isOfFinOrder_of_monomialMap (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) (hη : ∀ j, IsOfFinOrder (η j)) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ)
    (hw : ∀ j, IsOfFinOrder (monomialMap η B w j)) (k : Fin s) : IsOfFinOrder (w k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, N, hN, hCB⟩ := exists_left_inverse_smul B hB
  have h1 : ∀ j, IsOfFinOrder (monomialMap 1 B w j) := fun j => by
    have : monomialMap 1 B w j = (η j)⁻¹ * monomialMap η B w j := by
      simp [monomialMap]
    rw [this]
    exact (hη j).inv.mul (hw j)
  have h2 : IsOfFinOrder (monomialMap 1 C (monomialMap 1 B w) k) := by
    have hC : ∀ y : Fin r → ℂˣ, monomialMap 1 C y k = ∏ j, y j ^ C k j := fun y => by
      simp [monomialMap]
    rw [hC, ← CommGroup.mem_torsion]
    exact Subgroup.prod_mem _ fun j _ => (CommGroup.mem_torsion _).2 (h1 j).zpow
  rw [monomialMap_one_comp, hCB, monomialMap_one_smul_one] at h2
  exact isOfFinOrder_of_zpow hN h2

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.isRootOfUnityC_iff_isOfFinOrder
statement: theorem isRootOfUnityC_iff_isOfFinOrder (u : ℂˣ) : IsRootOfUnityC (u : ℂ) ↔ IsOfFinOrder u
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one, IsRootOfUnityC]
  refine exists_congr fun n => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
  rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_eq_one]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval_eq_evalHom
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.eval_eq_evalHom {r : ℕ} (P : MvLaurent r) (u : Fin r → ℂ) (hu : ∀ j, u j ≠ 0) :
    MvLaurent.eval P u = MvLaurent.evalHom (fun j => Units.mk0 (u j) (hu j)) P
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvLaurent.evalHom_apply]
  rfl

name: IngramMello.cosetPt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cosetPt_ne_zero {r s : ℕ} {η : Fin r → ℂ} (hη : ∀ j, η j ≠ 0)
    (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ) {w : Fin s → ℂ} (hw : ∀ k, w k ≠ 0) (j : Fin r) :
    cosetPt η B w j ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero (hη j) (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun k _ => zpow_ne_zero _ (hw k))

name: IngramMello.exists_zpow_eq
statement: theorem exists_zpow_eq {m : ℤ} (hm : m ≠ 0) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) : ∃ t : ℂ, t ≠ 0 ∧ t ^ m = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq m with h | h
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq c (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hm)
    refine ⟨t, fun h0 => hc ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← ht, h0, zero_pow (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hm).ne']
    · rw [h, zpow_natCast, ht]
  · obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq c⁻¹ (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hm)
    refine ⟨t, fun h0 => hc ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← inv_inv c, ← ht, h0, zero_pow (Int.natAbs_pos.2 hm).ne', inv_zero]
    · rw [h, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ht, inv_inv]

name: IngramMello.infinite_of_laurent_dense
statement:
theorem infinite_of_laurent_dense {r s : ℕ} (hs : 0 < s) {η : Fin r → ℂ} (hη : ∀ j, η j ≠ 0)
    {B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ} (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec) (T : Set (Fin r → ℂ))
    (hdense : ∀ P : MvLaurent r,
        (∀ w : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) → cosetPt η B w ∈ T →
          MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt η B w) = 0) →
        ∀ w : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) → MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt η B w) = 0) :
    (T ∩ cosetSet η B).Infinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hfin
  let k₀ : Fin s := ⟨0, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, B j k₀ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    have : B.mulVec (Pi.single k₀ 1) = B.mulVec 0 := by
      funext j
      simp [h j]
    exact one_ne_zero (congrFun (hB this) k₀ |>.symm.trans (by simp) |>.symm)
  let F := hfin.toFinset
  let P : MvLaurent r := ∏ p ∈ F, (single (Pi.single j 1) 1 - single 0 (p j))
  have hP : ∀ u : Fin r → ℂ, (hu : ∀ i, u i ≠ 0) →
      MvLaurent.eval P u = ∏ p ∈ F, (u j - p j) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [MvLaurent.eval_eq_evalHom P u hu, map_prod]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    rw [map_sub, MvLaurent.evalHom_single, MvLaurent.evalHom_single]
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  have hvan := hdense P fun w hw hT => by
    rw [hP _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη B hw)]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (hfin.mem_toFinset.2 ⟨hT, w, hw, rfl⟩) (sub_self _)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (insert (0 : ℂ) (F.image fun p => p j))
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := fun h => hz (h ▸ Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht⟩ := exists_zpow_eq hj (div_ne_zero hz0 (hη j))
  let w : Fin s → ℂ := Function.update (fun _ => 1) k₀ t
  have hw : ∀ k, w k ≠ 0 := fun k => by
    by_cases hk : k = k₀
    · subst hk; simp [w, ht0]
    · simp [w, hk]
  have hcj : cosetPt η B w j = z := by
    simp only [cosetPt]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single k₀ (fun k _ hk => by simp [w, hk]) (by simp)]
    simp [w, ht, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (hη j)]
  have := hvan w hw
  rw [hP _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη B hw), Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff] at this
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpz⟩ := this
  rw [hcj, sub_eq_zero] at hpz
  exact hz (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨p, hp, hpz.symm⟩))

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_eq
statement:
theorem monicCentred_eq (d : ℕ) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    monicCentred d a = X ^ d + ∑ i : Fin (d - 1), C (a i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)
proof: := rfl

name: IngramMello.natDegree_monicCentred_sum_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_monicCentred_sum_le (d : ℕ) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    (∑ i : Fin (d - 1), C (a i) * X ^ (i : ℕ)).natDegree ≤ d - 2
proof:
:= by
  refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i _ => ?_
  exact (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (by omega)

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_monic
statement:
theorem monicCentred_monic [Nontrivial R] {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    (monicCentred d a).Monic
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicCentred_eq]
  apply monic_X_pow_add
  have := natDegree_monicCentred_sum_le d a
  rw [← degree_X_pow (R := R) d]
  exact degree_lt_degree (by rw [natDegree_X_pow]; omega)

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_natDegree
statement:
theorem monicCentred_natDegree [Nontrivial R] {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    (monicCentred d a).natDegree = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicCentred_eq, natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt, natDegree_X_pow]
  rw [natDegree_X_pow]
  have := natDegree_monicCentred_sum_le d a
  omega

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_coeff_of_lt
statement:
theorem monicCentred_coeff_of_lt {d : ℕ} (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) {k : ℕ} (hk : k < d - 1) :
    (monicCentred d a).coeff k = a ⟨k, hk⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicCentred_eq, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right (by omega), zero_add, finsetSum_coeff]
  simp only [coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨k, hk⟩]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [ite_eq_right]
    intro h
    apply hb
    exact Fin.ext h.symm
  · simp

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero {d : ℕ} (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) {k : ℕ} (hk : d - 1 ≤ k)
    (hk' : k < d) : (monicCentred d a).coeff k = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [monicCentred_eq, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_right (by omega), zero_add, finsetSum_coeff]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  rw [coeff_C_mul_X_pow, ite_eq_right]
  have := i.isLt
  omega

name: IngramMello.monicCentred_eval
statement:
theorem monicCentred_eval {d : ℕ} (a : Fin (d - 1) → R) (z : R) :
    (monicCentred d a).eval z = z ^ d + ∑ i : Fin (d - 1), a i * z ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [monicCentred_eq, eval_finsetSum]

name: IngramMello.critProd_isRoot_iff
statement:
theorem critProd_isRoot_iff {F : Type*} [Field F] {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → F) (r : F) :
    (critProd u).IsRoot r ↔ ∃ i, u i = r
proof:
:= by
  unfold critProd
  rw [IsRoot, eval_prod, Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and, eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, sub_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, h⟩ => ⟨i, h.symm⟩, fun ⟨i, h⟩ => ⟨i, h.symm⟩⟩

name: IngramMello.sum_crit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_crit_eq_zero {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F] {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    (a : Fin (d - 1) → F) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F)
    (hc : derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c) : ∑ i, c i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (derivative (monicCentred d a)).coeff (d - 2) = 0 := by
    rw [coeff_derivative, monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero a (by omega) (by omega), zero_mul]
  rw [hc, coeff_C_mul] at h1
  have h2 : (critProd c).coeff (d - 2) = -∑ i, c i := by
    unfold critProd
    have := prod_X_sub_C_coeff_card_pred (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))) c
      (by simp; omega)
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, show d - 1 - 1 = d - 2 by omega] at this
    exact this
  rw [h2, mul_neg, neg_eq_zero, mul_eq_zero] at h1
  rcases h1 with h1 | h1
  · exact absurd h1 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega))
  · exact h1

name: IngramMello.vbdd_of_dvd
statement:
theorem vbdd_of_dvd {M M' : ℕ} (h : M ∣ M') {x : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) :
    v ((M' : F) * x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm (M : F), mul_assoc, Valuation.map_mul]
  calc v (t : F) * v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v t) hx
    _ = 1 := mul_one 1

name: IngramMello.vbdd_add
statement:
theorem vbdd_add {M : ℕ} {x y : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) (hy : v ((M : F) * y) ≤ 1) :
    v ((M : F) * (x + y)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_add]; exact v.map_add_le hx hy

name: IngramMello.vbdd_neg
statement: theorem vbdd_neg {M : ℕ} {x : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) : v ((M : F) * (-x)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_neg, Valuation.map_neg]; exact hx

name: IngramMello.vbdd_sub
statement:
theorem vbdd_sub {M : ℕ} {x y : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) (hy : v ((M : F) * y) ≤ 1) :
    v ((M : F) * (x - y)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact vbdd_add v hx (vbdd_neg v hy)

name: IngramMello.vbdd_mul
statement:
theorem vbdd_mul {M M' : ℕ} {x y : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) (hy : v ((M' : F) * y) ≤ 1) :
    v (((M * M' : ℕ) : F) * (x * y)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, show (M : F) * M' * (x * y) = ((M : F) * x) * ((M' : F) * y) by ring,
    Valuation.map_mul]
  calc v ((M : F) * x) * v ((M' : F) * y) ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul' hx hy
    _ = 1 := mul_one 1

name: IngramMello.vbdd_pow
statement:
theorem vbdd_pow {M : ℕ} {x : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    v (((M ^ n : ℕ) : F) * x ^ n) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_pow, ← mul_pow, Valuation.map_pow]
  exact pow_le_one' hx n

name: IngramMello.vbdd_sum
statement:
theorem vbdd_sum {M : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {x : ι → F}
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, v ((M : F) * x i) ≤ 1) : v ((M : F) * ∑ i ∈ s, x i) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact v.map_sum_le hx

name: IngramMello.vbdd_natCast
statement: theorem vbdd_natCast {M : ℕ} (n : ℕ) : v ((M : F) * (n : F)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_mul]; exact val_natCast_le_one v _

name: IngramMello.vbdd_one_of_le
statement: theorem vbdd_one_of_le {M : ℕ} {x : F} (hx : v x ≤ 1) : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Valuation.map_mul]
  calc v (M : F) * v x ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v M) hx
    _ = 1 := mul_one 1

name: IngramMello.le_inv_of_vbdd
statement:
theorem le_inv_of_vbdd [CharZero F] {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {x : F} (hx : v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1) :
    v x ≤ (v (M : F))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : v (M : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne'
  rw [Valuation.map_mul] at hx
  calc v x = (v (M : F))⁻¹ * (v (M : F) * v x) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hM0]
    _ ≤ (v (M : F))⁻¹ * 1 := mul_le_mul_right hx _
    _ = (v (M : F))⁻¹ := mul_one _

name: IngramMello.vbdd_of_le_inv
statement:
theorem vbdd_of_le_inv [CharZero F] {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) {x : F} (hx : v x ≤ (v (M : F))⁻¹) :
    v ((M : F) * x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : v (M : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne'
  rw [Valuation.map_mul]
  calc v (M : F) * v x ≤ v (M : F) * (v (M : F))⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_right hx _
    _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hM0

name: IngramMello.one_le_inv_val_natCast
statement: theorem one_le_inv_val_natCast [CharZero F] {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) : 1 ≤ (v (M : F))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : v (M : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hM.ne'
  rw [one_le_inv₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr hM0)]
  exact val_natCast_le_one v M

name: IngramMello.val_coeff_critProd_le
statement:
theorem val_coeff_critProd_le {R : Γ₀} (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → F), (∀ i, v (u i) ≤ R) → ∀ k, v ((critProd u).coeff k) ≤ R ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro u _ k
    unfold critProd
    simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty, pow_zero, coeff_one]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro u hu k
    have hsplit : critProd u = (X - C (u 0)) * critProd (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ) := by
      unfold critProd
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
    have hih := ih (fun i : Fin n => u i.succ) (fun i => hu i.succ)
    rw [hsplit, sub_mul, coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul]
    have hRn : R ^ n ≤ R ^ (n + 1) := pow_le_pow_right' hR (Nat.le_succ n)
    refine v.map_sub_le ?_ ?_
    · rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [coeff_X_mul_zero, Valuation.map_zero]; exact zero_le
      · rw [coeff_X_mul]; exact (hih k).trans hRn
    · rw [Valuation.map_mul, pow_succ']
      exact mul_le_mul' (hu 0) (hih k)

name: IngramMello.val_eval_eq_pow
statement:
theorem val_eval_eq_pow {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (_hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree) {B : Γ₀} (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ B) {z : F} (hz : B < v z) :
    v (f.eval z) = v z ^ f.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 1 < v z := lt_of_le_of_lt hB hz
  have hz0 : v z ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans h1).ne'
  rw [eval_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ, hf.coeff_natDegree, one_mul]
  rw [Valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_right, Valuation.map_pow]
  rw [Valuation.map_pow]
  refine v.map_sum_lt (pow_ne_zero _ hz0) fun k hk => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
  rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow]
  calc v (f.coeff k) * v z ^ k ≤ B * v z ^ k := mul_le_mul_left (hcoef k hk) _
    _ < v z * v z ^ k := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hz (pow_pos (zero_lt_one.trans h1) k)
    _ = v z ^ (k + 1) := (pow_succ' _ _).symm
    _ ≤ v z ^ f.natDegree := pow_le_pow_right' h1.le hk

name: IngramMello.val_iterate_of_escape
statement:
theorem val_iterate_of_escape {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree) {B : Γ₀}
    (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ B) {z : F} (hz : B < v z) :
    ∀ n, B < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n] z) ∧
      v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n] z) < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    show v z < v (f.eval z)
    rw [val_eval_eq_pow v hf hd hB hcoef hz]
    have h1 : 1 < v z := lt_of_le_of_lt hB hz
    calc v z = v z * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
      _ < v z * v z ^ (f.natDegree - 1) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (one_lt_pow' h1 (by omega)) (zero_lt_one.trans h1)
      _ = v z ^ f.natDegree := by rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz' : B < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) := ih.1.trans ih.2
    refine ⟨hz', ?_⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ (n + 1), val_eval_eq_pow v hf hd hB hcoef hz']
    have h1 : 1 < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) := lt_of_le_of_lt hB hz'
    calc v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) = v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) * 1 :=
          (mul_one _).symm
      _ < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) * v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n + 1] z) ^ (f.natDegree - 1) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (one_lt_pow' h1 (by omega)) (zero_lt_one.trans h1)
      _ = _ := by rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]

name: IngramMello.not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escape
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun n : ℕ => (fun w => aeval w f)^[n] z := by
    have hsm : StrictMono fun n : ℕ => v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[n] z) :=
      strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => (val_iterate_of_escape v hf hd hB hcoef hz n).2
    intro n m hnm
    apply hsm.injective
    simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval] at hnm
    simp only [hnm]
  exact Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj

name: IngramMello.val_iterate_le_of_hasFiniteOrbit
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escape v hf hd hB hcoef h
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit at hc ⊢
  refine hc.subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨m + n, ?_⟩
  simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval, Function.iterate_add_apply]

name: IngramMello.not_escapes_of_hasFiniteOrbit
statement:
theorem not_escapes_of_hasFiniteOrbit {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree) {c : F}
    (hc : HasFiniteOrbit f c) : ¬ Escapes v f c
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨B, hB, hcoef, n, hlt⟩
  exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr (val_iterate_le_of_hasFiniteOrbit v hf hd hB hcoef hc n))

name: IngramMello.not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escapes
statement:
theorem not_hasFiniteOrbit_of_escapes {f : F[X]} (hf : f.Monic) (hd : 2 ≤ f.natDegree) {c : F}
    (hc : Escapes v f c) : ¬ HasFiniteOrbit f c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hcoef, n, hlt⟩ := hc
  intro hfin
  exact absurd hlt (not_lt.mpr (val_iterate_le_of_hasFiniteOrbit v hf hd hB hcoef hfin n))

name: IngramMello.conjFixed_eval
statement: theorem conjFixed_eval (f : F[X]) (p w : F) : (conjFixed f p).eval w = f.eval (w + p) - p
proof:
:= by
  simp [conjFixed, eval_comp]

name: IngramMello.conjFixed_iterate
statement:
theorem conjFixed_iterate (f : F[X]) (p z : F) (n : ℕ) :
    (fun w => (conjFixed f p).eval w)^[n] (z - p) = (fun w => f.eval w)^[n] z - p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, conjFixed_eval,
      sub_add_cancel]

name: IngramMello.hasFiniteOrbit_conjFixed
statement:
theorem hasFiniteOrbit_conjFixed (f : F[X]) (p z : F) (hz : HasFiniteOrbit f z) :
    HasFiniteOrbit (conjFixed f p) (z - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold HasFiniteOrbit at hz ⊢
  refine (hz.image (fun w => w - p)).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(fun w => aeval w f)^[n] z, ⟨n, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  simp only [coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  exact (conjFixed_iterate f p z n).symm

name: IngramMello.conjFixed_monicCentred
statement:
theorem conjFixed_monicCentred {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (p : F)
    (hc : derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c)
    (hp : (monicCentred d a).eval p = p) :
    conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p = C (d : F) * Phi d (fun i => c i - p) ∧
      (conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p).Monic ∧
      (conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p).natDegree = d
proof:
:= by
  set f := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
  set g := conjFixed f p with hg
  have hg' : derivative g = C (d : F) * critProd (fun i => c i - p) := by
    rw [hg, conjFixed, derivative_sub, derivative_C, sub_zero, derivative_comp, hc,
      derivative_add, derivative_X, derivative_C, add_zero, one_mul, mul_comp, C_comp]
    congr 1
    unfold critProd
    rw [prod_comp]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp, C_sub]; ring
  have hg0 : g.eval 0 = 0 := by rw [hg, conjFixed_eval, zero_add, hp, sub_self]
  have hcompm : (f.comp (X + C p)).Monic :=
    hfm.comp (monic_X_add_C p) (by rw [natDegree_X_add_C]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hcompdeg : (f.comp (X + C p)).natDegree = d := by
    rw [natDegree_comp, natDegree_X_add_C, mul_one, hfdeg]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hder : derivative (g - C (d : F) * Phi d (fun i => c i - p)) = 0 := by
      rw [derivative_sub, hg', derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add,
        derivative_Phi d (by omega), sub_self]
    have h0 : (g - C (d : F) * Phi d (fun i => c i - p)).eval 0 = 0 := by
      simp [hg0, eval_zero_Phi]
    have := eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hder
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, h0, C_0] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  · rw [hg, conjFixed]
    refine Monic.sub_of_left hcompm ?_
    refine degree_C_le.trans_lt ?_
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hcompm.ne_zero, hcompdeg]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  · rw [hg, conjFixed, natDegree_sub_C, hcompdeg]

name: IngramMello.conjFixed_coeff
statement:
theorem conjFixed_coeff {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (p : F)
    (hc : derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c)
    (hp : (monicCentred d a).eval p = p) :
    (conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p).coeff 0 = 0 ∧
      ∀ k, (conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p).coeff (k + 1) * ((k : F) + 1)
        = (d : F) * (critProd (fun i => c i - p)).coeff k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hgPhi, -, -⟩ := conjFixed_monicCentred hd a c p hc hp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, conjFixed_eval, zero_add, hp, sub_self]
  · intro k
    have hder := coeff_derivative (conjFixed (monicCentred d a) p) k
    rw [hgPhi, derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add, derivative_Phi d (by omega),
      coeff_C_mul] at hder
    rw [hgPhi]
    exact hder.symm

name: IngramMello.exists_local_coeff_bound_of_not_escapes
statement:
theorem exists_local_coeff_bound_of_not_escapes (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [CharZero F] (Γ₀ : Type w) [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
        (v : Valuation F Γ₀) (a : Fin (d - 1) → F) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (p : F),
        derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c →
        (monicCentred d a).eval p = p →
        (∀ i, ¬ Escapes v (monicCentred d a) (c i)) →
        ∀ k, v ((N : F) * a k) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀, hloc⟩ := exists_ingram_local.{u, w} d hd
  set N₂ : ℕ := d * N₀ * d.factorial with hN₂
  set M₁ : ℕ := (d - 1) * N₂ with hM₁
  have hN₂pos : 0 < N₂ := by positivity
  have hM₁pos : 0 < M₁ := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hN₂pos
  refine ⟨d.factorial * M₁ ^ (2 * d), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro F _ _ Γ₀ _ v a c p hc hp hnesc
  set f := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
                                                                             
  set c' : Fin (d - 1) → F := fun i => c i - p with hc'
  set g : F[X] := f.comp (X + C p) - C p with hg
  have hg' : derivative g = C (d : F) * critProd c' := by
    rw [hg, derivative_sub, derivative_C, sub_zero, derivative_comp, hc, derivative_add,
      derivative_X, derivative_C, add_zero, one_mul, mul_comp, C_comp]
    congr 1
    unfold critProd
    rw [prod_comp]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp, hc']
    simp only
    rw [C_sub]; ring
  have hg0 : g.eval 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hg, eval_sub, eval_comp, eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, zero_add, hp, sub_self]
  have hgPhi : g = C (d : F) * Phi d c' := by
    have hder : derivative (g - C (d : F) * Phi d c') = 0 := by
      rw [derivative_sub, hg', derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add,
        derivative_Phi d (by omega), sub_self]
    have h0 : (g - C (d : F) * Phi d c').eval 0 = 0 := by simp [hg0, eval_zero_Phi]
    have := eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hder
    rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, h0, C_0] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hcompm : (f.comp (X + C p)).Monic :=
    hfm.comp (monic_X_add_C p) (by rw [natDegree_X_add_C]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have hcompdeg : (f.comp (X + C p)).natDegree = d := by
    rw [natDegree_comp, natDegree_X_add_C, mul_one, hfdeg]
  have hgm : g.Monic := by
    rw [hg]
    refine Monic.sub_of_left hcompm ?_
    refine degree_C_le.trans_lt ?_
    rw [degree_eq_natDegree hcompm.ne_zero, hcompdeg]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < d by omega)
  have hgdeg : g.natDegree = d := by rw [hg, natDegree_sub_C, hcompdeg]
  have hgiter : ∀ j n, (fun w => g.eval w)^[n] (c' j) = (fun w => f.eval w)^[n] (c j) - p := by
    intro j n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [hc']
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply', ih, hg, eval_sub, eval_comp,
        eval_add, eval_X, eval_C, sub_add_cancel]
                                  
  have hstep1 : ∀ i, v ((N₂ : F) * c' i) ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcon
    have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))).Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
    obtain ⟨i₀, -, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => v (c' k)) hne
    set R := v (c' i₀) with hR
    have hR1 : 1 < v (N₂ : F) * R := by
      calc 1 < v ((N₂ : F) * c' i) := hi
        _ = v (N₂ : F) * v (c' i) := Valuation.map_mul _ _ _
        _ ≤ v (N₂ : F) * R := mul_le_mul_right (hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)) _
    have hRgt : 1 < R := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      have : v (N₂ : F) * R ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v N₂) h
      rw [one_mul] at this
      exact absurd hR1 (not_lt.mpr this)
    have hR0 : 0 < R := zero_lt_one.trans hRgt
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hloc F Γ₀ v c' i₀
    have hgj : v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R ^ d ≤ v (g.eval (c' j)) := by
      rw [hgPhi, eval_mul, eval_C, Valuation.map_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_right hj _
    have hfact0 : v (d.factorial : F) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos d).ne'
    set Bg : Γ₀ := (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R ^ (d - 1) with hBg
    have hBg1 : 1 ≤ Bg := by
      calc (1 : Γ₀) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
        _ ≤ Bg := mul_le_mul' (one_le_inv_val_natCast v (Nat.factorial_pos d))
            (one_le_pow_of_one_le' hRgt.le _)
    have hcoefg : ∀ k < g.natDegree, v (g.coeff k) ≤ Bg := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hgdeg] at hk
      rcases k with _ | k
      · rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hg0, Valuation.map_zero]; exact zero_le
      · have hder := coeff_derivative g k
        rw [hg', coeff_C_mul] at hder
        have hprod : v ((critProd c').coeff k) ≤ R ^ (d - 1) :=
          val_coeff_critProd_le v hRgt.le c' (fun i => hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)) k
        have hk1 : v ((k : F) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero k
        have h1 : v (g.coeff (k + 1)) * v ((k : F) + 1) ≤ R ^ (d - 1) := by
          rw [← Valuation.map_mul, ← hder, Valuation.map_mul]
          calc v (d : F) * v ((critProd c').coeff k) ≤ 1 * R ^ (d - 1) :=
                mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v d) hprod
            _ = R ^ (d - 1) := one_mul _
        have h2 : v (g.coeff (k + 1)) ≤ (v ((k : F) + 1))⁻¹ * R ^ (d - 1) := by
          calc v (g.coeff (k + 1))
              = (v ((k : F) + 1))⁻¹ * (v (g.coeff (k + 1)) * v ((k : F) + 1)) := by
                rw [mul_comm (v (g.coeff _)), inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hk1]
            _ ≤ (v ((k : F) + 1))⁻¹ * R ^ (d - 1) := mul_le_mul_right h1 _
        have h3 : (v ((k : F) + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ := by
          rw [inv_le_inv₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr hk1) (zero_lt_iff.mpr hfact0)]
          obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial (Nat.succ_pos k) (by omega : k + 1 ≤ d)
          rw [ht, Nat.cast_mul, Valuation.map_mul, Nat.cast_succ]
          calc v ((k : F) + 1) * v (t : F) ≤ v ((k : F) + 1) * 1 :=
                mul_le_mul_right (val_natCast_le_one v t) _
            _ = v ((k : F) + 1) := mul_one _
        exact h2.trans (mul_le_mul_left h3 _)
    have hBglt : Bg < v (g.eval (c' j)) := by
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hgj
      have hRd : R ^ d = R * R ^ (d - 1) := by
        rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)]
      have hsplit : v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R ^ d
          = (v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R) * R ^ (d - 1) := by
        rw [hRd]; ac_rfl
      rw [hBg, hsplit]
      refine mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ?_ (pow_pos hR0 _)
      have hN₂v : v (d.factorial : F) * (v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R) = v (N₂ : F) * R := by
        rw [hN₂, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_mul]
        ac_rfl
      calc (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ = (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ < (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * (v (d.factorial : F) * (v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R)) := by
            rw [hN₂v]
            exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hR1 (inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_iff.mpr hfact0))
        _ = v (d : F) * v (N₀ : F) * R := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hfact0 _
                                                                  
    have hgd : 2 ≤ g.natDegree := by rw [hgdeg]; exact hd
    set γ := v (g.eval (c' j)) with hγ
    have hRBg : R ≤ Bg := by
      calc R ≤ R ^ (d - 1) := le_self_pow hRgt.le (by omega)
        _ = 1 * R ^ (d - 1) := (one_mul _).symm
        _ ≤ Bg := mul_le_mul' (one_le_inv_val_natCast v (Nat.factorial_pos d)) le_rfl
    have hRγ : R ≤ γ := hRBg.trans hBglt.le
    have hiter : ∀ m, v ((fun w => g.eval w)^[m] (g.eval (c' j))) = γ ^ (d ^ m) := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero => simp [hγ]
      | succ m ih =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', val_eval_eq_pow v hgm hgd hBg1 hcoefg
          (val_iterate_of_escape v hgm hgd hBg1 hcoefg hBglt m).1, ih, hgdeg, ← pow_mul,
          pow_succ]
    have hd1 : v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (by omega)
    set R' : Γ₀ := (v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F))⁻¹ * R with hR'
    have hRR' : R ≤ R' := by
      calc R = 1 * R := (one_mul R).symm
        _ ≤ R' := mul_le_mul' (one_le_inv_val_natCast v (by omega)) le_rfl
    have hR'1 : 1 ≤ R' := hRgt.le.trans hRR'
    have hsum0 := sum_crit_eq_zero hd a c hc
    have hp0 : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F) * p = -∑ i, c' i := by
      simp only [hc', Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum0, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      ring
    have hpR' : v p ≤ R' := by
      have h1 : v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F) * v p ≤ R := by
        rw [← Valuation.map_mul, hp0, Valuation.map_neg]
        exact v.map_sum_le fun i _ => hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)
      calc v p = (v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F))⁻¹ * (v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F) * v p) := by
            rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hd1]
        _ ≤ R' := mul_le_mul' le_rfl h1
    have hcR' : ∀ i, v (c i) ≤ R' := by
      intro i
      have : c i = c' i + p := by simp [hc']
      rw [this]
      exact (v.map_add _ _).trans (max_le ((hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hRR') hpR')
    have hcoef_crit' : ∀ k, v ((critProd c).coeff k) ≤ R' ^ (d - 1) :=
      val_coeff_critProd_le v hR'1 c hcR'
    set Bf : Γ₀ := (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R' ^ (2 * d) with hBf
    have hfact1 : 1 ≤ (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ := one_le_inv_val_natCast v (Nat.factorial_pos d)
    have hBf1 : 1 ≤ Bf := by
      calc (1 : Γ₀) = 1 * 1 := (mul_one 1).symm
        _ ≤ Bf := mul_le_mul' hfact1 (one_le_pow_of_one_le' hR'1 _)
    have hR'Bf : R' ≤ Bf := by
      calc R' = 1 * R' ^ 1 := by rw [one_mul, pow_one]
        _ ≤ Bf := mul_le_mul' hfact1 (pow_le_pow_right' hR'1 (by omega))
    have hak' : ∀ k : Fin (d - 1), 1 ≤ (k : ℕ) →
        v (a k) ≤ (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1) := by
      intro k hk
      obtain ⟨j', hj'⟩ : ∃ j', (k : ℕ) = j' + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
      have hder := coeff_derivative f j'
      rw [hc, coeff_C_mul, ← hj', monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a k.isLt, Fin.eta] at hder
      have hk1 : v ((j' : F) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero j'
      have h1 : v (a k) * v ((j' : F) + 1) ≤ R' ^ (d - 1) := by
        rw [← Valuation.map_mul, ← hder, Valuation.map_mul]
        calc v (d : F) * v ((critProd c).coeff j') ≤ 1 * R' ^ (d - 1) :=
              mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v d) (hcoef_crit' j')
          _ = R' ^ (d - 1) := one_mul _
      have h2 : v (a k) ≤ (v ((j' : F) + 1))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1) := by
        calc v (a k) = (v ((j' : F) + 1))⁻¹ * (v (a k) * v ((j' : F) + 1)) := by
              rw [mul_comm (v (a k)), inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hk1]
          _ ≤ (v ((j' : F) + 1))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl h1
      have h3 : (v ((j' : F) + 1))⁻¹ ≤ (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_le_inv₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr hk1) (zero_lt_iff.mpr hfact0)]
        obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial (Nat.succ_pos j') (by omega : j' + 1 ≤ d)
        rw [ht, Nat.cast_mul, Valuation.map_mul, Nat.cast_succ]
        calc v ((j' : F) + 1) * v (t : F) ≤ v ((j' : F) + 1) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul' le_rfl (val_natCast_le_one v t)
          _ = v ((j' : F) + 1) := mul_one _
      exact h2.trans (mul_le_mul' h3 le_rfl)
    have hcoefF : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ Bf := by
      intro k hk
      rw [hfdeg] at hk
      by_cases hk' : k < d - 1
      · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a hk']
        by_cases hk0 : k = 0
        · subst hk0
          have ha0 : a ⟨0, hk'⟩ = p - p ^ d -
              ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨0, hk'⟩ : Fin (d - 1)), a i * p ^ (i : ℕ) := by
            have h := hp
            rw [monicCentred_eval,
              ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨0, hk'⟩ : Fin (d - 1)))] at h
            simp only [pow_zero, mul_one] at h
            linear_combination h
          rw [ha0]
          have hpBf : v p ≤ Bf := hpR'.trans hR'Bf
          have hpdBf : v (p ^ d) ≤ Bf := by
            rw [Valuation.map_pow]
            calc v p ^ d ≤ R' ^ d := pow_le_pow_left' hpR' d
              _ = 1 * R' ^ d := (one_mul _).symm
              _ ≤ Bf := mul_le_mul' hfact1 (pow_le_pow_right' hR'1 (by omega))
          refine (v.map_sub _ _).trans
            (max_le ((v.map_sub _ _).trans (max_le hpBf hpdBf)) ?_)
          refine v.map_sum_le fun i hi => ?_
          have hi1 : 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := by
            rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hi with ⟨hne', -⟩
            by_contra h
            exact hne' (Fin.ext (show (i : ℕ) = 0 by omega))
          rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow]
          calc v (a i) * v p ^ (i : ℕ)
              ≤ ((v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1)) * R' ^ (d - 1) :=
                mul_le_mul' (hak' i hi1) ((pow_le_pow_left' hpR' _).trans
                  (pow_le_pow_right' hR'1 (by have := i.isLt; omega)))
            _ = (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1 + (d - 1)) := by
                rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
            _ ≤ Bf := mul_le_mul' le_rfl (pow_le_pow_right' hR'1 (by omega))
        · calc v (a ⟨k, hk'⟩) ≤ (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * R' ^ (d - 1) :=
                hak' ⟨k, hk'⟩ (by simp only; omega)
            _ ≤ Bf := mul_le_mul' le_rfl (pow_le_pow_right' hR'1 (by omega))
      · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero a (by omega) hk, Valuation.map_zero]
        exact zero_le
                                                                                  
    have hN₂0 : v (N₂ : F) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN₂pos.ne'
    have hinvN₂ : (v (N₂ : F))⁻¹ ≤ R := by
      calc (v (N₂ : F))⁻¹ = (v (N₂ : F))⁻¹ * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
        _ ≤ (v (N₂ : F))⁻¹ * (v (N₂ : F) * R) := mul_le_mul' le_rfl hR1.le
        _ = R := inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hN₂0 _
    have hdvdN : d.factorial * (d - 1) ^ (2 * d) ∣ N₂ ^ (2 * d + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ, mul_comm d.factorial]
      refine mul_dvd_mul ?_ (Dvd.intro_left _ rfl)
      refine pow_dvd_pow_of_dvd ?_ _
      exact (Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega) (by omega)).trans (Dvd.intro_left _ rfl)
    have hconst : (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * ((v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F))⁻¹) ^ (2 * d)
        ≤ R ^ (2 * d + 1) := by
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdvdN
      have h1 : v ((N₂ ^ (2 * d + 1) : ℕ) : F)
          ≤ v ((d.factorial * (d - 1) ^ (2 * d) : ℕ) : F) := by
        rw [ht, Nat.cast_mul, Valuation.map_mul]
        calc _ ≤ v ((d.factorial * (d - 1) ^ (2 * d) : ℕ) : F) * 1 :=
              mul_le_mul' le_rfl (val_natCast_le_one v t)
          _ = _ := mul_one _
      have h2 : v ((d.factorial * (d - 1) ^ (2 * d) : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]
        exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr
          (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.factorial_pos d) (pow_pos (by omega) _)).ne'
      have h3 : v ((N₂ ^ (2 * d + 1) : ℕ) : F) ≠ 0 := by
        rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]; exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (pow_pos hN₂pos _).ne'
      calc (v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * ((v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F))⁻¹) ^ (2 * d)
          = (v ((d.factorial * (d - 1) ^ (2 * d) : ℕ) : F))⁻¹ := by
            rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow, mul_inv,
              inv_pow]
        _ ≤ (v ((N₂ ^ (2 * d + 1) : ℕ) : F))⁻¹ := by
            rw [inv_le_inv₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr h2) (zero_lt_iff.mpr h3)]; exact h1
        _ = ((v (N₂ : F))⁻¹) ^ (2 * d + 1) := by
            rw [Nat.cast_pow, Valuation.map_pow, inv_pow]
        _ ≤ R ^ (2 * d + 1) := pow_le_pow_left' hinvN₂ _
    have hBfR : Bf ≤ R ^ (4 * d + 1) := by
      calc Bf = ((v (d.factorial : F))⁻¹ * ((v ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F))⁻¹) ^ (2 * d)) * R ^ (2 * d) := by
            rw [hBf, hR', mul_pow, mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ R ^ (2 * d + 1) * R ^ (2 * d) := mul_le_mul' hconst le_rfl
        _ = R ^ (4 * d + 1) := by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    set m : ℕ := 4 * d + 1 with hm
    have hpowm : 4 * d + 1 < d ^ m := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    have hbig : R ^ (4 * d + 1) < v ((fun w => g.eval w)^[m] (g.eval (c' j))) := by
      rw [hiter m]
      calc R ^ (4 * d + 1) < R ^ (d ^ m) := pow_lt_pow_right₀ hRgt hpowm
        _ ≤ γ ^ (d ^ m) := pow_le_pow_left' hRγ _
    have hfn : (fun w => f.eval w)^[m + 1] (c j)
        = (fun w => g.eval w)^[m] (g.eval (c' j)) + p := by
      have := hgiter j (m + 1)
      rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply] at this
      rw [this, sub_add_cancel]
    have hlt : Bf < v ((fun w => f.eval w)^[m + 1] (c j)) := by
      rw [hfn, Valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_left]
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt hBfR hbig
      · exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hpR'.trans hR'Bf) (lt_of_le_of_lt hBfR hbig)
    exact hnesc j ⟨Bf, hBf1, hcoefF, m + 1, hlt⟩
                                                    
  have hsum := sum_crit_eq_zero hd a c hc
  have hp' : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : F) * p = -∑ i, c' i := by
    simp only [hc', Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hsum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring
  have hpM : v ((M₁ : F) * p) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hM₁, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, hp', mul_neg, Valuation.map_neg,
      Finset.mul_sum]
    exact v.map_sum_le fun i _ => hstep1 i
  have hcM : ∀ i, v ((M₁ : F) * c i) ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    have : c i = c' i + p := by simp [hc']
    rw [this]
    exact vbdd_add v (vbdd_of_dvd v (Dvd.intro_left _ rfl) (hstep1 i)) hpM
                                 
  have hcoef_crit : ∀ k, v ((critProd c).coeff k) ≤ ((v (M₁ : F))⁻¹) ^ (d - 1) :=
    val_coeff_critProd_le v (one_le_inv_val_natCast v hM₁pos) c
      (fun i => le_inv_of_vbdd v hM₁pos (hcM i))
  have hak : ∀ k : Fin (d - 1), 1 ≤ (k : ℕ) →
      v (((d.factorial * M₁ ^ (d - 1) : ℕ) : F) * a k) ≤ 1 := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, (k : ℕ) = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hder := coeff_derivative f j
    rw [hc, coeff_C_mul, ← hj, monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a k.isLt, Fin.eta] at hder
    have hjk : ((j : F) + 1) = ((k : ℕ) : F) := by rw [hj]; push_cast; ring
    rw [hjk] at hder
    have h1 : v (((M₁ ^ (d - 1) : ℕ) : F) * (((k : ℕ) : F) * a k)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [mul_comm ((k : ℕ) : F), ← hder, mul_left_comm, Valuation.map_mul]
      calc v (d : F) * v (((M₁ ^ (d - 1) : ℕ) : F) * (critProd c).coeff j) ≤ 1 * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul' (val_natCast_le_one v d) (vbdd_of_le_inv v (by positivity)
              (by rw [Nat.cast_pow, Valuation.map_pow, ← inv_pow]; exact hcoef_crit j))
        _ = 1 := mul_one 1
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Nat.dvd_factorial (by omega : 0 < (k : ℕ)) (by omega : (k : ℕ) ≤ d)
    have h2 := vbdd_of_dvd v (Dvd.intro_left t rfl : M₁ ^ (d - 1) ∣ t * M₁ ^ (d - 1)) h1
    have h3 : (((t * M₁ ^ (d - 1) : ℕ) : F) * (((k : ℕ) : F) * a k))
        = ((d.factorial * M₁ ^ (d - 1) : ℕ) : F) * a k := by
      rw [ht]; push_cast; ring
    rwa [h3] at h2
  have hdvd1 : M₁ ∣ d.factorial * M₁ ^ (2 * d) :=
    Dvd.dvd.mul_left (dvd_pow_self M₁ (by omega)) _
  have hdvd2 : M₁ ^ d ∣ d.factorial * M₁ ^ (2 * d) :=
    Dvd.dvd.mul_left (pow_dvd_pow M₁ (by omega)) _
  have hdvd3 : d.factorial * M₁ ^ (d - 1) ∣ d.factorial * M₁ ^ (2 * d) :=
    mul_dvd_mul_left _ (pow_dvd_pow M₁ (by omega))
  have hdvd4 : ∀ i : Fin (d - 1), d.factorial * M₁ ^ (d - 1) * M₁ ^ (i : ℕ)
      ∣ d.factorial * M₁ ^ (2 * d) := by
    intro i
    rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ (pow_dvd_pow M₁ (by have := i.isLt; omega))
  intro k
  by_cases hk : (k : ℕ) = 0
  · have hk0 : k = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext hk
    have ha0 : a k = p - p ^ d - ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, a i * p ^ (i : ℕ) := by
      have h := hp
      rw [monicCentred_eval, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ k), hk, pow_zero,
        mul_one] at h
      linear_combination h
    rw [ha0]
    refine vbdd_sub v (vbdd_sub v (vbdd_of_dvd v hdvd1 hpM) ?_) ?_
    · have := vbdd_pow v hpM d
      exact vbdd_of_dvd v hdvd2 this
    · refine vbdd_sum v _ fun i hi => ?_
      have hi1 : 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := by
        rcases Finset.mem_erase.mp hi with ⟨hne, -⟩
        by_contra h
        exact hne (Fin.ext (by rw [hk]; omega))
      have := vbdd_mul v (hak i hi1) (vbdd_pow v hpM (i : ℕ))
      exact vbdd_of_dvd v (hdvd4 i) this
  · exact vbdd_of_dvd v hdvd3 (hak k (by omega))

name: IngramMello.exists_local_coeff_bound
statement:
theorem exists_local_coeff_bound (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [CharZero F] (Γ₀ : Type w) [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
        (v : Valuation F Γ₀) (a : Fin (d - 1) → F) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (p : F),
        derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c →
        (monicCentred d a).eval p = p →
        (∀ i, HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) (c i)) →
        ∀ k, v ((N : F) * a k) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, h⟩ := exists_local_coeff_bound_of_not_escapes.{u, w} d hd
  refine ⟨N, hN, fun F _ _ Γ₀ _ v a c p hc hp horb => h F Γ₀ v a c p hc hp fun i => ?_⟩
  exact not_escapes_of_hasFiniteOrbit v (monicCentred_monic hd a)
    (by rw [monicCentred_natDegree hd a]; exact hd) (horb i)

name: IngramMello.exists_local_bound
statement:
theorem exists_local_bound (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧
      ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [CharZero F] (Γ₀ : Type w) [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
        (v : Valuation F Γ₀) (a : Fin (d - 1) → F) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (p : F),
        derivative (monicCentred d a) = C (d : F) * critProd c →
        (monicCentred d a).eval p = p →
        (∀ i, HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) (c i)) →
        (∀ k, v ((N : F) * a k) ≤ 1) ∧
        ∀ z : F, HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) z → ∀ n m : ℕ,
          v ((N : F) * ((fun w => (monicCentred d a).eval w)^[n] z -
            (fun w => (monicCentred d a).eval w)^[m] z)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hbound⟩ := exists_local_coeff_bound.{u, w} d hd
  refine ⟨N, hN, ?_⟩
  intro F _ _ Γ₀ _ v a c p hc hp horb
  have ha := hbound F Γ₀ v a c p hc hp horb
  refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
  intro z hz n m
  set f := monicCentred d a with hf
  have hfm : f.Monic := monicCentred_monic hd a
  have hfdeg : f.natDegree = d := monicCentred_natDegree hd a
  have hB1 : (1 : Γ₀) ≤ (v (N : F))⁻¹ := one_le_inv_val_natCast v hN
  have hcoef : ∀ k < f.natDegree, v (f.coeff k) ≤ (v (N : F))⁻¹ := by
    intro k hk
    rw [hfdeg] at hk
    by_cases hk' : k < d - 1
    · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_of_lt a hk']
      exact le_inv_of_vbdd v hN (ha _)
    · rw [hf, monicCentred_coeff_eq_zero a (by omega) hk, Valuation.map_zero]
      exact zero_le
  have h1 := val_iterate_le_of_hasFiniteOrbit v hfm (by rw [hfdeg]; exact hd) hB1 hcoef hz n
  have h2 := val_iterate_le_of_hasFiniteOrbit v hfm (by rw [hfdeg]; exact hd) hB1 hcoef hz m
  exact vbdd_of_le_inv v hN (v.map_sub_le h1 h2)

name: IngramMello.sum_pow_mul_primitiveRoot
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mul_primitiveRoot {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {ξ : ℂ} (hξ : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ p)
    (a : ℕ) :
    ∑ m ∈ range p, ξ ^ (m * a) = if p ∣ a then (p : ℂ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ m, ξ ^ (m * a) = (ξ ^ a) ^ m := fun m => by rw [mul_comm, pow_mul]
  simp_rw [h1]
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [(hξ.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd a).2 hd]
    simp
  · have hcop : a.Coprime p := (Nat.coprime_comm).1 ((Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 hd)
    exact (hξ.pow_of_coprime a hcop).geom_sum_eq_zero hp.one_lt

name: IngramMello.exists_algHom_pow_of_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_pow_of_coprime {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {ω : ℂ} (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n)
    {b : ℕ} (hb : b.Coprime n) :
    ∃ σ : ℚ⟮ω⟯ →ₐ[ℚ] ℂ, σ (IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ ω) = ω ^ b
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral ℚ ω := (hω.isIntegral hn).tower_top
  have hroot : aeval (ω ^ b) (minpoly ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis hint).gen) = 0 := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis_gen, IntermediateField.minpoly_gen,
      ← cyclotomic_eq_minpoly_rat hω hn, aeval_def, ← eval_map, map_cyclotomic]
    have : NeZero (n : ℂ) := ⟨by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'⟩
    exact (isRoot_cyclotomic_iff.2 (hω.pow_of_coprime b hb))
  refine ⟨(IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis hint).lift (ω ^ b) hroot, ?_⟩
  have := (IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis hint).lift_gen (ω ^ b) hroot
  rwa [IntermediateField.adjoin.powerBasis_gen] at this

name: IngramMello.sum_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_algHom
statement:
theorem sum_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_algHom {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {ω : ℂ} (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n)
    {b : ℕ} (hb : b.Coprime n) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℚ) (a : Fin k → ℕ)
    (hsum : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i = 0) :
    ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ (b * a i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_algHom_pow_of_coprime hn hω hb
  set g := IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ ω
  have hg : (g : ℂ) = ω := rfl
  have hin : ∑ i, (algebraMap ℚ ℚ⟮ω⟯ (c i)) * g ^ a i = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [hg] using hsum
  have := congrArg σ hin
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at this
  simpa [hσ, pow_mul] using this

name: IngramMello.eq_of_dvd_add_sub
statement:
theorem eq_of_dvd_add_sub {p a j j' : ℕ} (hj : j < p) (hj' : j' < p)
    (h : p ∣ a + (p - j)) (h' : p ∣ a + (p - j')) : j = j'
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total j j' with hle | hle
  · have hd : p ∣ (a + (p - j)) - (a + (p - j')) := Nat.dvd_sub h h'
    have he : (a + (p - j)) - (a + (p - j')) = j' - j := by omega
    rw [he] at hd
    have := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd (by omega)
    omega
  · have hd : p ∣ (a + (p - j')) - (a + (p - j)) := Nat.dvd_sub h' h
    have he : (a + (p - j')) - (a + (p - j)) = j - j' := by omega
    rw [he] at hd
    have := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt hd (by omega)
    omega

name: IngramMello.mann_prime_step
statement:
theorem mann_prime_step {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {ω : ℂ} (hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n) {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℚ) (a : Fin k → ℕ)
    (i₀ : Fin k) (h₀ : p ∣ a i₀)
    (hsum : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i = 0)
    (hmin : ∀ I : Finset (Fin k), I.Nonempty → ∑ i ∈ I, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i = 0 → I = univ) :
    (∀ i, p ∣ a i) ∨ (p ≤ k ∧ ¬ p ∣ n / p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q := n / p with hq
  have hnq : n = q * p := (Nat.div_mul_cancel hpn).symm
  set ξ := ω ^ q with hξdef
  have hξ : IsPrimitiveRoot ξ p := hω.pow hn hnq
  have hξ0 : ξ ≠ 0 := hξ.ne_zero hp.ne_zero
  have hp0 : (p : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne_zero
  
  set R : ℕ → ℂ := fun m => ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i * ξ ^ (m * a i) with hR
  have hRzero : ∀ m, Nat.Coprime (1 + m * q) n → R m = 0 := by
    intro m hm
    have := sum_pow_mul_eq_zero_of_algHom hn hω hm c a hsum
    simp only [hR]
    rw [← this]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [mul_assoc, hξdef, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
    congr 2
    ring
  
  set A : ℕ → ℂ := fun j => ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => p ∣ a i + (p - j)), (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i
    with hA
  
  have hfourier : ∀ j, ∑ m ∈ range p, ξ ^ (m * (p - j)) * R m = (p : ℂ) * A j := by
    intro j
    simp only [hR, hA, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    have : ∀ m, ξ ^ (m * (p - j)) * ((c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i * ξ ^ (m * a i)) =
        (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i * ξ ^ (m * (a i + (p - j))) := by
      intro m
      rw [mul_add, pow_add]
      ring
    simp_rw [this, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_pow_mul_primitiveRoot hp hξ]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  
  set Bad := (range p).filter (fun m => ¬ Nat.Coprime (1 + m * q) n) with hBad
  have hbad_dvd : ∀ m ∈ Bad, p ∣ 1 + m * q := by
    intro m hm
    rw [hBad, Finset.mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hr1, hrn⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.1 hm.2
    by_cases hrp : r = p
    · exact hrp ▸ hr1
    · exfalso
      have hrq : r ∣ q := by
        rw [hnq] at hrn
        rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hr).1 hrn with h | h
        · exact h
        · exact absurd ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hr hp).1 h) hrp
      have : r ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hrq m)).1 hr1
      exact hr.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.1 this)
  have hbad_notq : ∀ m ∈ Bad, ¬ p ∣ q := by
    intro m hm hpq
    have : p ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_left (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hpq m)).1 (hbad_dvd m hm)
    exact hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.1 this)
  have hbad_card : Bad.card ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Finset.card_le_one]
    intro m hm m' hm'
    have hmp : m < p := Finset.mem_range.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hm).1
    have hm'p : m' < p := Finset.mem_range.1 (Finset.mem_filter.1 hm').1
    have hd := hbad_dvd m hm
    have hd' := hbad_dvd m' hm'
    have hnq' := hbad_notq m hm
    rcases le_total m m' with hle | hle
    · have h1 : p ∣ (1 + m' * q) - (1 + m * q) := Nat.dvd_sub hd' hd
      have h2 : (1 + m' * q) - (1 + m * q) = (m' - m) * q := by
        rw [Nat.sub_mul]; omega
      rw [h2] at h1
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 h1 with h | h
      · have := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h (by omega); omega
      · exact absurd h hnq'
    · have h1 : p ∣ (1 + m * q) - (1 + m' * q) := Nat.dvd_sub hd hd'
      have h2 : (1 + m * q) - (1 + m' * q) = (m - m') * q := by
        rw [Nat.sub_mul]; omega
      rw [h2] at h1
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).1 h1 with h | h
      · have := Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h (by omega); omega
      · exact absurd h hnq'
  
  have hkey : ∀ j, (p : ℂ) * A j = ∑ m ∈ Bad, ξ ^ (m * (p - j)) * R m := by
    intro j
    rw [← hfourier j, hBad]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_filter_of_ne
    intro m _ hne hcop
    exact hne (by rw [hRzero m hcop, mul_zero])
  
  have hiff : ∀ j, (A 0 = 0 ↔ A j = 0) := by
    intro j
    have hcases : Bad = ∅ ∨ ∃ m₀, Bad = {m₀} := by
      rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hbad_card with h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Finset.card_eq_zero.1 h)
      · exact Or.inr (Finset.card_eq_one.1 h)
    rcases hcases with hB | ⟨m₀, hB⟩
    · have h0 : A 0 = 0 := by
        have := hkey 0; rw [hB, Finset.sum_empty] at this
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hp0
      have hj : A j = 0 := by
        have := hkey j; rw [hB, Finset.sum_empty] at this
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hp0
      exact ⟨fun _ => hj, fun _ => h0⟩
    · have h0 := hkey 0
      have hj := hkey j
      rw [hB, Finset.sum_singleton] at h0 hj
      have e0 : A 0 = 0 ↔ R m₀ = 0 := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at h0
          rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h0.symm with h' | h'
          · exact absurd h' (pow_ne_zero _ hξ0)
          · exact h'
        · intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at h0
          exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left hp0
      have ej : A j = 0 ↔ R m₀ = 0 := by
        constructor
        · intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at hj
          rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hj.symm with h' | h'
          · exact absurd h' (pow_ne_zero _ hξ0)
          · exact h'
        · intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at hj
          exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hj).resolve_left hp0
      rw [e0, ej]
  have hA0_of_dvd : p ∣ q → A 0 = 0 := by
    intro hpq
    have hB : Bad = ∅ := by
      rw [Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
      intro m hm
      exact hbad_notq m hm hpq
    have := hkey 0
    rw [hB, Finset.sum_empty] at this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_left hp0
  
  by_cases hA0 : A 0 = 0
  · left
    have hmem : i₀ ∈ univ.filter (fun i => p ∣ a i + (p - 0)) := by
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Nat.sub_zero]
      exact dvd_add h₀ dvd_rfl
    have huniv := hmin _ ⟨i₀, hmem⟩ hA0
    intro i
    have hi : i ∈ univ.filter (fun i => p ∣ a i + (p - 0)) := by
      rw [huniv]; exact Finset.mem_univ i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Nat.sub_zero] at hi
    exact (Nat.dvd_add_left dvd_rfl).1 hi
  · right
    refine ⟨?_, fun hpq => hA0 (hA0_of_dvd hpq)⟩
    have hne : ∀ j : Fin p, (univ.filter (fun i => p ∣ a i + (p - (j : ℕ)))).Nonempty := by
      intro j
      apply Finset.nonempty_of_sum_ne_zero (f := fun i => (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i)
      exact fun h => hA0 ((hiff j).2 h)
    choose f hf using hne
    have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
      intro j j' hjj'
      have h1 := Finset.mem_filter.1 (hf j)
      have h2 := Finset.mem_filter.1 (hf j')
      rw [hjj'] at h1
      exact Fin.ext (eq_of_dvd_add_sub j.isLt j'.isLt h1.2 h2.2)
    simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hinj

name: IngramMello.exists_common_exponent
statement:
theorem exists_common_exponent {k : ℕ} (ζ : Fin k → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ζ i)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ i, ζ i ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  choose N hN using hζ
  refine ⟨∏ i, N i, Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => (hN i).1, fun i => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem N (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [ht, pow_mul, (hN i).2, one_pow]

name: IngramMello.mann_normalized
statement:
theorem mann_normalized {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℚ) (ζ : Fin k → ℂ)
    (hζ : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ζ i)) (i₀ : Fin k) (h₀ : ζ i₀ = 1)
    (hsum : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0)
    (hmin : ∀ I : Finset (Fin k), I.Nonempty → ∑ i ∈ I, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0 → I = univ) :
    ∀ i, ζ i ^ k.factorial = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex := exists_common_exponent ζ hζ
  set n := Nat.find hex with hndef
  have hn : 0 < n ∧ ∀ i, ζ i ^ n = 1 := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hnmin : ∀ m, m < n → ¬ (0 < m ∧ ∀ i, ζ i ^ m = 1) := fun m hm => Nat.find_min hex hm
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := hn.1.ne'
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn0⟩
  set ω : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / n) with hωdef
  have hω : IsPrimitiveRoot ω n := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp n hn0
  have hpow : ∀ i, ∃ j, j < n ∧ ω ^ j = ζ i := fun i => by
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hjω⟩ := hω.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one (hn.2 i)
    exact ⟨j, hj, hjω⟩
  choose a ha using hpow
  have hζa : ζ = fun i => ω ^ a i := funext fun i => ((ha i).2).symm
  have hsum' : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i = 0 := by rw [hζa] at hsum; exact hsum
  have hmin' : ∀ I : Finset (Fin k), I.Nonempty →
      ∑ i ∈ I, (c i : ℂ) * ω ^ a i = 0 → I = univ := by
    rw [hζa] at hmin; exact hmin
  have h₀' : ω ^ a i₀ = 1 := by rw [(ha i₀).2]; exact h₀
  
  have hsq : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ n → p ≤ k ∧ ¬ p ∣ n / p := by
    intro p hp hpn
    have h₀'' : p ∣ a i₀ := by
      have : n ∣ a i₀ := (hω.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd _).1 h₀'
      exact dvd_trans hpn this
    rcases mann_prime_step hn.1 hω hp hpn c a i₀ h₀'' hsum' hmin' with h | h
    · exfalso
      apply hnmin (n / p) (Nat.div_lt_self hn.1 hp.one_lt)
      refine ⟨Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn.1 hpn) hp.pos, fun i => ?_⟩
      rw [← (ha i).2, ← pow_mul, hω.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd]
      obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h i
      refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
      rw [ht, mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc p, mul_comm p t, mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hpn,
        mul_comm]
    · exact h
  have hsf : Squarefree n := by
    rw [Nat.squarefree_iff_prime_squarefree]
    intro p hp hpp
    have hpn : p ∣ n := dvd_trans (dvd_mul_right p p) hpp
    exact (hsq p hp hpn).2 (Nat.dvd_div_of_mul_dvd hpp)
  have hdvd : n ∣ k.factorial := by
    rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsf]
    apply Finset.prod_primes_dvd
    · intro p hp
      exact (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp).prime
    · intro p hp
      have hp' := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp
      exact (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial hp').2 (hsq p hp' (Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactors hp)).1
  intro i
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hdvd
  rw [ht, pow_mul, hn.2 i, one_pow]

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.ne_zero
statement: theorem IsRootOfUnityC.ne_zero {ζ : ℂ} (h : IsRootOfUnityC ζ) : ζ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hζ⟩ := h
  rintro rfl
  rw [zero_pow hn.ne'] at hζ
  exact zero_ne_one hζ

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.mul
statement:
theorem IsRootOfUnityC.mul {ζ₁ ζ₂ : ℂ} (h₁ : IsRootOfUnityC ζ₁) (h₂ : IsRootOfUnityC ζ₂) :
    IsRootOfUnityC (ζ₁ * ζ₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁, h₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂, h₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨n₁ * n₂, Nat.mul_pos hn₁ hn₂, ?_⟩
  rw [mul_pow, pow_mul, h₁, one_pow, mul_comm n₁, pow_mul, h₂, one_pow, one_mul]

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.inv
statement: theorem IsRootOfUnityC.inv {ζ : ℂ} (h : IsRootOfUnityC ζ) : IsRootOfUnityC ζ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hζ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, hn, by rw [inv_pow, hζ, inv_one]⟩

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.pow
statement: theorem IsRootOfUnityC.pow {ζ : ℂ} (h : IsRootOfUnityC ζ) (m : ℕ) : IsRootOfUnityC (ζ ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hζ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, hn, by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, hζ, one_pow]⟩

name: IngramMello.IsRootOfUnityC.zpow
statement: theorem IsRootOfUnityC.zpow {ζ : ℂ} (h : IsRootOfUnityC ζ) (m : ℤ) : IsRootOfUnityC (ζ ^ m)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq m with hm | hm
  · rw [hm, zpow_natCast]; exact h.pow _
  · rw [hm, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]; exact (h.pow _).inv

name: IngramMello.mann
statement:
theorem mann {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℚ) (ζ : Fin k → ℂ) (hζ : ∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ζ i))
    (hsum : ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0)
    (hmin : ∀ I : Finset (Fin k), I.Nonempty → ∑ i ∈ I, (c i : ℂ) * ζ i = 0 → I = univ)
    (i j : Fin k) : ζ i ^ k.factorial = ζ j ^ k.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hj0 : ζ j ≠ 0 := (hζ j).ne_zero
  have hj0' : (ζ j)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hj0
  have h := mann_normalized c (fun i => ζ i * (ζ j)⁻¹) (fun i => (hζ i).mul (hζ j).inv) j
    (mul_inv_cancel₀ hj0)
    (by simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, zero_mul])
    (by
      intro I hI h
      apply hmin I hI
      simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul] at h
      exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right hj0') i
  simp only [mul_pow, inv_pow] at h
  exact (mul_inv_eq_one₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hj0)).1 h

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.false_of_dominant_coset
statement:
theorem false_of_dominant_coset {r N s : ℕ} (F : MvLaurent r) (hF : F ≠ 0) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ)
    (hFx : F ∈ maxIdeal x ^ (N + 1)) (c : Fin N → ℂ) (η : Fin (r + N) → ℂˣ)
    (B : Matrix (Fin (r + N)) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hBtop : Function.Injective (B.submatrix (Fin.castAdd N) id).transpose.mulVec)
    (hid : ∀ w : Fin s → ℂˣ, evalHom (fun j => monomialMap η B w (Fin.castAdd N j)) F =
      ∑ i, c i * (monomialMap η B w (Fin.natAdd r i) : ℂ)) : False
proof:
:= by
  let ηt : Fin r → ℂˣ := fun j => η (Fin.castAdd N j)
  let Bt := B.submatrix (Fin.castAdd N) id
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_monomialMap_eq ηt Bt hBtop x
  let H : MvLaurent s :=
    ∑ i, single (fun k => B (Fin.natAdd r i) k) (c i * η (Fin.natAdd r i))
  have hPH : pullback ηt Bt F = H := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    apply eq_zero_of_forall_evalHom
    intro w
    rw [map_sub, evalHom_pullback, sub_eq_zero]
    refine (hid w).trans ?_
    simp only [H, map_sum, evalHom_single, monomialMap, Units.val_mul, Units.coe_prod,
      Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, mul_assoc]
  have hne : H ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hPH]
    intro h0
    exact hF (pullback_injective ηt Bt hBtop (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hmem : H ∈ maxIdeal z ^ (N + 1) := by
    rw [← hPH]
    exact pullback_mem_pow ηt Bt z (hz ▸ hFx)
  exact hajos_sum z le_rfl _ _ hne (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right N.le_succ hmem)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_of_not_nonConst
statement:
theorem evalHom_of_not_nonConst {r : ℕ} {F : MvLaurent r} (hF : ¬ NonConst F)
    (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) : evalHom x F = F.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  have hF' : F = single 0 (F.coeff 0) := by
    refine AddMonoidAlgebra.ext (Finsupp.ext fun e => ?_)
    rw [coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h]
    · exact not_not.1 fun hne => hF ⟨e, Ne.symm h, hne⟩
  rw [hF', evalHom_single]
  simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_pullback_projMat
statement:
theorem evalHom_pullback_projMat {r N : ℕ} (y : Fin (r + N) → ℂˣ) (F : MvLaurent r) :
    evalHom y (pullback 1 (projMat r N) F) = evalHom (fun j => y (Fin.castAdd N j)) F
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalHom_pullback]
  congr 2
  funext j
  simp only [monomialMap, projMat, Pi.one_apply, one_mul, Matrix.of_apply]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (Fin.castAdd N j) (fun k _ hk => by simp [hk]) (by simp)]
  simp

name: IngramMello.nonConst_of_isExceptional
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  apply hEx.1
  refine Set.Subsingleton.finite fun t ht t' ht' => hEx.2.2.2 ht ht' ?_
  funext i
  have h1 := MvLaurent.evalHom_of_not_nonConst (h i) t
  have h2 := MvLaurent.evalHom_of_not_nonConst (h i) t'
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: IngramMello.not_isExceptional
statement:
theorem not_isExceptional (hIB : IngramBound) (hDZ : DvornicichZannier) (hL : Laurent)
    (hSA : SuperAttracting) (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
    (hK : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ))
    (T : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ)) : ¬ IsExceptional d K r a T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing K with
  | _ r ih =>
  intro hEx
  let ι := AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (Fin r → ℤ) K.val.toRingHom
  obtain ⟨D, hD, E, -, N, hrep⟩ := exists_W_representations hIB hDZ hd K hK
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed (AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ)) := isIntegrallyClosed_mvLaurent K r
  obtain ⟨A, hAm, hAdvd, hWne, x, q, hq, hord⟩ :=
    exists_highOrderResultant hSA ι hd a (nonConst_of_isExceptional hEx)
  set W := IngramMello.W A (monicCentred d a) (q * (N + 1)) (q * N) with hWdef
  
  have hrep' : ∀ t ∈ T, ∃ (c : Fin N → ↥(insert (0 : ℂ) E)) (ξ : Fin N → ℂˣ),
      (∀ i, IsRootOfUnityC (ξ i : ℂ)) ∧
      (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * MvLaurent.evalOver K t W = ∑ i, (c i : ℂ) * ξ i := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨n, c, ξ, hn, hc, hξ, hsum⟩ := hrep r a A hAm hAdvd t (hEx.2.1 t ht)
      (hEx.2.2.1 t ht) (q * (N + 1)) (q * N)
    have hξ0 : ∀ i, ξ i ≠ 0 := fun i h0 => by
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hm1⟩ := hξ i
      rw [h0, zero_pow hm.ne'] at hm1
      exact zero_ne_one hm1
    refine ⟨fun k => if h : (k : ℕ) < n then ⟨c ⟨k, h⟩, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (hc _)⟩
        else ⟨0, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩,
      fun k => if h : (k : ℕ) < n then Units.mk0 (ξ ⟨k, h⟩) (hξ0 _) else 1, fun k => ?_, ?_⟩
    · by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < n
      · simp only [h, dite_true, Units.val_mk0]
        exact hξ _
      · simp only [h, dite_false, Units.val_one]
        exact ⟨1, one_pos, one_pow 1⟩
    · rw [hsum, sum_fin_pad hn]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
      by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < n <;> simp [h]
  have : Nonempty ↥(insert (0 : ℂ) E) := ⟨⟨0, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩⟩
  choose! cf ξf hξf hsumf using hrep'
  
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ : ∃ c₀ : Fin N → ↥(insert (0 : ℂ) E), {t | t ∈ T ∧ cf t = c₀}.Infinite := by
    by_contra hfin
    push Not at hfin
    apply hEx.1
    refine (Set.finite_iUnion fun c₀ => hfin c₀).subset fun t ht => ?_
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨cf t, ht, rfl⟩
  set T' := {t | t ∈ T ∧ cf t = c₀} with hT'
  
  let lift : (Fin r → ℂˣ) → Fin (r + N) → ℂ := fun t =>
    Fin.append (fun j => (t j : ℂ)) (fun i => (ξf t i : ℂ))
  have hlift_inj : Function.Injective lift := fun t t' h => funext fun j =>
    Units.ext (by simpa [lift] using congrFun h (Fin.castAdd N j))
  have hTt_tor : ∀ p ∈ lift '' T', ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (p j) := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ j
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
    · simpa [lift] using hEx.2.1 t ht.1 j
    · simpa [lift] using hξf t ht.1 i
  obtain ⟨s, η, B, hs, hη, hB, hdense⟩ :=
    hL (r + N) (lift '' T') hTt_tor (hc₀.image hlift_inj.injOn)
  have hη0 : ∀ j, η j ≠ 0 := fun j h0 => by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hm1⟩ := hη j
    rw [h0, zero_pow hm.ne'] at hm1
    exact zero_ne_one hm1
  let ηu : Fin (r + N) → ℂˣ := fun j => Units.mk0 (η j) (hη0 j)
  
  let G : MvLaurent (r + N) :=
    MvLaurent.pullback 1 (MvLaurent.projMat r N)
        (algebraMap ℂ (MvLaurent r) ((D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1)) * ι W) -
      ∑ i, single (Pi.single (Fin.natAdd r i) 1) ((c₀ i : ℂ))
  have hGeval : ∀ p : Fin (r + N) → ℂ, (∀ j, p j ≠ 0) → MvLaurent.eval G p =
      (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * MvLaurent.eval (ι W) (fun j => p (Fin.castAdd N j)) -
        ∑ i, (c₀ i : ℂ) * p (Fin.natAdd r i) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [MvLaurent.eval_eq_evalHom G p hp]
    simp only [G, map_sub, map_sum, MvLaurent.evalHom_pullback_projMat, map_mul,
      AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, MvLaurent.evalHom_single]
    congr 1
    · rw [MvLaurent.evalHom_apply]
      rfl
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      congr 1
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (Fin.natAdd r i) (fun k _ hk => by simp [hk]) (by simp)]
      simp
  have hcoset : ∀ w : Fin s → ℂˣ,
      (D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1) * MvLaurent.eval (ι W)
          (fun j => (MvLaurent.monomialMap ηu B w (Fin.castAdd N j) : ℂ)) =
        ∑ i, (c₀ i : ℂ) * (MvLaurent.monomialMap ηu B w (Fin.natAdd r i) : ℂ) := by
    have hvan : ∀ w : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) → MvLaurent.eval G (cosetPt η B w) = 0 := by
      refine hdense G fun w hw hmem => ?_
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hte⟩ := hmem
      rw [hGeval _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη0 B hw), ← hte, sub_eq_zero]
      have h1 := hsumf t ht.1
      rw [ht.2] at h1
      simp only [lift, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
      rw [← MvLaurent.evalHom_apply]
      exact h1
    intro w
    have hp := hvan (fun k => (w k : ℂ)) (fun k => (w k).ne_zero)
    rw [hGeval _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη0 B fun k => (w k).ne_zero), sub_eq_zero] at hp
    have hc := MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap ηu B w
    have hηu : (fun j => (ηu j : ℂ)) = η := funext fun j => Units.val_mk0 _
    rw [hηu] at hc
    rw [← hc] at hp
    exact hp
  rcases MvLaurent.exists_rank_factorization (B.submatrix (Fin.castAdd N) id) with
    hdom | ⟨r', hr', B₁, B₂, hB₁, hfac⟩
  · 
    have hιW : ι W ≠ 0 := by
      have hW0 : W ≠ 0 := hWne _ _ (by nlinarith)
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, W.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra h'
        push Not at h'
        exact hW0 (AddMonoidAlgebra.ext (Finsupp.ext h'))
      intro h0
      apply he
      have := congrArg (fun F : MvLaurent r => F.coeff e) h0
      simp only [ι, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_mapRingHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero,
        Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
      exact Subtype.ext this
    refine MvLaurent.false_of_dominant_coset (algebraMap ℂ (MvLaurent r) ((D : ℂ) ^ (d - 1)) * ι W)
      ?_ x (Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (hord N)) (fun i => (c₀ i : ℂ)) ηu B hdom fun w => ?_
    · refine mul_ne_zero ?_ hιW
      rw [map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap ℂ (MvLaurent r)).injective]
      exact pow_ne_zero _ (by exact_mod_cast hD.ne')
    · rw [map_mul, AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply,
        MvLaurent.evalHom_apply]
      exact hcoset w
  · 
    let T₀ : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ) := {t | t ∈ T' ∧ lift t ∈ cosetSet η B}
    have hT₀inf : T₀.Infinite := by
      have hinf := infinite_of_laurent_dense hs hη0 hB (lift '' T') hdense
      refine Set.Infinite.of_image lift (hinf.mono ?_)
      rintro _ ⟨⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, hc⟩
      exact ⟨t, ⟨ht, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    have hT₀B : ∀ t ∈ T₀, ∃ w,
        MvLaurent.monomialMap (fun j => ηu (Fin.castAdd N j)) B₁ w = t := by
      rintro t ⟨-, w, hw, hwe⟩
      let wu : Fin s → ℂˣ := fun k => Units.mk0 (w k) (hw k)
      refine ⟨MvLaurent.monomialMap 1 B₂ wu, ?_⟩
      rw [← MvLaurent.monomialMap_mul, ← hfac]
      funext j
      apply Units.ext
      have h1 := congrFun (MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap ηu B wu) (Fin.castAdd N j)
      have h2 := congrFun hwe (Fin.castAdd N j)
      simp only [lift, Fin.append_left] at h2
      change (MvLaurent.monomialMap ηu B wu (Fin.castAdd N j) : ℂ) = t j
      rw [h1, ← h2]
      simp [ηu, wu]
    have : FiniteDimensional ℚ K := hK
    obtain ⟨L, hLf, a', T'', hEx''⟩ := isExceptional_descent hEx
      (fun j => ηu (Fin.castAdd N j)) (fun j => by simpa [ηu] using hη (Fin.castAdd N j))
      B₁ hB₁ T₀ (fun t ht => ht.1.1) hT₀inf hT₀B
    exact ih r' hr' L hLf a' T'' hEx''

name: IngramMello.card_primeFactors_mul_of_dvd
statement:
theorem card_primeFactors_mul_of_dvd {p P₁ : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) (hdvd : p ∣ P₁) :
    (p * P₁).primeFactors.card = P₁.primeFactors.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hp.ne_zero hP₁.ne', hp.primeFactors]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.union_eq_right]
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at hq
  rw [hq, Nat.mem_primeFactors]
  exact ⟨hp, hdvd, hP₁.ne'⟩

name: IngramMello.card_primeFactors_mul_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem card_primeFactors_mul_of_not_dvd {p P₁ : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hP₁ : 0 < P₁)
    (hndvd : ¬ p ∣ P₁) :
    (p * P₁).primeFactors.card = P₁.primeFactors.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul hp.ne_zero hP₁.ne', hp.primeFactors, Finset.singleton_union,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors]
  exact fun h => hndvd h.2.1

name: IngramMello.loxton_sumRoots_bound
statement:
theorem loxton_sumRoots_bound : ∀ P : ℕ, 0 < P → ∀ β ∈ cycInt P,
    ∃ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ P.primeFactors.card * cassM P β ∧ β ∈ SumRoots k
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  induction P using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ P ih =>
  intro hP β hβ
  rcases eq_or_ne P 1 with rfl | hP1
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, hmem⟩ := exists_mem_sumRoots_of_mem_cycInt_one hβ
    exact ⟨k, by simpa using hk, hmem⟩
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, P₁, hPeq⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ ∃ P₁, P = p * P₁ :=
    ⟨P.minFac, Nat.minFac_prime hP1, Nat.minFac_dvd P⟩
  have hP₁ : 0 < P₁ := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left (hPeq ▸ hP)
  have hP₁lt : P₁ < P := by
    rw [hPeq]
    have := hp.two_le
    nlinarith
  have hcassM_nonneg := cassM_nonneg P β
  
  have ih' : ∀ γ ∈ cycInt P₁, ∃ k : ℕ,
      (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * cassM P₁ γ ∧ γ ∈ SumRoots k :=
    ih P₁ hP₁lt hP₁
  subst hPeq
  by_cases hdvd : p ∣ P₁
  · 
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hsum⟩ := exists_cycInt_sum_pow hp.pos hP₁ hβ
    choose k hk hkmem using fun j => ih' (a j) (ha j)
    refine ⟨∑ j, k j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [card_primeFactors_mul_of_dvd hp hP₁ hdvd, hsum,
        cassels_identity_dvd hp hP₁ hdvd a (fun j => mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (ha j)),
        Finset.mul_sum]
      push_cast
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => hk j
    · rw [hsum]
      refine SumRoots.sum _ _ _ fun j _ => ?_
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact SumRoots.mul_root ⟨p * P₁, Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁, by
        rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℕ), pow_mul, (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot
          (Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hP₁)).pow_eq_one, one_pow]⟩ (hkmem j)
  · 
    have hcop : p.Coprime P₁ := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp).2 hdvd
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hdec⟩ := exists_cycInt_sum_pow_sub hp.one_lt hP₁ hcop hβ
    choose k hk hkmem using fun i j => ih' (a j - a i) ((hdec i).1 j)
    have hne : Nonempty (Fin p) := ⟨⟨0, hp.pos⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Finite.exists_min fun i : Fin p => ∑ j, k i j
    refine ⟨∑ j, k i₀ j, ?_, ?_⟩
    · 
      have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
      have h1 : (p : ℝ) * ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (k i j : ℝ) := by
        have : ∀ i : Fin p, ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j, (k i j : ℝ) := fun i => by
          exact_mod_cast hi₀ i
        calc (p : ℝ) * ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) = ∑ _i : Fin p, ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
          _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (k i j : ℝ) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => this i
      have h2 : ∑ i, ∑ j, (k i j : ℝ) ≤
          2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
        rw [← cassM_neg, neg_sub]
        exact hk i j
      have h3 : ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) =
          2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (p * P₁) β := by
        rw [(hdec i₀).2]
        rw [← cassels_identity_coprime hp hP₁ hdvd a (fun j => mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (ha j))]
        rw [sum_sub_mul_zetaC_pow hp.one_lt]
      have h4 : 2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (p * P₁) β ≤ 2 * p * cassM (p * P₁) β := by
        nlinarith
      rw [card_primeFactors_mul_of_not_dvd hp hP₁ hdvd, pow_succ]
      push_cast
      have h5 : (p : ℝ) * ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) ≤
