          (p : ℝ) * (2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * 2 * cassM (p * P₁) β) := by
        calc (p : ℝ) * ∑ j, (k i₀ j : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (k i j : ℝ) := h1
          _ ≤ 2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) := h2
          _ = 2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * (2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (p * P₁) β) := by rw [h3]
          _ ≤ 2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * (2 * p * cassM (p * P₁) β) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity)
          _ = (p : ℝ) * (2 ^ P₁.primeFactors.card * 2 * cassM (p * P₁) β) := by ring
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h5 hp0
    · rw [(hdec i₀).2]
      refine SumRoots.sum _ _ _ fun j _ => ?_
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact SumRoots.mul_root ⟨p, hp.pos, by
        rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℕ), pow_mul, (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hp.pos).pow_eq_one,
          one_pow]⟩ (hkmem i₀ j)

name: IngramMello.eq_zero_of_cassM_lt_one
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_cassM_lt_one {P : ℕ} (hP : 0 < P) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ∈ cycInt P)
    (h : cassM P β < 1) : β = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  exact absurd (one_le_cassM hP (mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt hβ) (isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt hP hβ)
    hne) (not_le.2 h)

name: IngramMello.card_filter_ne_zero_le_sum_cassM
statement:
theorem card_filter_ne_zero_le_sum_cassM {P₁ : ℕ} (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ j, c j ∈ cycInt P₁) :
    (((univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j ≠ 0).card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum]
  push_cast
  calc (∑ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun j => c j ≠ 0), (1 : ℝ))
      ≤ ∑ j ∈ (univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter (fun j => c j ≠ 0), cassM P₁ (c j) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
        rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hj
        exact one_le_cassM hP₁ (mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (hc j))
          (isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt hP₁ (hc j)) hj.2
    _ ≤ ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
          fun j _ _ => cassM_nonneg _ _

name: IngramMello.cassM_sub_ge_ite
statement:
theorem cassM_sub_ge_ite (P : ℕ) (x y : ℂ) :
    (if y = 0 then cassM P x else 0) + (if x = 0 then cassM P y else 0) ≤ cassM P (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y = 0 <;> by_cases hx : x = 0 <;> simp [hx, hy, cassM_zero, cassM_nonneg, cassM_neg]

name: IngramMello.two_mul_card_mul_sum_le
statement:
theorem two_mul_card_mul_sum_le {P : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ) :
    2 * ((((univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card : ℝ) * ∑ i, cassM P (c i)) ≤
      ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P (c i - c j)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : ∀ f : Fin n → ℝ, ∑ i, ∑ j, (if c j = 0 then f i else 0) =
      (((univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card : ℝ) * ∑ i, f i := by
    intro f
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  calc 2 * ((((univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card : ℝ) * ∑ i, cassM P (c i))
      = ∑ i, ∑ j, (if c j = 0 then cassM P (c i) else 0) +
          ∑ i, ∑ j, (if c i = 0 then cassM P (c j) else 0) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => if c i = 0 then cassM P (c j) else 0), hsplit]
        ring
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((if c j = 0 then cassM P (c i) else 0) +
          (if c i = 0 then cassM P (c j) else 0)) := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P (c i - c j) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => cassM_sub_ge_ite P _ _

name: IngramMello.loxton_ineq
statement:
theorem loxton_ineq {p Z X : ℕ} {T B M : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hM : M ≤ B) (_hT0 : 0 ≤ T)
    (hZX : Z + X = p) (hZ : (p : ℝ) < 2 * Z) (hA : (Z : ℝ) * T ≤ ((p : ℝ) - 1) * M)
    (hXT : (X : ℝ) ≤ T) (hp : 4 * B ^ 2 + 2 * B < p) :
    T ≤ B + 1 / 2 ∧ (X = 1 → T ≤ B)
proof:
:= by
  have hZX' : (Z : ℝ) + X = p := by exact_mod_cast hZX
  have hX0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X := Nat.cast_nonneg X
  have hZ0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Z := Nat.cast_nonneg Z
  have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) < p := by nlinarith
  constructor
  · 
    have hX2B : (X : ℝ) < 2 * B := by
      by_contra hcon
      push Not at hcon
      have h1 : (Z : ℝ) * X ≤ Z * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXT hZ0
      have h2 : (Z : ℝ) * (2 * B) ≤ Z * X := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcon hZ0
      nlinarith
    
    have hZbig : 4 * B ^ 2 < (Z : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have h3 : (Z : ℝ) * (B + 1 / 2) < Z * T :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcon (by nlinarith)
    nlinarith
  · intro hX1
    subst hX1
    have hZp : (Z : ℝ) = p - 1 := by push_cast at hZX'; linarith
    rw [hZp] at hA
    have := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hA (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < p - 1)
    linarith

name: IngramMello.cassels_majority
statement:
theorem cassels_majority {p P₁ : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) (hndvd : ¬ p ∣ P₁)
    (a : Fin p → ℂ) (ha : ∀ j, a j ∈ cycInt P₁) {B : ℝ}
    (hM : cassM (p * P₁) (∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ)) ≤ B) (hpB : 4 * B < p) :
    ∃ i₀ : Fin p,
      (p : ℝ) < 2 * (((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i₀ = 0).card)
proof:
:= by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (cassM_nonneg _ _).trans hM
  have hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p := by exact_mod_cast hp.pos
  
  have hN : ∀ i : Fin p, ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i ≠ 0).card : ℝ)) ≤
      ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) := by
    intro i
    have := card_filter_ne_zero_le_sum_cassM hP₁ (fun j => a j - a i)
      (fun j => (cycInt P₁).sub_mem (ha j) (ha i))
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_))
    rw [← cassM_neg, neg_sub]
  have hsum : ∑ i, ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i ≠ 0).card : ℝ)) ≤
      2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * B := by
    calc ∑ i, ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i ≠ 0).card : ℝ))
        ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a i - a j) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hN i
      _ = 2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (p * P₁) (∑ j, a j * zetaC p ^ (j : ℕ)) :=
          (cassels_identity_coprime hp hP₁ hndvd a
            (fun j => mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (ha j))).symm
      _ ≤ 2 * ((p : ℝ) - 1) * B := by
          have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.one_le
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM (by linarith)
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  
  have hlow : ∀ i : Fin p, (p : ℝ) ≤
      2 * ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i ≠ 0).card : ℝ)) := by
    intro i
    have h := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin p)))
      (fun j => a j - a i = 0)
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
    have h' : ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i = 0).card : ℝ)) +
        ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => ¬ a j - a i = 0).card : ℝ)) = p := by
      exact_mod_cast h
    have := hcon i
    simp only [ne_eq]
    linarith
  have htot : (p : ℝ) * p ≤
      2 * ∑ i, ((((univ : Finset (Fin p)).filter fun j => a j - a i ≠ 0).card : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc (p : ℝ) * p = ∑ _i : Fin p, (p : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hlow i
  nlinarith

name: IngramMello.sum_mem_sumRoots_of_bounds
statement:
theorem sum_mem_sumRoots_of_bounds {P₁ : ℕ} (hP₁ : 0 < P₁) {B : ℝ} (hB : 1 ≤ B) {Λ Λ' : ℕ}
    (hΛ : ⌈2 * B⌉₊ * Λ' ≤ Λ)
    (hinner : ∀ γ ∈ cycInt P₁, cassM P₁ γ ≤ B → γ ∈ SumRoots Λ)
    (houter : ∀ γ ∈ cycInt P₁, cassM P₁ γ ≤ B - 1 / 2 → γ ∈ SumRoots Λ')
    {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℂ) (hc : ∀ j, c j ∈ cycInt P₁) (ρ : Fin n → ℂ)
    (hρ : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (ρ j)) (hT : ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j) ≤ B + 1 / 2)
    (hT1 : ((univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j ≠ 0).card = 1 →
      ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j) ≤ B) :
    ∑ j, c j * ρ j ∈ SumRoots Λ
proof:
:= by
  set S := (univ : Finset (Fin n)).filter fun j => c j ≠ 0 with hS
  have hsumS : ∑ j, c j * ρ j = ∑ j ∈ S, c j * ρ j := by
    rw [hS, Finset.sum_filter_of_ne]
    intro j _ hj h0
    exact hj (by rw [h0, zero_mul])
  have hcard : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j) := card_filter_ne_zero_le_sum_cassM hP₁ c hc
  have hone : ∀ j ∈ S, 1 ≤ cassM P₁ (c j) := fun j hj => by
    rw [hS, Finset.mem_filter] at hj
    exact one_le_cassM hP₁ (mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (hc j))
      (isIntegral_of_mem_cycInt hP₁ (hc j)) hj.2
  have hSle : ∑ j ∈ S, cassM P₁ (c j) ≤ ∑ j, cassM P₁ (c j) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.filter_subset _ _) fun j _ _ => cassM_nonneg _ _
  have hSceil : S.card ≤ ⌈2 * B⌉₊ := by
    have h1 : (S.card : ℝ) < 2 * B := by linarith
    have h2 : (2 * B : ℝ) ≤ ⌈2 * B⌉₊ := Nat.le_ceil _
    exact_mod_cast h1.le.trans h2
  rw [hsumS]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge S.card 2 with hlt | hge
  · have h01 : S.card = 0 ∨ S.card = 1 := by omega
    rcases h01 with h | h
    · rw [Finset.card_eq_zero.1 h, Finset.sum_empty]
      exact SumRoots.zero_mem Λ
    · obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 h
      rw [hj₀, Finset.sum_singleton, mul_comm]
      have hM : cassM P₁ (c j₀) ≤ B :=
        (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => cassM_nonneg P₁ (c j)) (Finset.mem_univ j₀)).trans
          (hT1 h)
      exact SumRoots.mul_root (hρ j₀) (hinner _ (hc j₀) hM)
  · have hsmall : ∀ j ∈ S, cassM P₁ (c j) ≤ B - 1 / 2 := by
      intro j hj
      have h1 : ∑ i ∈ S, cassM P₁ (c i) = cassM P₁ (c j) + ∑ i ∈ S.erase j, cassM P₁ (c i) :=
        (Finset.add_sum_erase S _ hj).symm
      have h2 : ((S.erase j).card : ℝ) ≤ ∑ i ∈ S.erase j, cassM P₁ (c i) := by
        rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Nat.cast_sum]
        push_cast
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hone i (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi)
      have h3 : (S.erase j).card = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hj
      have h4 : ((S.card - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = S.card - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]; simp
      have h5 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ S.card := by exact_mod_cast hge
      rw [h3, h4] at h2
      linarith
    have hmem : ∑ j ∈ S, c j * ρ j ∈ SumRoots (∑ _j ∈ S, Λ') := by
      refine SumRoots.sum S _ _ fun j hj => ?_
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact SumRoots.mul_root (hρ j) (houter _ (hc j) (hsmall j hj))
    refine SumRoots.mono ?_ hmem
    rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul]
    exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_right Λ' hSceil).trans hΛ

name: IngramMello.loxton_step
proof:
:= by
  set p₀ : ℕ := ⌈4 * B ^ 2 + 2 * B⌉₊ + 1 with hp₀
  refine ⟨max ⌈(2 : ℝ) ^ p₀ * B⌉₊ (⌈2 * B⌉₊ * Λ'), ?_⟩
  set Λ := max ⌈(2 : ℝ) ^ p₀ * B⌉₊ (⌈2 * B⌉₊ * Λ') with hΛ
  intro P
  induction P using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ P ih =>
  intro hP β hβ hM
  by_cases hsmall : ∀ q ∈ P.primeFactors, q < p₀
  · 
    have hω : P.primeFactors.card ≤ p₀ := by
      calc P.primeFactors.card ≤ (Finset.range p₀).card :=
            Finset.card_le_card fun q hq => Finset.mem_range.2 (hsmall q hq)
        _ = p₀ := Finset.card_range p₀
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hmem⟩ := loxton_sumRoots_bound P hP β hβ
    refine SumRoots.mono ?_ hmem
    have h1 : (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ p₀ * B := by
      calc (k : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ P.primeFactors.card * cassM P β := hk
        _ ≤ 2 ^ p₀ * B :=
          mul_le_mul (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hω) hM (cassM_nonneg _ _) (by positivity)
    have h2 : k ≤ ⌈(2 : ℝ) ^ p₀ * B⌉₊ := by exact_mod_cast h1.trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
    exact h2.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · push Not at hsmall
    obtain ⟨q, hqmem, hq₀⟩ := hsmall
    rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hqmem
    obtain ⟨hq, hqdvd, -⟩ := hqmem
    obtain ⟨P₁, rfl⟩ := hqdvd
    have hP₁ : 0 < P₁ := Nat.pos_of_mul_pos_left hP
    have hP₁lt : P₁ < q * P₁ := by
      have := hq.two_le
      nlinarith
    have hinner : ∀ γ ∈ cycInt P₁, cassM P₁ γ ≤ B → γ ∈ SumRoots Λ := ih P₁ hP₁lt hP₁
    have houter : ∀ γ ∈ cycInt P₁, cassM P₁ γ ≤ B - 1 / 2 → γ ∈ SumRoots Λ' := hΛ' P₁ hP₁
    have hΛge : ⌈2 * B⌉₊ * Λ' ≤ Λ := le_max_right _ _
    have hq₀' : 4 * B ^ 2 + 2 * B < q := by
      have h1 : (4 * B ^ 2 + 2 * B : ℝ) ≤ ⌈4 * B ^ 2 + 2 * B⌉₊ := Nat.le_ceil _
      have h2 : (p₀ : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq₀
      rw [hp₀] at h2
      push_cast at h2
      linarith
    by_cases hdvd : q ∣ P₁
    · 
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hsum⟩ := exists_cycInt_sum_pow hq.pos hP₁ hβ
      have hT : ∑ j, cassM P₁ (a j) ≤ B := by
        rw [← cassels_identity_dvd hq hP₁ hdvd a (fun j => mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (ha j)),
          ← hsum]
        exact hM
      rw [hsum]
      exact sum_mem_sumRoots_of_bounds hP₁ hB hΛge hinner houter a ha
        (fun j => zetaC (q * P₁) ^ (j : ℕ))
        (fun j => ⟨q * P₁, Nat.mul_pos hq.pos hP₁, by
          rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℕ), pow_mul,
            (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot (Nat.mul_pos hq.pos hP₁)).pow_eq_one, one_pow]⟩)
        (hT.trans (by linarith)) (fun _ => hT)
    · 
      have hcop : q.Coprime P₁ := (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hq).2 hdvd
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hdec⟩ := exists_cycInt_sum_pow_sub hq.one_lt hP₁ hcop hβ
      have hβa : β = ∑ j, a j * zetaC q ^ (j : ℕ) := by
        rw [(hdec ⟨0, hq.pos⟩).2, sum_sub_mul_zetaC_pow hq.one_lt]
      have hMa : cassM (q * P₁) (∑ j, a j * zetaC q ^ (j : ℕ)) ≤ B := hβa ▸ hM
      have h4B : 4 * B < q := by nlinarith
      obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := cassels_majority hq hP₁ hdvd a ha hMa h4B
      obtain ⟨c, hcdef⟩ : ∃ c : Fin q → ℂ, c = fun j => a j - a i₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      have hcmem : ∀ j, c j ∈ cycInt P₁ := by rw [hcdef]; exact (hdec i₀).1
      have hβc : β = ∑ j, c j * zetaC q ^ (j : ℕ) := by rw [hcdef]; exact (hdec i₀).2
      have hi₀' : (q : ℝ) <
          2 * (((univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card : ℝ) := by
        rw [hcdef]; exact hi₀
      have hZX : ((univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card +
          ((univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter fun j => c j ≠ 0).card = q := by
        have := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin q)))
          (fun j => c j = 0)
        rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
        simpa only [ne_eq] using this
      have hA : ((((univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter fun j => c j = 0).card : ℝ)) *
          ∑ i, cassM P₁ (c i) ≤ ((q : ℝ) - 1) * cassM (q * P₁) β := by
        have h1 := two_mul_card_mul_sum_le (P := P₁) c
        rw [← cassels_identity_coprime hq hP₁ hdvd c
          (fun j => mem_cycField_of_mem_cycInt (hcmem j)), ← hβc] at h1
        linarith
      have hXT : ((((univ : Finset (Fin q)).filter fun j => c j ≠ 0).card : ℝ)) ≤
          ∑ i, cassM P₁ (c i) := card_filter_ne_zero_le_sum_cassM hP₁ c hcmem
      obtain ⟨hT, hT1⟩ := loxton_ineq hB hM (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => cassM_nonneg _ _)
        hZX hi₀' hA hXT hq₀'
      rw [hβc]
      exact sum_mem_sumRoots_of_bounds hP₁ hB hΛge hinner houter c hcmem
        (fun j => zetaC q ^ (j : ℕ))
        (fun j => ⟨q, hq.pos, by
          rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm (j : ℕ), pow_mul, (zetaC_isPrimitiveRoot hq.pos).pow_eq_one,
            one_pow]⟩) hT hT1

name: IngramMello.loxton_qualitative
statement:
theorem loxton_qualitative (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ Λ : ℕ, ∀ P, 0 < P → ∀ β ∈ cycInt P, cassM P β ≤ B → β ∈ SumRoots Λ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ B : ℝ, B ≤ n / 2 →
      ∃ Λ : ℕ, ∀ P, 0 < P → ∀ β ∈ cycInt P, cassM P β ≤ B → β ∈ SumRoots Λ := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro B hB
      refine ⟨0, fun P hP β hβ hM => ?_⟩
      rw [eq_zero_of_cassM_lt_one hP hβ (by simp at hB; linarith)]
      exact SumRoots.zero_mem 0
    | succ n ih =>
      intro B hB
      by_cases hB1 : B < 1
      · refine ⟨0, fun P hP β hβ hM => ?_⟩
        rw [eq_zero_of_cassM_lt_one hP hβ (by linarith)]
        exact SumRoots.zero_mem 0
      · push Not at hB1
        obtain ⟨Λ', hΛ'⟩ := ih (B - 1 / 2) (by push_cast at hB; linarith)
        exact loxton_step hB1 hΛ'
  exact key ⌈2 * B⌉₊ B (by
    have := Nat.le_ceil (2 * B)
    linarith)

name: IngramMello.loxton_house
statement:
theorem loxton_house (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ Λ : ℕ, ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ β ∈ cycField n, IsIntegral ℤ β → HouseLE β B → β ∈ SumRoots Λ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Λ, hΛ⟩ := loxton_qualitative (B ^ 2)
  refine ⟨Λ, fun n hn β hβ hint hhouse => ?_⟩
  exact hΛ n hn β ((mem_cycInt_iff hn).2 ⟨hβ, hint⟩) (cassM_le_sq_of_houseLE hn hβ hhouse)

name: IngramMello.critProd_monic
statement: theorem critProd_monic {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → R) : (critProd c).Monic
proof:
:=
  monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C (c i)

name: IngramMello.critProd_natDegree
statement:
theorem critProd_natDegree [Nontrivial R] {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → R) :
    (critProd c).natDegree = n
proof:
:= by
  unfold critProd
  rw [natDegree_prod_of_monic _ _ fun i _ => monic_X_sub_C (c i)]
  simp

name: IngramMello.map_critProd
statement:
theorem map_critProd {S : Type*} [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S) {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → R) :
    (critProd c).map φ = critProd (φ ∘ c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold critProd
  simp [Polynomial.map_prod]

name: IngramMello.derivative_Phi
statement:
theorem derivative_Phi (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (c : Fin (d - 1) → R) :
    derivative (Phi d c) = critProd c
proof:
:= by
  unfold Phi
  rw [derivative_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [(critProd c).as_sum_range' d (by
    rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial R with h | h
    · simp [Subsingleton.elim (critProd c) 0]; omega
    · rw [critProd_natDegree]; omega)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [derivative_C_mul_X_pow, Nat.add_sub_cancel, ← C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
  congr 2
  have h1 : (algebraMap ℚ R) ((k : ℚ) + 1)⁻¹ * ((k : R) + 1) = 1 := by
    rw [show ((k : R) + 1) = algebraMap ℚ R ((k : ℚ) + 1) by simp, ← map_mul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), map_one]
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, Nat.cast_add_one, mul_assoc, mul_comm ((critProd c).coeff k),
    ← mul_assoc, h1, one_mul]

name: IngramMello.eval_zero_Phi
statement: theorem eval_zero_Phi (d : ℕ) (c : Fin (d - 1) → R) : (Phi d c).eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold Phi
  simp [eval_finsetSum]

name: IngramMello.map_Phi
statement:
theorem map_Phi {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S] (φ : R →ₐ[ℚ] S) (d : ℕ)
    (c : Fin (d - 1) → R) : (Phi d c).map φ = Phi d (φ ∘ c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Phi
  rw [Polynomial.map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  have h : (critProd (φ ∘ c)).coeff k = φ ((critProd c).coeff k) := by
    have := congrArg (fun P => P.coeff k) (map_critProd (φ : R →+* S) c)
    simpa [coeff_map] using this.symm
  simp only [Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_pow, map_X, map_C, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom, h,
    map_smul]

name: IngramMello.algHom_eval
statement:
theorem algHom_eval {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ R] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (φ : R →ₐ[ℚ] S) (P : R[X]) (x : R) : φ (P.eval x) = (P.map φ).eval (φ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_map]
  exact (eval₂_hom (φ : R →+* S) x).symm

name: IngramMello.aeval_G
statement:
theorem aeval_G {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra ℚ R] (c : Fin (d - 1) → R) (j : Fin (d - 1)) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval c (G d j) = (Phi d c).eval (c j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold G
  rw [algHom_eval, map_Phi]
  simp [Function.comp_def]

name: IngramMello.Phi_eq_zero_of_forall_eval_crit
statement:
theorem Phi_eq_zero_of_forall_eval_crit (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (c : Fin (d - 1) → k)
    (h : ∀ j, (Phi d c).eval (c j) = 0) : c = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := Phi d c with hP
  have hP' : derivative P = critProd c := derivative_Phi d (by omega) c
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := hP'
    rw [h0, derivative_zero] at this
    exact (critProd_monic c).ne_zero this.symm
  have hdeg : P.natDegree ≤ d := by
    rw [hP]; unfold Phi
    refine natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le _ _ fun i hi => ?_
    exact (natDegree_C_mul_X_pow_le _ _).trans (by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega)
  have hroots : (critProd c).roots = Finset.univ.val.map c := by
    unfold critProd
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod, show (Multiset.map (fun i => X - C (c i)) Finset.univ.val)
      = Multiset.map (fun a => X - C a) (Multiset.map c Finset.univ.val) by
      rw [Multiset.map_map]; rfl, roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C]
  have hmult : ∀ j, (Finset.univ.val.map c).count (c j) + 1 ≤ P.roots.count (c j) := by
    intro j
    have h1 : (Finset.univ.val.map c).count (c j) = P.rootMultiplicity (c j) - 1 := by
      rw [← hroots, count_roots, ← hP', derivative_rootMultiplicity_of_root (h j)]
    have h2 : 0 < P.rootMultiplicity (c j) := (rootMultiplicity_pos hP0).mpr (h j)
    rw [count_roots, h1]; omega
  set T : Finset k := insert 0 (Finset.univ.val.map c).toFinset with hT
  have hTle : ∀ α ∈ T, (Finset.univ.val.map c).count α + 1 ≤ P.roots.count α := by
    intro α hα
    rw [hT, Finset.mem_insert, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Multiset.mem_map] at hα
    rcases hα with rfl | ⟨j, -, rfl⟩
    · by_cases h0 : ∃ j, c j = 0
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h0
        rw [← hj]; exact hmult j
      · push Not at h0
        have hc0 : (Finset.univ.val.map c).count 0 = 0 := by
          rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero, Multiset.mem_map]
          rintro ⟨j, -, hj⟩
          exact h0 j hj
        rw [hc0, count_roots]
        exact (rootMultiplicity_pos hP0).mpr (eval_zero_Phi d c)
    · exact hmult j
  have hsub : T ⊆ P.roots.toFinset := by
    intro α hα
    rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, ← Multiset.count_pos]
    have := hTle α hα; omega
  have hsum1 : ∑ α ∈ T, ((Finset.univ.val.map c).count α + 1) ≤ ∑ α ∈ T, P.roots.count α :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hTle
  have hsum2 : ∑ α ∈ T, P.roots.count α ≤ d := by
    calc ∑ α ∈ T, P.roots.count α ≤ ∑ α ∈ P.roots.toFinset, P.roots.count α :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub
      _ = Multiset.card P.roots := Multiset.toFinset_sum_count_eq _
      _ ≤ P.natDegree := card_roots' P
      _ ≤ d := hdeg
  have hsum3 : ∑ α ∈ T, (Finset.univ.val.map c).count α = d - 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_insert _ _) (fun x _ hx => by
      rwa [Multiset.count_eq_zero, ← Multiset.mem_toFinset]),
      Multiset.toFinset_sum_count_eq]
    simp
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, hsum3] at hsum1
  have hcard : T.card ≤ 1 := by omega
  have hT0 : ∀ α ∈ T, α = 0 := by
    intro α hα
    exact Finset.card_le_one.mp hcard α hα 0 (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  funext j
  exact hT0 (c j) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr
    (Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ_val _, rfl⟩)))

name: IngramMello.exists_certificate
statement:
theorem exists_certificate (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ) (F : Fin (d - 1) → Fin (d - 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (d - 1)) ℚ), 0 < e ∧
      ∀ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ e = ∑ j, F i j * G d j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin (d - 1)) ℚ) := Ideal.span (Set.range (G d)) with hI
  have hrad : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.X i ∈ I.radical := by
    intro i
    rw [← MvPolynomial.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (K := ℂ),
      MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      apply Phi_eq_zero_of_forall_eval_crit d hd x
      intro j
      rw [← aeval_G]
      exact hx _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    simp [hx0]
  choose e he using fun i => (Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp (hrad i))
  have hmem : ∀ i, MvPolynomial.X i ^ (Finset.univ.sup e + 1) ∈ I := by
    intro i
    have : Finset.univ.sup e + 1 = e i + (Finset.univ.sup e + 1 - e i) := by
      have := Finset.le_sup (f := e) (Finset.mem_univ i); omega
    rw [this, pow_add]
    exact I.mul_mem_right _ (he i)
  have hspan : ∀ i, ∃ F : Fin (d - 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin (d - 1)) ℚ,
      ∑ j, F j * G d j = MvPolynomial.X i ^ (Finset.univ.sup e + 1) := by
    intro i
    have := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun (MvPolynomial (Fin (d - 1)) ℚ)).mp (hmem i)
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using this
  choose F hF using hspan
  exact ⟨_, F, Nat.succ_pos _, fun i => (hF i).symm⟩

name: IngramMello.Phi_comp_smul
statement:
theorem Phi_comp_smul (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (l : F) :
    (Phi d fun i => l * c i).comp (C l * X) = C (l ^ d) * Phi d c
proof:
:= by
  have hl : C l * C l ^ (d - 1) = C (l ^ d) := by
    rw [← C_pow, ← C_mul, ← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel hd]
  have hder : derivative ((Phi d fun i => l * c i).comp (C l * X) - C (l ^ d) * Phi d c) = 0 := by
    simp only [derivative_sub, derivative_comp, derivative_Phi d hd, derivative_mul, derivative_C,
      derivative_X, zero_mul, zero_add, mul_one]
    unfold critProd
    rw [prod_comp]
    simp only [sub_comp, X_comp, C_comp]
    have : ∀ i, C l * X - C (l * c i) = C l * (X - C (c i)) := fun i => by rw [C_mul, mul_sub]
    simp_rw [this]
    rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      ← mul_assoc, hl, sub_self]
  have h0 : ((Phi d fun i => l * c i).comp (C l * X) - C (l ^ d) * Phi d c).eval 0 = 0 := by
    simp [eval_comp, eval_zero_Phi]
  have := eq_C_of_derivative_eq_zero hder
  rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, h0, C_0] at this
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: IngramMello.Phi_eval_smul
statement:
theorem Phi_eval_smul (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (l z : F) :
    (Phi d fun i => l * c i).eval (l * z) = l ^ d * (Phi d c).eval z
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (eval z) (Phi_comp_smul d hd c l)
  simpa [eval_comp] using this

name: IngramMello.denClear_pos
statement: theorem denClear_pos {σ : Type*} (F : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : 0 < denClear F
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_pos fun _ _ => Rat.den_pos _

name: IngramMello.den_dvd_denClear
statement:
theorem den_dvd_denClear {σ : Type*} (F : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (F.coeff m).den ∣ denClear F
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m ∈ F.support
  · exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ hm
  · rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hm]; simp

name: IngramMello.exists_int_mul_coeff
statement:
theorem exists_int_mul_coeff {σ : Type*} (F : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ m', (F.coeff m').den ∣ N) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) : ∃ z : ℤ, (N : ℚ) * F.coeff m = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hN m
  refine ⟨(F.coeff m).num * t, ?_⟩
  rw [ht]; push_cast
  have h := Rat.mul_den_eq_num (F.coeff m)
  linear_combination (t : ℚ) * h

name: IngramMello.val_natCast_le_one
statement: theorem val_natCast_le_one (n : ℕ) : v (n : F) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [Nat.cast_succ]; exact v.map_add_le ih (by simp)

name: IngramMello.val_intCast_le_one
statement: theorem val_intCast_le_one (z : ℤ) : v (z : F) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg z with ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩
  · exact_mod_cast val_natCast_le_one v n
  · rw [Int.cast_neg, Valuation.map_neg]; exact_mod_cast val_natCast_le_one v n

name: IngramMello.val_natCast_mul_aeval_le_one
statement:
theorem val_natCast_mul_aeval_le_one [CharZero F] {σ : Type*} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ m, (P.coeff m).den ∣ N) (x : σ → F) (hx : ∀ i, v (x i) ≤ 1) :
    v ((N : F) * MvPolynomial.aeval x P) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_eq_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  refine v.map_sum_le fun m _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_int_mul_coeff P N hN m
  have : (N : F) * (algebraMap ℚ F (P.coeff m) * ∏ i ∈ m.support, x i ^ m i)
      = (z : F) * ∏ i ∈ m.support, x i ^ m i := by
    rw [← mul_assoc]; congr 1
    rw [eq_ratCast, ← Rat.cast_natCast, ← Rat.cast_mul, hz, Rat.cast_intCast]
  rw [this, Valuation.map_mul]
  calc v (z : F) * v (∏ i ∈ m.support, x i ^ m i) ≤ 1 * 1 := by
        refine mul_le_mul' (val_intCast_le_one v z) ?_
        rw [map_prod]
        exact Finset.prod_le_one fun i _ => by rw [Valuation.map_pow]; exact pow_le_one' (hx i) _
    _ = 1 := mul_one 1

name: IngramMello.exists_ingram_local
statement:
theorem exists_ingram_local (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ∃ N₀ : ℕ, 0 < N₀ ∧
      ∀ (F : Type u) [Field F] [CharZero F] (Γ₀ : Type w) [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero Γ₀]
        (v : Valuation F Γ₀) (c : Fin (d - 1) → F) (i : Fin (d - 1)),
        ∃ j, v (N₀ : F) * v (c i) ^ d ≤ v ((Phi d c).eval (c j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, Fc, he, hFc⟩ := exists_certificate d hd
  refine ⟨∏ i, ∏ j, denClear (Fc i j),
    Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => Finset.prod_pos fun j _ => denClear_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro F _ _ Γ₀ _ v c i
  set N₀ : ℕ := ∏ i, ∏ j, denClear (Fc i j) with hN₀
  have hden : ∀ i j m, ((Fc i j).coeff m).den ∣ N₀ := fun i j m =>
    (den_dvd_denClear _ m).trans ((Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
      (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun i => ∏ j, denClear (Fc i j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)))
  have hN0ne : v (N₀ : F) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Finset.prod_pos fun i _ =>
      Finset.prod_pos fun j _ => denClear_pos _).ne'
  by_cases hci : c i = 0
  · exact ⟨i, by rw [hci, Valuation.map_zero, zero_pow (by omega), mul_zero]; exact zero_le⟩
  have hne : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (d - 1))).Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i⟩
  obtain ⟨i₀, -, hi₀⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ (fun k => v (c k)) hne
  have hvi₀ : v (c i₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [h0] at this
    exact hci ((Valuation.zero_iff v).mp (le_antisymm this zero_le))
  have hci₀ : c i₀ ≠ 0 := fun h => hvi₀ (by rw [h, Valuation.map_zero])
  set x : Fin (d - 1) → F := fun k => c k * (c i₀)⁻¹ with hx
  have hcx : ∀ k, c k = c i₀ * x k := fun k => by
    rw [hx]; simp only; field_simp
  have hx1 : ∀ k, v (x k) ≤ 1 := fun k => by
    rw [hx]; simp only
    rw [Valuation.map_mul, map_inv₀]
    calc v (c k) * (v (c i₀))⁻¹ ≤ v (c i₀) * (v (c i₀))⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_left (hi₀ k (Finset.mem_univ k)) _
      _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hvi₀
  have hxi₀ : x i₀ = 1 := by rw [hx]; simp only; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hci₀
  have hcert : (1 : F) = ∑ j, MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j) * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := by
    have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval x) (hFc i₀)
    rw [map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, hxi₀, one_pow, map_sum] at this
    simpa [aeval_G] using this
  have hhom : ∀ j, (Phi d c).eval (c j) = c i₀ ^ d * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := by
    intro j
    have hc : c = fun k => c i₀ * x k := funext hcx
    calc (Phi d c).eval (c j) = (Phi d fun k => c i₀ * x k).eval (c i₀ * x j) := by
          rw [← hcx j, ← hc]
      _ = c i₀ ^ d * (Phi d x).eval (x j) := Phi_eval_smul d (by omega) x (c i₀) (x j)
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hlt : ∀ j, v ((Phi d x).eval (x j)) < v (N₀ : F) := by
    intro j
    have h1 := hcon j
    rw [hhom j, Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow] at h1
    have h2 : v (N₀ : F) * v (c i) ^ d ≤ v (N₀ : F) * v (c i₀) ^ d :=
      mul_le_mul_right (pow_le_pow_left' (hi₀ i (Finset.mem_univ i)) d) _
    have h3 := lt_of_lt_of_le h1 h2
    rw [mul_comm (v (N₀ : F))] at h3
    exact lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left' h3
  have hsum : v ((N₀ : F) * ∑ j, MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j) * (Phi d x).eval (x j))
      < v (N₀ : F) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine v.map_sum_lt hN0ne fun j _ => ?_
    rw [← mul_assoc, Valuation.map_mul]
    calc v ((N₀ : F) * MvPolynomial.aeval x (Fc i₀ j)) * v ((Phi d x).eval (x j))
        ≤ 1 * v ((Phi d x).eval (x j)) :=
          mul_le_mul_left (val_natCast_mul_aeval_le_one v _ N₀ (hden i₀ j) x hx1) _
      _ = v ((Phi d x).eval (x j)) := one_mul _
      _ < v (N₀ : F) := hlt j
  rw [← hcert, mul_one] at hsum
  exact lt_irrefl _ hsum

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.pullbackOver_single
statement:
theorem pullbackOver_single {K L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ} (hKL : K ≤ L)
    (η : Fin r → Lˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (c : K) :
    pullbackOver hKL η B (single a c) =
      single (B.transpose.mulVec a)
        (IntermediateField.inclusion hKL c * ((∏ j, η j ^ a j : Lˣ) : L))
proof:
:= by
  simp [pullbackOver, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_single, smul_single, smul_eq_mul]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalOver_pullbackOver
statement:
theorem evalOver_pullbackOver {K L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ} (hKL : K ≤ L)
    (η : Fin r → Lˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ)
    (F : AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ)) :
    evalOver L w (pullbackOver hKL η B F) =
      evalOver K (monomialMap (fun j => Units.map L.val.toMonoidHom (η j)) B w) F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F G hF hG => simp only [map_add, hF, hG]
  | single a c =>
    rw [pullbackOver_single]
    have h := evalHom_pullback (fun j => Units.map L.val.toMonoidHom (η j)) B w
      (single a (c : ℂ))
    simp only [evalOver, RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      mapRingHom_single] at h ⊢
    rw [pullback_single] at h
    convert h using 3
    · simp only [Units.coe_prod, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, map_mul, map_prod, map_zpow₀]
      rfl
    · rfl

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.monomialMap_mul
statement:
theorem monomialMap_mul {t : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B₁ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℤ)
    (B₂ : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin s) ℤ) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) :
    monomialMap η (B₁ * B₂) w = monomialMap η B₁ (monomialMap 1 B₂ w)
proof:
:= by
  have h := monomialMap_one_comp B₂ B₁ w
  funext j
  have hj := congrFun h j
  simp only [monomialMap, Pi.one_apply, one_mul] at hj ⊢
  rw [hj]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_rank_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_rank_factorization {r s : ℕ} (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ) :
    Function.Injective B.transpose.mulVec ∨
      ∃ r' < r, ∃ (B₁ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r') ℤ) (B₂ : Matrix (Fin r') (Fin s) ℤ),
        Function.Injective B₁.mulVec ∧ B = B₁ * B₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Submodule ℤ (Fin r → ℤ) := LinearMap.range B.mulVecLin
  obtain ⟨n, b⟩ := Submodule.basisOfPid (Pi.basisFun ℤ (Fin r)) V
  have hcol : ∀ j, B.col j ∈ V := fun j => ⟨Pi.single j 1, by
    funext i; simp [Matrix.mulVec_single]⟩
  let B₁ : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin n) ℤ := Matrix.of fun i k => (b k : Fin r → ℤ) i
  let B₂ : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin s) ℤ := Matrix.of fun k j => b.repr ⟨B.col j, hcol j⟩ k
  have hli : LinearIndependent ℤ B₁.col := by
    have := b.linearIndependent.map' V.subtype V.ker_subtype
    convert this using 1
    funext k
    rfl
  have hB₁ : Function.Injective B₁.mulVec := Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff.2 hli
  have hfac : B = B₁ * B₂ := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrArg (fun x : V => (x : Fin r → ℤ) i) (b.sum_repr ⟨B.col j, hcol j⟩)
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul] at h
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, B₁, B₂, Matrix.of_apply]
    have e : B i j = B.col j i := rfl
    rw [e, ← h]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  have hn : n ≤ r := by
    simpa using hli.fintype_card_le_finrank
  rcases hn.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
  · exact Or.inr ⟨n, hlt, B₁, B₂, hB₁, hfac⟩
  · left
    intro v w hvw
    have hv : B.transpose.mulVec (v - w) = 0 := by rw [Matrix.mulVec_sub, hvw, sub_self]
    have h1 : B₁.transpose.mulVec (v - w) = 0 := by
      funext k
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (b k).2
      have hk : (B₁.transpose.mulVec (v - w)) k = (v - w) ⬝ᵥ (b k : Fin _ → ℤ) := by
        simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, B₁, mul_comm]
      rw [hk, ← hx, Pi.zero_apply, Matrix.mulVecLin_apply, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec,
        ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, hv, zero_dotProduct]
    have hdet : B₁.det ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hu0⟩ := Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.2 h0
      exact hu (hB₁ (hu0.trans (Matrix.mulVec_zero _).symm))
    by_contra hne
    apply hdet
    rw [← Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff.1 ⟨v - w, sub_ne_zero.2 hne, h1⟩

name: IngramMello.finiteDimensional_sup_adjoin_roots
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_sup_adjoin_roots (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ K] {r : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂ) (hη : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j)) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (K ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range η) : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range η)) := by
    apply IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := hη j
    exact IsIntegral.of_pow hn (h ▸ isIntegral_one)
  infer_instance

name: IngramMello.isExceptional_descent
statement:
theorem isExceptional_descent {d : ℕ} {K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ} [FiniteDimensional ℚ K]
    {r s : ℕ} {a : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra K (Fin r → ℤ)} {T : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ)}
    (hEx : IsExceptional d K r a T) (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (hη : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j : ℂ))
    (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ) (hB : Function.Injective B.mulVec)
    (T₀ : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ)) (hT₀ : T₀ ⊆ T) (hT₀inf : T₀.Infinite)
    (hT₀B : ∀ t ∈ T₀, ∃ w, MvLaurent.monomialMap η B w = t) :
    ∃ (L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (_ : FiniteDimensional ℚ L)
      (a' : Fin (d - 1) → AddMonoidAlgebra L (Fin s → ℤ)) (T' : Set (Fin s → ℂˣ)),
      IsExceptional d L s a' T'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨-, hTtor, hTpcf, hTinj⟩ := hEx
  let L : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ := K ⊔ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ (Set.range fun j => (η j : ℂ))
  have hKL : K ≤ L := le_sup_left
  have hηL : ∀ j, (η j : ℂ) ∈ L := fun j =>
    (le_sup_right : _ ≤ L) (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin ℚ _ ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  let ηL : Fin r → Lˣ := fun j =>
    Units.mk0 ⟨η j, hηL j⟩ (fun h => (η j).ne_zero (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have hηη : (fun j => Units.map L.val.toMonoidHom (ηL j)) = η := by
    funext j; ext; rfl
  let g : (Fin r → ℂˣ) → (Fin s → ℂˣ) := fun t =>
    if h : ∃ w, MvLaurent.monomialMap η B w = t then h.choose else 1
  have hg : ∀ t ∈ T₀, MvLaurent.monomialMap η B (g t) = t := fun t ht => by
    simp only [g, dite_eq_left (hT₀B t ht)]
    exact (hT₀B t ht).choose_spec
  have hev : ∀ t ∈ T₀, ∀ F, MvLaurent.evalOver L (g t) (MvLaurent.pullbackOver hKL ηL B F) =
      MvLaurent.evalOver K t F := fun t ht F => by
    rw [MvLaurent.evalOver_pullbackOver, hηη, hg t ht]
  refine ⟨L, finiteDimensional_sup_adjoin_roots K _ hη,
    fun i => MvLaurent.pullbackOver hKL ηL B (a i), g '' T₀, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine hT₀inf.image fun t ht t' ht' h => ?_
    rw [← hg t ht, ← hg t' ht', h]
  · rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ k
    rw [MvLaurent.isRootOfUnityC_iff_isOfFinOrder]
    refine MvLaurent.isOfFinOrder_of_monomialMap η B hB
      (fun j => (MvLaurent.isRootOfUnityC_iff_isOfFinOrder _).1 (hη j)) _ (fun j => ?_) k
    rw [hg t ht, ← MvLaurent.isRootOfUnityC_iff_isOfFinOrder]
    exact hTtor t (hT₀ ht) j
  · rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    simp only [hev t ht]
    exact hTpcf t (hT₀ ht)
  · rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩ h
    simp only [hev t ht, hev t' ht'] at h
    rw [hTinj (hT₀ ht) (hT₀ ht') h]

name: IngramMello.exists_valuation_of_prime
statement:
theorem exists_valuation_of_prime (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDedekindDomain A]
    (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (E : Type*) [Field E] [Algebra K E] [Algebra A E] [IsScalarTower A K E]
    [FiniteDimensional K E] [Algebra.IsSeparable K E]
    (𝔭 : Ideal A) [𝔭.IsPrime] (h𝔭 : 𝔭 ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ w : Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      (∀ x : A, w (algebraMap A E x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x : A, w (algebraMap A E x) < 1 ↔ x ∈ 𝔭
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsDedekindDomain (integralClosure A E) := integralClosure.isDedekindDomain A K E
  haveI : IsFractionRing (integralClosure A E) E :=
    integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension K E
  have hinjE : Function.Injective (algebraMap A E) := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K E]
    exact (algebraMap K E).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective A K)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A (integralClosure A E)) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply hinjE
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (integralClosure A E) E,
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (integralClosure A E) E y, hxy]
  obtain ⟨Q, -, hQp, hQ⟩ := Ideal.exists_ideal_over_prime_of_isIntegral 𝔭
    (⊥ : Ideal (integralClosure A E)) (Ideal.comap_bot_le_of_injective _ hinj)
  have hQne : Q ≠ ⊥ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact h𝔭 (by rw [← hQ, Ideal.under, Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective _ hinj])
  let v : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (integralClosure A E) := ⟨Q, hQp, hQne⟩
  refine ⟨v.valuation E, fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (integralClosure A E) E]
    exact v.valuation_le_one _
  · rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A (integralClosure A E) E, v.valuation_lt_one_iff_mem]
    change _ ∈ Q ↔ _
    rw [← hQ]
    rfl

name: IngramMello.valPow_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem valPow_apply (w : Valuation F Γ₀) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (x : F) :
    valPow w hn x = w x ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: IngramMello.exists_pow_mul_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_pow_mul_pow_eq_one {α β : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)} (hα0 : α ≠ 0)
    (hα : α < 1) (hβ : 1 < β) :
    ∃ e e' : ℕ, e ≠ 0 ∧ e' ≠ 0 ∧ α ^ e' * β ^ e = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans hβ).ne'
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a, α = WithZero.exp a := ⟨_, (WithZero.exp_log hα0).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, β = WithZero.exp b := ⟨_, (WithZero.exp_log hβ0).symm⟩
  rw [WithZero.exp_lt_one_iff] at hα
  rw [WithZero.one_lt_exp_iff] at hβ
  refine ⟨(-a).toNat, b.toNat, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Ne, Int.toNat_eq_zero]; omega
  · rw [Ne, Int.toNat_eq_zero]; omega
  · rw [← WithZero.exp_nsmul, ← WithZero.exp_nsmul, ← WithZero.exp_add, ← WithZero.exp_zero]
    congr 1
    simp only [nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega)]
    ring

name: IngramMello.isFractionRing_of_isLocalization_of_isFractionRing
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_of_isLocalization_of_isFractionRing {R S T : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S]
    (hM : M ≤ nonZeroDivisors R) [IsFractionRing S T] : IsFractionRing R T
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S) := IsLocalization.injective S hM
  have h := IsLocalization.localization_localization_isLocalization M (nonZeroDivisors S) T
  have heq : IsLocalization.localizationLocalizationSubmodule M (nonZeroDivisors S)
      = nonZeroDivisors R := by
    ext x
    rw [IsLocalization.mem_localizationLocalizationSubmodule, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, z, e⟩ hx
      rw [hx, map_zero] at e
      exact mul_ne_zero (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero y.2) (IsLocalization.map_units S z).ne_zero
        e.symm
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨⟨algebraMap R S x, mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ?_⟩, 1, by simp⟩
      intro h
      exact hx (hinj (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

name: IngramMello.exists_place_of_ringHom
statement:
theorem exists_place_of_ringHom (ψ : ℂ[X] →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
    (hψ : @IsLocalization ℂ[X] _ (Submonoid.powers X) (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) _ ψ.toAlgebra) :
    ∃ w : Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
      (∀ p : ℂ[X], w (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (ψ p)) ≤ 1) ∧
      ∀ p : ℂ[X], w (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (ψ p)) < 1 ↔ p.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ℂ[X] (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) := ψ.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ℂ[X] E := ((algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E).comp ψ).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower ℂ[X] Kt E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x => by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply ℂ[X] (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt x,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt E]
    rfl
  haveI : IsFractionRing ℂ[X] Kt :=
    isFractionRing_of_isLocalization_of_isFractionRing (S := LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
      (Submonoid.powers X) (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors X_ne_zero)
  haveI : CharZero Kt := charZero_of_injective_ringHom
    ((algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) Kt).comp LaurentPolynomial.C).injective
  haveI : (Ideal.span {(X : ℂ[X])}).IsPrime :=
    (Ideal.span_singleton_prime X_ne_zero).mpr prime_X
  obtain ⟨w, h1, h2⟩ := exists_valuation_of_prime ℂ[X] Kt E (Ideal.span {X})
    (by rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]; exact X_ne_zero)
  refine ⟨w, fun p => h1 p, fun p => ?_⟩
  exact (h2 p).trans (by rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, X_dvd_iff])

name: IngramMello.exists_twoPlaces
statement:
theorem exists_twoPlaces : ∃ w₀ w₁ : Valuation E (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)),
    TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁
proof:
:= by
  
  set ψ₀ : ℂ[X] →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ :=
    (RingEquiv.refl (LaurentPolynomial ℂ)).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap ℂ[X] (LaurentPolynomial ℂ))
    with hψ₀
  have hψ₀' : ∀ p, ψ₀ p = toLaurent p := fun p => rfl
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀le, hu₀lt⟩ := exists_place_of_ringHom E ψ₀
    ((IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv (Submonoid.powers X)
      (RingEquiv.refl (LaurentPolynomial ℂ))).mp LaurentPolynomial.isLocalization)
  
  set ψ₁ : ℂ[X] →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ :=
    (invert (R := ℂ)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap ℂ[X] (LaurentPolynomial ℂ))
    with hψ₁
  have hψ₁' : ∀ p, ψ₁ p = invert (toLaurent p) := fun p => rfl
  obtain ⟨u₁, hu₁le, hu₁lt⟩ := exists_place_of_ringHom E ψ₁
    ((IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv (Submonoid.powers X)
      (invert (R := ℂ)).toRingEquiv).mp LaurentPolynomial.isLocalization)
  simp only [hψ₀'] at hu₀le hu₀lt
  simp only [hψ₁'] at hu₁le hu₁lt
  
  have hT0 : u₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) < 1 := by
    have := (hu₀lt X).mpr (by simp)
    rwa [Polynomial.toLaurent_X] at this
  have hTinv : u₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T (-1))) < 1 := by
    have := (hu₁lt X).mpr (by simp)
    rwa [Polynomial.toLaurent_X, invert_T] at this
  have hTT : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1) * algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T (-1))
      = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, map_one]
  have hT1ne : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hTT
  have hTinv_eq : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T (-1))
      = (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1))⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hTT
  have hT₁ : 1 < u₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) := by
    rw [hTinv_eq, map_inv₀, inv_lt_one₀] at hTinv
    · exact hTinv
    · exact zero_lt_iff.mpr ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).mpr hT1ne)
  have hu₀T0 : u₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) ≠ 0 :=
    (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).mpr hT1ne
  obtain ⟨e, e', he, he', hee'⟩ := exists_pow_mul_pow_eq_one hu₀T0 hT0 hT₁
  refine ⟨valPow u₀ he', valPow u₁ he, ⟨fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_, fun p => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [valPow_apply, pow_le_one_iff he']; exact hu₀le p
  · rw [valPow_apply, pow_lt_one_iff he']; exact hu₀lt p
  · rw [valPow_apply, pow_le_one_iff he]; exact hu₁le p
  · rw [valPow_apply, pow_lt_one_iff he]; exact hu₁lt p
  · rw [valPow_apply, pow_lt_one_iff he']; exact hT0
  · rw [valPow_apply, valPow_apply]; exact hee'

name: IngramMello.algebraMap_T_zpow
statement:
theorem algebraMap_T_zpow (n : ℤ) :
    algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T n) = algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hTT : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1) * algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T (-1))
      = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, map_one]
  have hT1ne : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hTT
  have hTinv_eq : algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T (-1))
      = (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1))⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hTT
  induction n using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [T_zero]
  | succ i ih => rw [T_add, map_mul, ih, zpow_add_one₀ hT1ne]
  | pred i ih => rw [T_sub, map_mul, ih, zpow_sub_one₀ hT1ne, hTinv_eq]

name: IngramMello.exists_T_zpow_mul_toLaurent
statement:
theorem exists_T_zpow_mul_toLaurent (x : LaurentPolynomial ℂ) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℤ) (p : ℂ[X]), p.coeff 0 ≠ 0 ∧ x = T n * toLaurent p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, f, hf⟩ := exists_T_pow x
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero] at hf
    exact hx ((mul_eq_zero.mp hf.symm).resolve_right (isUnit_T m).ne_zero)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hXq⟩ := exists_eq_pow_rootMultiplicity_mul_and_not_dvd f hf0 0
  rw [C_0, sub_zero] at hq hXq
  set a := rootMultiplicity 0 f with ha
  refine ⟨(a : ℤ) - m, q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [X_dvd_iff] at hXq
  · have hx' : x = toLaurent f * T (-m) := by
      rw [hf, mul_assoc, ← T_add, add_neg_cancel, T_zero, mul_one]
    rw [hx', hq, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.toLaurent_X, T_pow, mul_one, T_sub]
    ring

name: IngramMello.toLaurent_eq_invert_reverse_mul
statement:
theorem toLaurent_eq_invert_reverse_mul (p : ℂ[X]) :
    toLaurent p = invert (toLaurent p.reverse) * T (p.natDegree : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg invert (toLaurent_reverse p)
  rw [map_mul, invert_T, involutive_invert (toLaurent p)] at h
  rw [h, mul_assoc, ← T_add, neg_add_cancel, T_zero, mul_one]

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.T_pos
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.T_pos (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) :
    0 < w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1))
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_iff.mpr (left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h.T_mul)

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.T_eq_inv
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.T_eq_inv (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) :
    w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) =
      (w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h.T_mul

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.exists_val_eq
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.exists_val_eq (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) {x : LaurentPolynomial ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (n : ℤ) (p : ℂ[X]), p.coeff 0 ≠ 0 ∧ x = T n * toLaurent p ∧
      w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) =
        w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) ^ n ∧
      w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) =
        w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) ^ (n + p.natDegree)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp0, hx⟩ := exists_T_zpow_mul_toLaurent x hx
  refine ⟨n, p, hp0, hx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (toLaurent p)) = 1 :=
      (h.le₀ p).lt_or_eq.resolve_left (by rw [h.lt₀]; exact hp0)
    rw [hx, map_mul, map_mul, h1, mul_one, algebraMap_T_zpow, map_zpow₀]
  · have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hp0 (coeff_zero 0)
    have h1 : w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (invert (toLaurent p.reverse))) = 1 :=
      (h.le₁ p.reverse).lt_or_eq.resolve_left
        (by rw [h.lt₁, coeff_zero_reverse]; exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hpne)
    have hne : w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (T 1)) ≠ 0 :=
      right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h.T_mul
    rw [hx, toLaurent_eq_invert_reverse_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, h1, one_mul,
      algebraMap_T_zpow, algebraMap_T_zpow (p.natDegree : ℤ), map_zpow₀, map_zpow₀,
      ← zpow_add₀ hne]

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.val_natCast
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.val_natCast (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    w₀ (N : E) = 1 ∧ w₁ (N : E) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (N : E) = algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (toLaurent (N : ℂ[X])) := by
    rw [map_natCast, map_natCast]
  have h2 : (N : E) = algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E (invert (toLaurent (N : ℂ[X]))) := by
    rw [map_natCast, map_natCast, map_natCast]
  have hc : ((N : ℂ[X]).coeff 0) ≠ 0 := by rw [natCast_coeff_zero]; exact_mod_cast hN
  constructor
  · rw [h1]; exact (h.le₀ _).lt_or_eq.resolve_left (by rw [h.lt₀]; exact hc)
  · rw [h2]; exact (h.le₁ _).lt_or_eq.resolve_left (by rw [h.lt₁]; exact hc)

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.mem_range_C_of_le_one
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.mem_range_C_of_le_one (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁) {x : LaurentPolynomial ℂ}
    (h0 : w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) ≤ 1)
    (h₁ : w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) ≤ 1) :
    x ∈ Set.range (LaurentPolynomial.C : ℂ →+* LaurentPolynomial ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [hx, map_zero]⟩
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp0, hxe, hv0, hv₁⟩ := h.exists_val_eq hx
  rw [hv0, zpow_le_one_iff_right_of_lt_one₀ h.T_pos h.T_lt] at h0
  rw [hv₁, h.T_eq_inv, inv_zpow', zpow_le_one_iff_right_of_lt_one₀ h.T_pos h.T_lt] at h₁
  have hn : n = 0 := by omega
  have hdeg : p.natDegree = 0 := by omega
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [hxe, hn, T_zero, one_mul, eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg, Polynomial.toLaurent_C,
    coeff_C_zero]

name: IngramMello.TwoPlaces.val_mul_val_eq_one_of_forall_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem TwoPlaces.val_mul_val_eq_one_of_forall_eval_ne_zero (h : TwoPlaces E w₀ w₁)
    {x : LaurentPolynomial ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hroot : ∀ t₀ : ℂˣ, LaurentPolynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) t₀ x ≠ 0) :
    w₀ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) * w₁ (algebraMap (LaurentPolynomial ℂ) E x) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp0, hxe, hv0, hv₁⟩ := h.exists_val_eq hx
  have hdeg : p.natDegree = 0 := by
    by_contra hdeg
    have hdeg' : p.degree ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hdeg (natDegree_eq_of_degree_eq_some h0)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root p hdeg'
    have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hp0 (by rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]; exact hz)
    apply hroot (Units.mk0 z hz0)
    rw [hxe, map_mul, eval₂_T, eval₂_toLaurent]
    simp only [Units.val_mk0]
    rw [show Polynomial.eval₂ (RingHom.id ℂ) z p = p.eval z from rfl, hz.eq_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [hv0, hv₁, hdeg, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, ← mul_zpow, h.T_mul, one_zpow]

name: IngramMello.cosetPt_one_one
statement:
theorem cosetPt_one_one (w : Fin r → ℂ) :
    cosetPt (fun _ : Fin r => (1 : ℂ)) (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℤ) w = w
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [cosetPt, Matrix.one_apply, one_mul]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval_zero
statement: theorem MvLaurent.eval_zero (u : Fin r → ℂ) : MvLaurent.eval (0 : MvLaurent r) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [MvLaurent.eval]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.monomialMap_monomialMap
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.monomialMap_monomialMap (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℤ)
    (η' : Fin t → ℂˣ) (B' : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin s) ℤ) (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) :
    monomialMap η B (monomialMap η' B' w) = monomialMap (monomialMap η B η') (B * B') w
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (MvLaurent.monomialMap_one_comp B' B w)
  funext j
  have hj := h j
  simp only [monomialMap, Pi.one_apply, one_mul] at hj ⊢
  rw [← hj, mul_assoc, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [mul_zpow]

name: IngramMello.cosetPt_cosetPt
statement:
theorem cosetPt_cosetPt {η : Fin r → ℂ} (hη : ∀ j, η j ≠ 0) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin t) ℤ)
    {η' : Fin t → ℂ} (hη' : ∀ k, η' k ≠ 0) (B' : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin s) ℤ)
    {u : Fin s → ℂ} (hu : ∀ l, u l ≠ 0) :
    cosetPt (cosetPt η B η') (B * B') u = cosetPt η B (cosetPt η' B' u)
proof:
:= by
  set ηu : Fin r → ℂˣ := fun j => Units.mk0 (η j) (hη j) with hηu
  set η'u : Fin t → ℂˣ := fun k => Units.mk0 (η' k) (hη' k) with hη'u
  set uu : Fin s → ℂˣ := fun l => Units.mk0 (u l) (hu l) with huu
  have h1 : (fun j => (ηu j : ℂ)) = η := by funext j; simp [hηu]
  have h2 : (fun k => (η'u k : ℂ)) = η' := by funext k; simp [hη'u]
  have h3 : (fun l => (uu l : ℂ)) = u := by funext l; simp [huu]
  rw [← h1, ← h2, ← h3, ← MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap, ← MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap,
    ← MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap, ← MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap,
    MvLaurent.monomialMap_monomialMap]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval_pullback_coe
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.eval_pullback_coe (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (z : Fin s → ℂˣ) (P : MvLaurent r) :
    MvLaurent.eval (pullback η B P) (fun k => (z k : ℂ)) =
      MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt (fun j => (η j : ℂ)) B (fun k => (z k : ℂ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evalHom_apply, evalHom_pullback, evalHom_apply, coe_monomialMap]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eval_mapRingHom_rat
statement:
theorem MvLaurent.eval_mapRingHom_rat (Q : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ)) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) :
    MvLaurent.eval (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom _ (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) Q) (fun j => (x j : ℂ)) =
      ∑ e ∈ Q.coeff.support, (Q.coeff e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MvLaurent.eval, AddMonoidAlgebra.coe_mapRingHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_map,
    coe_charPow]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (by simp)]
  rfl

name: IngramMello.laurent_dim
statement:
theorem laurent_dim (r : ℕ) : ∀ T : Set (Fin r → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (t j)) →
    T.Infinite →
    ∃ (s : ℕ) (η : Fin r → ℂ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ),
      0 < s ∧ (∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j)) ∧ Function.Injective B.mulVec ∧
      ∀ P : MvLaurent r,
        (∀ w : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) → cosetPt η B w ∈ T →
          MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt η B w) = 0) →
        ∀ w : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) → MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt η B w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro T _ hinf
    exact absurd (Set.toFinite T) hinf
  | succ r' ih =>
    intro T hT hinf
    have hne : ∀ t ∈ T, ∀ j, t j ≠ 0 := fun t ht j => (hT t ht j).ne_zero
    by_cases hdense : ∀ P : MvLaurent (r' + 1), (∀ t ∈ T, MvLaurent.eval P t = 0) → P = 0
    · 
      refine ⟨r' + 1, fun _ => 1, 1, Nat.succ_pos _, fun _ => ⟨1, one_pos, one_pow 1⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u u' h
        simpa [Matrix.one_mulVec] using h
      · intro P hP w _
        have hP' : ∀ t ∈ T, MvLaurent.eval P t = 0 := fun t ht => by
          have := hP t (hne t ht) (by rw [cosetPt_one_one]; exact ht)
          rwa [cosetPt_one_one] at this
        rw [hdense P hP', MvLaurent.eval_zero]
    · push Not at hdense
      obtain ⟨P, hPz, hP0⟩ := hdense
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ0, hQz⟩ := MvLaurent.exists_rational_equation_of_torsion hT hP0 hPz
      
      set Tu : Set (Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ) := {x | (fun j => (x j : ℂ)) ∈ T} with hTu
      have hTu_inf : Tu.Infinite := by
        intro hfin
        apply hinf
        refine Set.Finite.subset (hfin.image fun x : Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ => fun j => (x j : ℂ)) ?_
        intro t ht
        refine ⟨fun j => Units.mk0 (t j) (hne t ht j), ?_, ?_⟩
        · change (fun j => ((Units.mk0 (t j) (hne t ht j) : ℂˣ) : ℂ)) ∈ T
          simpa using ht
        · funext j; simp
      have hTu_tor : ∀ x ∈ Tu, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j : ℂ) := fun x hx j => hT _ hx j
      have hTu_van : ∀ x ∈ Tu,
          ∑ e ∈ Q.coeff.support, (Q.coeff e : ℂ) * (charPow x e : ℂ) = 0 := fun x hx => by
        rw [← MvLaurent.eval_mapRingHom_rat]; exact hQz _ hx
      have hQsupp : Q.coeff.support.Nonempty :=
        Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.2 fun h => hQ0 (AddMonoidAlgebra.ext h)
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hTv⟩ := exists_character_of_infinite Q.coeff.support (fun e => Q.coeff e)
        (fun e he => Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 he) hQsupp Tu hTu_inf hTu_tor hTu_van
      obtain ⟨F, B, hF, hB, hcover⟩ := exists_fiber_cover v hv
      
      set good : (Fin (r' + 1) → ℂ) → Set (Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ) := fun η =>
        {x ∈ Tu | charPow x v = 1 ∧ ∃ w : Fin r' → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k)) ∧ cosetPt η B w = fun j => (x j : ℂ)} with hgood
      obtain ⟨η, hηF, hηinf⟩ : ∃ η ∈ F, (good η).Infinite := by
        by_contra hcon
        push Not at hcon
        apply hTv
        refine Set.Finite.subset
          (Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet F) fun η hη => hcon η hη) ?_
        intro x hx
        obtain ⟨η, hη, w, hw0, hwt, hcos⟩ := hcover x (hTu_tor x hx.1) hx.2
        rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂]
        exact ⟨η, hη, hx.1, hx.2, w, hw0, hwt, hcos⟩
      have hη : ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (η j) := hF η hηF
      have hη0 : ∀ j, η j ≠ 0 := fun j => (hη j).ne_zero
      
      have hlift : ∀ x ∈ good η, ∃ w : Fin r' → ℂ, (∀ k, w k ≠ 0) ∧
          (∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (w k)) ∧ cosetPt η B w = fun j => (x j : ℂ) :=
        fun x hx => hx.2.2
      choose! w hw using hlift
      set T' : Set (Fin r' → ℂ) := w '' good η with hT'
      have hinjw : Set.InjOn w (good η) := by
        intro x hx y hy hxy
        have hx' := (hw x hx).2.2
        have hy' := (hw y hy).2.2
        rw [hxy, hy'] at hx'
        funext j
        exact Units.ext (congrFun hx' j).symm
      have hT'inf : T'.Infinite := (Set.infinite_image_iff hinjw).2 hηinf
      have hT'tor : ∀ t ∈ T', ∀ k, IsRootOfUnityC (t k) := by
        rintro t ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ k
        exact (hw x hx).2.1 k
      obtain ⟨s, η', B', hs, hη', hB', hdens'⟩ := ih T' hT'tor hT'inf
      have hη'0 : ∀ k, η' k ≠ 0 := fun k => (hη' k).ne_zero
      refine ⟨s, cosetPt η B η', B * B', hs, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro j
        exact (hη j).mul (IsRootOfUnityC.finset_prod _ _ fun k _ => (hη' k).zpow _)
      · intro u u' h
        apply hB'
        apply hB
        rwa [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      · intro P hP u hu
        set ηu : Fin (r' + 1) → ℂˣ := fun j => Units.mk0 (η j) (hη0 j) with hηu
        have hηuc : (fun j => (ηu j : ℂ)) = η := by funext j; simp [hηu]
        set Pb := pullback ηu B P with hPb
        have hPb_eval : ∀ z : Fin r' → ℂ, (∀ k, z k ≠ 0) →
            MvLaurent.eval Pb z = MvLaurent.eval P (cosetPt η B z) := by
          intro z hz
          set zu : Fin r' → ℂˣ := fun k => Units.mk0 (z k) (hz k) with hzu
          have hzuc : (fun k => (zu k : ℂ)) = z := by funext k; simp [hzu]
          rw [← hzuc, ← hηuc, hPb, MvLaurent.eval_pullback_coe]
        have hcomp : ∀ z : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, z k ≠ 0) →
            cosetPt (cosetPt η B η') (B * B') z = cosetPt η B (cosetPt η' B' z) :=
          fun z hz => cosetPt_cosetPt hη0 B hη'0 B' hz
        have h1 : ∀ z : Fin s → ℂ, (∀ k, z k ≠ 0) → cosetPt η' B' z ∈ T' →
            MvLaurent.eval Pb (cosetPt η' B' z) = 0 := by
          intro z hz hmem
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := hmem
          have hmemT : cosetPt (cosetPt η B η') (B * B') z ∈ T := by
            rw [hcomp z hz, ← hxz, (hw x hx).2.2]
            exact hx.1
          have := hP z hz hmemT
          rw [hcomp z hz] at this
          rw [hPb_eval _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη'0 B' hz)]
          exact this
        have := hdens' Pb h1 u hu
        rwa [hPb_eval _ (cosetPt_ne_zero hη'0 B' hu), ← hcomp u hu] at this

name: IngramMello.laurent_of_mann
statement: theorem laurent_of_mann : Laurent
proof: := laurent_dim

name: IngramMello.sum_fin_pad
statement:
theorem sum_fin_pad {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] {n N : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (g : Fin n → M) :
    ∑ i, g i = ∑ k : Fin N, if h : (k : ℕ) < n then g ⟨k, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => if h : k < n then g ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) N]
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ hn]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero (s := Finset.Ico n N) (fun k hk => by
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    simp [not_lt.2 hk.1]), add_zero]
  rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => if h : k < n then g ⟨k, h⟩ else 0) n]
  simp

name: IngramMello.exists_linearForm
statement:
theorem exists_linearForm (hDZ : DvornicichZannier) (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ)
    (hK : FiniteDimensional ℚ K) (B : ℝ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℂ), (∀ i, e i ∈ K) ∧
      ∀ α ∈ Kcyc K, IsIntegral ℤ α → HouseLE α B →
        ∃ y : Fin m → ℂ, (∀ i, y i = 0 ∨ IsRootOfUnityC (y i)) ∧ α = ∑ i, e i * y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, hE, N, hN⟩ := hDZ K hK B
  let ι := {x : ℂ // x ∈ E} × Fin N
  let σ := Fintype.equivFin ι
  refine ⟨Fintype.card ι, fun i => ((σ.symm i).1 : ℂ), fun i => hE _ (σ.symm i).1.2, ?_⟩
  intro α hα hint hB
  obtain ⟨n, c, ξ, hnN, hc, hξ, rfl⟩ := hN α hα hint hB
  let y : ι → ℂ := fun p =>
    if h : (p.2 : ℕ) < n then (if c ⟨p.2, h⟩ = p.1 then ξ ⟨p.2, h⟩ else 0) else 0
  refine ⟨fun i => y (σ.symm i), fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [y]
    split_ifs
    · exact Or.inr (hξ _)
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
  · rw [Equiv.sum_comp σ.symm (fun p : ι => ((p.1 : ℂ)) * y p)]
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    rw [sum_fin_pad hnN]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < n
    · simp only [y, h, dite_true]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨c ⟨k, h⟩, hc _⟩ : {x : ℂ // x ∈ E})]
      · simp
      · intro b _ hb
        have : c ⟨k, h⟩ ≠ b := fun h' => hb (Subtype.ext h'.symm)
        simp [this]
      · simp
    · simp [y, h]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coeff_mapCoeffLinear
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mapCoeffLinear (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (L : ℂ →ₗ[K] K)
    (P : MvLaurent r) (e : Fin r → ℤ) :
    (mapCoeffLinear K L P).coeff e = (L (P.coeff e) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapCoeffLinear, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_map]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_mapCoeffLinear
statement:
theorem evalHom_mapCoeffLinear (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) (L : ℂ →ₗ[K] K)
    (P : MvLaurent r) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (hx : ∀ j, (x j : ℂ) ∈ K) :
    evalHom x (mapCoeffLinear K L P) = (L (evalHom x P) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp [mapCoeffLinear]
  | add P Q hP hQ => simp [mapCoeffLinear, AddMonoidAlgebra.map_add, hP, hQ] at *
  | single e c =>
    have hm : (∏ j, (x j : ℂ) ^ e j) ∈ K :=
      K.toSubfield.prod_mem fun j _ => K.toSubfield.zpow_mem (hx j) _
    let m : K := ⟨∏ j, (x j : ℂ) ^ e j, hm⟩
    have hL := L.map_smul m c
    have hLc : (L (c * (m : ℂ)) : ℂ) = (L c : ℂ) * (m : ℂ) := by
      simpa [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm] using congrArg (fun z : K => (z : ℂ)) hL
    simpa [mapCoeffLinear, evalHom_single, m] using hLc.symm

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_equation_over
statement:
theorem exists_equation_over (K : IntermediateField ℚ ℂ) {P : MvLaurent r}
    (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ F : MvLaurent r, F ≠ 0 ∧ (∀ e, F.coeff e ∈ K) ∧
      ∀ x : Fin r → ℂˣ, (∀ j, (x j : ℂ) ∈ K) →
        evalHom x P = 0 → evalHom x F = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, P.coeff e ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hP (AddMonoidAlgebra.ext (Finsupp.ext h))
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_ne_zero K he
  refine ⟨mapCoeffLinear K L P, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have := congrArg (fun F : MvLaurent r => F.coeff e) h
    exact hL (by simpa using this)
  · intro e
    exact (L (P.coeff e)).property
  · intro x hx h
    rw [evalHom_mapCoeffLinear K L P x hx, h, map_zero]
    rfl

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.isIntegral_of_coeff
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_coeff (P : MvLaurent r)
    (hP : ∀ e, IsIntegral ℚ (P.coeff e)) :
    IsIntegral (AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ)) P
proof:
:= by
  let R := AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ)
  rw [← P.sum_coeff_single]
  apply IsIntegral.sum
  intro e he
  have hc : IsIntegral R (single (0 : Fin r → ℤ) (P.coeff e) : MvLaurent r) :=
    ((hP e).algebraMap (B := MvLaurent r)).tower_top
  have hm : IsIntegral R (single e (1 : ℂ) : MvLaurent r) := by
    simpa [R] using
      (isIntegral_algebraMap (R := R) (A := MvLaurent r) (x := single e (1 : ℚ)))
  simpa using hc.mul hm

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_rational_multiple
statement:
theorem exists_rational_multiple {F : MvLaurent r} (hF : F ≠ 0)
    (hcoeff : ∀ e, IsIntegral ℚ (F.coeff e)) :
    ∃ Q : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ), Q ≠ 0 ∧
      F ∣ AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom _ (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) Q
proof:
:= by
  exact (isIntegral_of_coeff F hcoeff).isAlgebraic.exists_nonzero_dvd
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hF)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_rational_equation
statement:
theorem exists_rational_equation {P : MvLaurent r} (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ Q : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ), Q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x : Fin r → ℂˣ, (∀ j, IsAlgebraic ℚ (x j : ℂ)) →
        evalHom x P = 0 →
          evalHom x (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom _ (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hc, hz⟩ := exists_equation_over (algebraicClosure ℚ ℂ) hP
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, G, hG⟩ := exists_rational_multiple hF hc
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun x hx h => ?_⟩
  rw [hG, map_mul, hz x (fun j => (hx j).isIntegral) h, zero_mul]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.rational_dense_iff
statement:
theorem rational_dense_iff {T : Set (Fin r → ℂˣ)}
    (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ j, IsAlgebraic ℚ (x j : ℂ)) :
    (∀ Q : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ),
      (∀ x ∈ T, evalHom x (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom _ (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) Q) = 0) →
        Q = 0) ↔
    (∀ P : MvLaurent r, (∀ x ∈ T, evalHom x P = 0) → P = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h P hP
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hz⟩ := exists_rational_equation hn
    exact hQ (h Q fun x hx => hz x (hT x hx) (hP x hx))
  · intro h Q hQ
    have hz := h _ hQ
    ext e
    have he := congrArg (fun P : MvLaurent r => P.coeff e) hz
    simpa using he

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_rational_equation_of_torsion
statement:
theorem exists_rational_equation_of_torsion {T : Set (Fin r → ℂ)}
    (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, ∀ j, IsRootOfUnityC (x j))
    {P : MvLaurent r} (hP : P ≠ 0) (hz : ∀ x ∈ T, eval P x = 0) :
    ∃ Q : AddMonoidAlgebra ℚ (Fin r → ℤ), Q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ x ∈ T, eval (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom _ (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) Q) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, h⟩ := exists_rational_equation hP
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hne (j) : x j ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, heq⟩ := hT x hx j
    intro hj
    simp [hj, zero_pow hn.ne'] at heq
  let u : Fin r → ℂˣ := fun j => Units.mk0 (x j) (hne j)
  have ha (j) : IsAlgebraic ℚ (u j : ℂ) := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn, heq⟩ := hT x hx j
    exact (IsIntegral.of_pow hn (heq ▸ isIntegral_one (R := ℚ))).isAlgebraic
  simpa [evalHom_apply, u] using h u ha (by simpa [evalHom_apply, u] using hz x hx)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_single
statement:
theorem evalHom_single (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (β : ℂ) :
    evalHom x (single a β) = β * ∏ j, ((x j : ℂ) ^ a j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalHom, character, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_apply
statement:
theorem evalHom_apply (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (F : MvLaurent r) :
    evalHom x F = MvLaurent.eval F (fun j => (x j : ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalHom, AddMonoidAlgebra.lift_apply', MvLaurent.eval, character,
    Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.mem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_maxIdeal {x : Fin r → ℂˣ} {F : MvLaurent r} :
    F ∈ maxIdeal x ↔ evalHom x F = 0
proof:
:=
  RingHom.mem_ker

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.single_notMem_maxIdeal
statement:
theorem single_notMem_maxIdeal (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) {β : ℂ} (hβ : β ≠ 0) :
    single a β ∉ maxIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_maxIdeal, evalHom_single]
  exact mul_ne_zero hβ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ => zpow_ne_zero _ (x j).ne_zero)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coeff_eulerD
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_eulerD (w : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ ℂ) (F : MvLaurent r) (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    (eulerD w F).coeff a = w a * F.coeff a
proof:
:= by
  simp [eulerD]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eulerD_single
statement:
theorem eulerD_single (w : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ ℂ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) (β : ℂ) :
    eulerD w (single a β) = single a (w a * β)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [coeff_eulerD, coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
  · simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eulerD_mul
statement:
theorem eulerD_mul (w : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ ℂ) (F G : MvLaurent r) :
    eulerD w (F * G) = F * eulerD w G + G * eulerD w F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F₁ F₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [add_mul, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add]
    ring
  | single a α =>
    induction G using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add G₁ G₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [mul_add, map_add, h₁, h₂, map_add]
      ring
    | single b β =>
      simp only [eulerD_single, single_mul_single, map_add, add_comm b a, ← single_add]
      congr 1
      ring

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.eulerD_mem_pow
statement:
theorem eulerD_mem_pow (w : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ ℂ) (I : Ideal (MvLaurent r)) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : MvLaurent r), F ∈ I ^ (n + 1) → eulerD w F ∈ I ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    intro F hF
    rw [pow_succ] at hF
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hF (fun G hG H hH => ?_) (fun G H hG hH => ?_)
    · rw [eulerD_mul]
      refine add_mem (Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ hG) ?_
      rw [pow_succ']
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hH (ih G hG)
    · rw [map_add]
      exact add_mem hG hH

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coe_monomialMap
statement:
theorem coe_monomialMap {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) :
    (fun j => (monomialMap η B w j : ℂ)) = cosetPt (fun j => (η j : ℂ)) B (fun k => w k)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp [monomialMap, cosetPt, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.pullback_single
statement:
theorem pullback_single {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (a : Fin r → ℤ) (β : ℂ) :
    pullback η B (single a β) =
      single (B.transpose.mulVec a) (β * ∏ j, ((η j : ℂ) ^ a j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [pullback, character, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.zpow_finset_sum
statement:
theorem zpow_finset_sum {G ι : Type*} [CommGroup G] (g : G) (t : Finset ι) (n : ι → ℤ) :
    g ^ (∑ i ∈ t, n i) = ∏ i ∈ t, g ^ n i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i t hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.prod_insert hi, zpow_add, ih]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.prod_monomialMap_zpow
statement:
theorem prod_monomialMap_zpow {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) (a : Fin r → ℤ) :
    ∏ j, monomialMap η B w j ^ a j =
      (∏ j, η j ^ a j) * ∏ k, w k ^ (B.transpose.mulVec a) k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [monomialMap, mul_zpow, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, zpow_finset_sum, ← Finset.prod_zpow, ← zpow_mul]
  rw [Finset.prod_comm]

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.evalHom_pullback
statement:
theorem evalHom_pullback {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) (F : MvLaurent r) :
    evalHom w (pullback η B F) = evalHom (monomialMap η B w) F
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F G hF hG => simp [hF, hG]
  | single a β =>
    rw [pullback_single, evalHom_single, evalHom_single, mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have := congrArg (fun u : ℂˣ => (u : ℂ)) (prod_monomialMap_zpow η B w a)
    simpa [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val] using this.symm

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.maxIdeal_le_comap_pullback
statement:
theorem maxIdeal_le_comap_pullback {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) :
    maxIdeal (monomialMap η B w) ≤ (maxIdeal w).comap (pullback η B)
proof:
:= fun F hF => by
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_maxIdeal, evalHom_pullback]
  exact mem_maxIdeal.1 hF

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.pullback_mem_pow
statement:
theorem pullback_mem_pow {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (w : Fin s → ℂˣ) {n : ℕ} {F : MvLaurent r} (hF : F ∈ maxIdeal (monomialMap η B w) ^ n) :
    pullback η B F ∈ maxIdeal w ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : pullback η B F ∈ (maxIdeal (monomialMap η B w) ^ n).map (pullback η B) :=
    Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hF
  rw [Ideal.map_pow] at h1
  exact Ideal.pow_right_mono (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (maxIdeal_le_comap_pullback η B w)) n h1

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.coeff_pullback_mulVec
statement:
theorem coeff_pullback_mulVec {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.transpose.mulVec) (F : MvLaurent r) (b : Fin r → ℤ) :
    (pullback η B F).coeff (B.transpose.mulVec b) = F.coeff b * ∏ j, ((η j : ℂ) ^ b j)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using AddMonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add F G hF hG => simp [hF, hG, add_mul]
  | single a β =>
    rw [pullback_single, coeff_single, coeff_single, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    simp only [hB.eq_iff]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [h]
    · simp

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.pullback_injective
statement:
theorem pullback_injective {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.transpose.mulVec) : Function.Injective (pullback η B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro F hF
  ext b
  have h := coeff_pullback_mulVec η B hB F b
  rw [hF, coeff_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply, eq_comm] at h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h | h
  · simpa using h
  · exact absurd h (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ => zpow_ne_zero _ (η j).ne_zero)

name: IngramMello.MvLaurent.exists_monomialMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_monomialMap_eq {s : ℕ} (η : Fin r → ℂˣ) (B : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin s) ℤ)
    (hB : Function.Injective B.transpose.mulVec) (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) :
    ∃ w : Fin s → ℂˣ, monomialMap η B w = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let y : Fin r → ℂˣ := fun j => (η j)⁻¹ * x j
  let g : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ Additive ℂˣ :=
    { toFun := fun a => Additive.ofMul (∏ j, y j ^ a j)
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun a b => by
        simp [zpow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib] }
  let f : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ (Fin s → ℤ) := B.transpose.mulVecLin.toAddMonoidHom
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := (Module.Baer.of_divisible (Additive ℂˣ)).extension_property_addMonoidHom
    f hB g
  refine ⟨fun k => (h (Pi.single k 1)).toMul, funext fun j => ?_⟩
  have hv : ∀ v : Fin s → ℤ, (h v).toMul = ∏ k, (h (Pi.single k 1)).toMul ^ v k := by
    intro v
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finset.univ_sum_single v]
    simp only [map_sum, toMul_sum]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [← toMul_zsmul, ← map_zsmul]
    congr 2
    rw [← Pi.single_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hj := congrArg (fun φ : (Fin r → ℤ) →+ Additive ℂˣ => (φ (Pi.single j 1)).toMul) hh
  simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] at hj
  rw [hv] at hj
  have hf : ∀ k, f (Pi.single j 1) k = B j k := fun k => by
    simp [f]
  simp only [hf] at hj
  have hg : (g (Pi.single j 1)).toMul = y j := by
    change ∏ i, y i ^ (Pi.single j (1 : ℤ) : Fin r → ℤ) i = y j
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_single j (fun i _ hi => by rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hi, zpow_zero])
      (by simp), Pi.single_eq_same, zpow_one]
  rw [monomialMap, hj, hg, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: IngramMello.lemma6
statement:
theorem lemma6 {r d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → MvLaurent r)
    (hnc : ∃ i, MvLaurent.NonConst (a i)) :
    ∃ P : (MvLaurent r)[X], P.Monic ∧
      (∀ c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvLaurent r)), aeval c P = 0 →
        aeval c (derivative (monicCentred d a)) = 0 ∧ ¬ HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) c) ∧
      ∃ (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (c₀ : ℂ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q ∧
        (P.map (MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ)).IsRoot c₀ ∧
        (fun z => ((monicCentred d a).map
          (MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ)).eval z)^[q] c₀ = c₀
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed (MvLaurent r) := isIntegrallyClosed_mvLaurent ℂ r
  obtain ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, -, hfg, hnm, hBN, hiff⟩ :=
    exists_infiniteOrbitFactor_monicCentred hd a
  refine ⟨A, hAm, fun c hc => (hiff c).1 hc, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, c₀, q, hq, hroot, -, hper⟩ :=
    exists_superAttracting_root superAttracting_of_algebraic (RingHom.id _) hd a hnc hnm rfl
      hBN hfg
  rw [RingHom.comp_id] at hroot hper
  exact ⟨x, c₀, q, hq, hroot, hper⟩

name: IngramMello.lemma7
statement:
theorem lemma7 {R₀ : Type*} [CommRing R₀] [IsDomain R₀] [IsIntegrallyClosed R₀] [Algebra ℚ R₀]
    {r : ℕ} (ι : R₀ →+* MvLaurent r) {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (a : Fin (d - 1) → R₀) :
    ∃ A : R₀[X], A.Monic ∧ A ∣ derivative (monicCentred d a) ∧
      (∀ c : AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀), aeval c A = 0 ↔
        (aeval c (derivative (monicCentred d a)) = 0 ∧
          ¬ HasFiniteOrbit (monicCentred d a) c)) ∧
      (∀ l j, l ≠ j → W A (monicCentred d a) l j ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ (x : Fin r → ℂˣ) (c₀ : ℂ) (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
        (A.map ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).IsRoot c₀ →
        (fun z => ((monicCentred d a).map
          ((MvLaurent.evalHom x : MvLaurent r →+* ℂ).comp ι)).eval z)^[q] c₀ = c₀ →
        ∀ l, ι (W A (monicCentred d a) (q * (l + 1)) (q * l)) ∈
          MvLaurent.maxIdeal x ^ (l + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, n, m, N, hAm, -, hfg, hnm, hBN, hiff⟩ :=
    exists_infiniteOrbitFactor_monicCentred hd a
  set f := monicCentred d a
  refine ⟨A, hAm, ⟨C (d : R₀) * B, by rw [hfg]; ring⟩, hiff, fun l j hlj => ?_,
    fun x c₀ q hq hA₀ hper l => ?_⟩
  · refine W_ne_zero hAm f ((algebraMap (FractionRing R₀) (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing R₀))).comp
      (algebraMap R₀ (FractionRing R₀))) l j fun c hc heq => ?_
    have h := (hiff c).1 (by rw [aeval_eq_eval_map_algebraicClosure]; exact hc)
    exact h.2 ((hasFiniteOrbit_iff_algebraicClosure f c).2 (finite_orbit_of_iterate_eq _ hlj heq))
  · refine map_W_mem_maxIdeal_pow hAm f ι x hq hA₀ ?_ hper l
    rw [derivative_map, hfg, Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_mul, eval_mul, eval_mul,
      hA₀.eq_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero]
